<file path="app/api/dashboard/stats/route.ts">
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getDashboardStats } from '@/server/queries/dashboard-stats';
import { ForbiddenError, UnauthenticatedError } from '@/lib/permissions';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const stats = await getDashboardStats();
    return NextResponse.json(stats);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof UnauthenticatedError || error instanceof ForbiddenError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
</file>

<file path="app/api/notifications/route.ts">
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getRecentNotifications, getUnreadNotificationsCount } from "@/server/queries/notifications";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const [notifications, unreadCount] = await Promise.all([
      getRecentNotifications(8),
      getUnreadNotificationsCount(),
    ]);

    return NextResponse.json({ notifications, unreadCount });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ notifications: [], unreadCount: 0 }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
</file>

<file path="app/api/regions/route.ts">
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const API_BASE = 'https://emsifa.github.io/api-wilayah-indonesia/api';

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const provinceId = searchParams.get('provinceId');
  const endpoint = provinceId ? `${API_BASE}/regencies/${encodeURIComponent(provinceId)}.json` : `${API_BASE}/provinces.json`;

  try {
    const response = await fetch(endpoint, { next: { revalidate: 86400 } });
    if (!response.ok) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Wilayah tidak tersedia.' }, { status: 502 });
    return NextResponse.json(await response.json(), {
      headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'public, s-maxage=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800' },
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Gagal mengambil data wilayah.' }, { status: 502 });
  }
}
</file>

'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCcw, Home, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';

export default function AppError({
  error,
  reset,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  reset: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error('App error:', error);
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-[#F7FAF8] p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white p-8 shadow-sm text-center">
          {/* Icon */}
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#FEF2F2]">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-8 w-8 text-[#dc2626]" />
          </div>

          {/* Title */}
          <h1 className="mt-6 text-xl font-bold text-[#111827]">Oops! Ada Masalah</h1>

          {/* Description */}
          <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-[#6B7280] leading-relaxed">
            Halaman ini mengalami kesalahan saat memuat data. Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.
          </p>

          {/* Error digest */}
          {error.digest && (
            <div className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-[#F7FAF8] p-3">

<file path="components/auth/logout-confirm-modal.tsx">
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { LogOut } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

export type LogoutConfirmModalProps = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
};

const COUNTDOWN_SECONDS = 5;

export function LogoutConfirmModal({
  isOpen,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: LogoutConfirmModalProps) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;
  return <ModalContent onConfirm={onConfirm} onCancel={onCancel} />;
}

function ModalContent({ onConfirm, onCancel }: { onConfirm: () => void; onCancel: () => void }) {
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(COUNTDOWN_SECONDS);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  const clearTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setSeconds((current) => {
        const next = current - 1;
        return next > 0 ? next : 0;
      });
    }, 1000);
    return clearTimer;
  }, [clearTimer]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (seconds === 0) {
      clearTimer();
      onConfirm();
    }
  }, [seconds, onConfirm, clearTimer]);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity"
        onClick={onCancel}
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white shadow-xl">
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-8">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#f7f000]">
              <LogOut className="h-5 w-5 text-[#181700]" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[#181700] leading-tight">Konfirmasi Keluar</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-stone-500">
                Sesi Anda akan keluar otomatis dalam{' '}
                <span className="font-bold text-[#181700]">{seconds}</span>{' '}
                detik. Pilih opsi di bawah ini.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 bg-[#F9FAFB] px-6 py-4 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end sm:gap-3">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={onCancel}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto h-10 px-4 rounded-full border border-stone-200 bg-white text-[#181700] font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-stone-100"
          >
            Batal
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              clearTimer();
              onConfirm();
            }}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto h-11 px-5 rounded-full bg-[#f7f000] hover:bg-[#e6de00] text-[#181700] font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all shadow-2xs"
          >
            <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" /> Keluar Sekarang
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/dashboard/appointments/appointment-edit-button.tsx">
'use client';

import { Pencil } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AppointmentEditDrawer,
  useAppointmentEditDrawer,
} from '@/components/dashboard/appointments/appointment-edit-drawer';

type Props = {
  appointmentId: string;
  className?: string;
  label?: string;
  onBeforeOpen?: () => void;
};

export function AppointmentEditButton({
  appointmentId,
  className,
  label = 'Edit',
  onBeforeOpen,
}: Props) {
  const editor = useAppointmentEditDrawer();

  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          onBeforeOpen?.();
          editor.openEdit(appointmentId);
        }}
        className={className}
      >
        <Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        <span>{label}</span>
      </button>
      <AppointmentEditDrawer
        isOpen={editor.isOpen}
        isLoading={editor.isLoading}
        data={editor.data}
        onClose={editor.closeEdit}
      />
    </>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { CheckCircle2, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { ConfirmDialog } from '@/components/ui/confirm-dialog';
import { useToast } from '@/components/ui/toast';
import { completeAppointmentSession } from '@/server/actions/therapy-completion';

export function CompleteSessionButton({
  appointmentId,
  className,
}: {
  appointmentId: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  function handleComplete() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await completeAppointmentSession({ appointmentId });
        showToast('success', 'Sesi terapi ditandai selesai.');
        setIsOpen(false);
        router.refresh();
      } catch (error) {
        showToast(
          'error',
          error instanceof Error && error.message !== 'Forbidden'
            ? error.message
            : 'Sesi terapi tidak dapat diselesaikan.',
        );
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)} className={className}>
        {pending ? <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
        <span>Selesaikan</span>
      </button>

      <ConfirmDialog
        isOpen={isOpen}
        title="Selesaikan Sesi Terapi?"
        description="Sesi akan ditandai selesai dan pasien menerima notifikasi. Pastikan catatan terapi sesi ini sudah diisi."
        confirmLabel="Ya, Selesaikan"
        pending={pending}
        onConfirm={handleComplete}
        onCancel={() => setIsOpen(false)}
      />
    </>
  );
}

  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'PENDING' | 'ACCEPTED' | 'REVISION'>('ALL');

  // Slide-over drawer state
  const [selectedPatientId, setSelectedPatientId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedPatientName, setSelectedPatientName] = useState<string>('');
  const [isDrawerOpen, setIsDrawerOpen] = useState(false);

  // Archive modal state

  const [isArchivePending, setIsArchivePending] = useState(false);

    setSelectedPatientId(patientId);
    setSelectedPatientName(patientName);
    setIsDrawerOpen(true);
  };

  const handleArchiveConfirm = async () => {
    if (!archiveTargetId) return;
    setIsArchivePending(true);
    try {
      await archivePatientIntake(archiveTargetId);
      setArchiveTargetId(null);
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      // ignore
    } finally {
      setIsArchivePending(false);
    }
  };

  // Real-time filtering
  const filteredItems = items.filter((row) => {
    if (statusFilter === 'PENDING') {
      if (row.status !== 'SUBMITTED' && row.status !== 'UNDER_REVIEW') return false;
    } else if (statusFilter === 'ACCEPTED') {
      if (row.status !== 'ACCEPTED') return false;
    } else if (statusFilter === 'REVISION') {
      if (row.status !== 'NEEDS_REVISION') return false;
    }

    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const matchName = row.patientName.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchArea = row.affectedArea ? row.affectedArea.toLowerCase().includes(q) : false;
      if (!matchName && !matchArea) return false;
    }

    return true;
  });

  const countPending = items.filter((i) => i.status === 'SUBMITTED' || i.status === 'UNDER_REVIEW').length;
  const countAccepted = items.filter((i) => i.status === 'ACCEPTED').length;

  return (

                ? 'bg-[#181700] text-white shadow-2xs'

<file path="components/dashboard/shared/role-activity-hub.tsx">
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  FolderTabPanel,
  type FolderTab,
  type FolderActivityItem,
  type FolderMetricItem,
  type FolderSummaryTag,
} from '@/components/ui/folder-tab-panel';
import type { ActivityView } from '@/server/queries/recent-activities';
import type { Role } from '@/lib/permissions/roles';

function getTimeAgo(date: Date): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
  const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
  const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
  const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);

  if (diffMins < 1) return 'Baru saja';
  if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}m lalu`;
  if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}j lalu`;
  if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}h lalu`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
}

function getActivityTag(action: string): string {
  const tags: Record<string, string> = {
    'appointment.create': 'Janji Temu Baru',
    'appointment.cancel': 'Pembatalan Jadwal',
    'appointment.update': 'Perubahan Jadwal',
    'appointment.complete': 'Sesi Selesai',
    'progress.finalize': 'Finalisasi RM',
    'progress.create': 'Evaluasi Klinis',
    'progress.update': 'Pembaruan RM',
    'intake.submit': 'Form Intake',
    'intake.review': 'Peninjauan Intake',
    'intake.accept': 'Intake Diterima',
    'intake.reject': 'Intake Ditolak',
    'intake.request-revision': 'Revisi Intake',
    'assessment.create': 'Asesmen Klinis',
    'assessment.finalize': 'Finalisasi Asesmen',
    'session.create': 'Sesi Terapi',
    'session.finalize': 'Sesi Selesai',
    'patient.create': 'Pasien Baru',
    'patient.update': 'Pembaruan Data Pasien',
    'patient.program.complete': 'Program Selesai',
  };

  if (tags[action]) return tags[action];
  if (action.startsWith('appointment.')) return 'Aktivitas Jadwal';
  if (action.startsWith('progress.')) return 'Aktivitas Rekam Medis';
  if (action.startsWith('assessment.')) return 'Aktivitas Asesmen';
  if (action.startsWith('intake.')) return 'Aktivitas Intake';
  if (action.startsWith('patient.')) return 'Aktivitas Pasien';
  return 'Aktivitas Klinis';
}

function getActivityKind(action: string): string {
  if (action.includes('appointment')) return 'Jadwal';
  if (action.includes('progress') || action.includes('assessment')) return 'Medis';
  if (action.includes('intake')) return 'Intake';
  if (action.includes('patient')) return 'Pasien';
  return 'Sistem';
}

function distributePercentages(counts: number[]): number[] {
  const total = counts.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
  if (total === 0) return counts.map(() => 0);

  const raw = counts.map((count) => (count / total) * 100);
  const result = raw.map(Math.floor);
  let remainder = 100 - result.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);

  const order = raw
    .map((value, index) => ({ index, fraction: value - Math.floor(value) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.fraction - a.fraction);

  for (let index = 0; index < remainder; index += 1) {
    result[order[index % order.length].index] += 1;
  }

  return result;
}

export function RoleActivityHub({
  activities,
  role = 'SUPER_ADMIN',
  userName,
  dateLabel,
}: {
  activities: ActivityView[];
  role?: Role;
  userName?: string;
  dateLabel?: string;
}) {
  const isTherapist = role === 'THERAPIST';
  const isAdmin = role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' || role === 'ADMIN';

  // State Tab Aktif
  const [activeTabId, setActiveTabId] = useState<string>('all');

  // Tabs Definition
  const therapistTabs: FolderTab[] = [
    { id: 'all', label: 'Semua', count: activities.length },
    {
      id: 'appointment',
      label: 'Jadwal',
      count: activities.filter((a) => a.action.includes('appointment')).length,
    },
    {
      id: 'progress',
      label: 'RM',
      count: activities.filter(
        (a) => a.action.includes('progress') || a.action.includes('intake') || a.action.includes('assessment')
      ).length,
    },
  ];

  const adminTabs: FolderTab[] = [
    { id: 'all', label: 'Semua', count: activities.length },
    {
      id: 'clinical',
      label: 'Klinis',
      count: activities.filter(
        (a) =>
          a.action.includes('appointment') ||
          a.action.includes('assessment') ||
          a.action.includes('intake') ||
          a.action.includes('progress') ||
          a.action.includes('patient')
      ).length,
    },
    {
      id: 'system',
      label: 'Sistem',
      count: activities.filter(
        (a) =>
          a.action.includes('user') ||
          a.action.includes('role') ||
          a.action.includes('setting') ||
          a.action.includes('login') ||
          a.action.includes('logout')
      ).length,
    },
  ];

  const tabs = isTherapist ? therapistTabs : adminTabs;

  // Filter Aktivitas sesuai Tab
  const filteredActivities = activities.filter((act) => {
    if (isTherapist) {
      if (activeTabId === 'appointment') return act.action.includes('appointment');
      if (activeTabId === 'progress')
        return act.action.includes('progress') || act.action.includes('intake') || act.action.includes('assessment');
      return true;
    }

    if (activeTabId === 'clinical') {
      return (
        act.action.includes('appointment') ||
        act.action.includes('assessment') ||
        act.action.includes('intake') ||
        act.action.includes('progress') ||
        act.action.includes('patient')
      );
    }

    if (activeTabId === 'system') {
      return (
        act.action.includes('user') ||
        act.action.includes('role') ||
        act.action.includes('setting') ||
        act.action.includes('login') ||
        act.action.includes('logout')
      );
    }

    return true;
  });

  // Hitung metrik real aktivitas
  const apptCount = activities.filter((a) => a.action.includes('appointment')).length;
  const progressCount = activities.filter((a) => a.action.includes('progress') || a.action.includes('assessment')).length;
  const intakeCount = activities.filter((a) => a.action.includes('intake')).length;
  const cancelCount = activities.filter((a) => a.action === 'appointment.cancel').length;
  const clinicalCount = activities.filter(
    (a) =>
      a.action.includes('appointment') ||
      a.action.includes('assessment') ||
      a.action.includes('intake') ||
      a.action.includes('progress') ||
      a.action.includes('patient'),
  ).length;
  const systemCount = activities.filter(
    (a) =>
      a.action.includes('user') ||
      a.action.includes('role') ||
      a.action.includes('setting') ||
      a.action.includes('login') ||
      a.action.includes('logout'),
  ).length;
  const operationalCount = Math.max(0, activities.length - clinicalCount - systemCount);

  const therapistPercentages = distributePercentages([apptCount, progressCount, intakeCount]);
  const adminPercentages = distributePercentages([clinicalCount, systemCount, operationalCount]);

  const metrics: FolderMetricItem[] = isTherapist
    ? [
        {
          label: `Janji Temu (${apptCount})`,
          value: `${therapistPercentages[0] ?? 0}%`,
          percentage: therapistPercentages[0] ?? 0,
          barStyle: 'tick',
        },
        {
          label: `Catatan Medis (${progressCount})`,
          value: `${therapistPercentages[1] ?? 0}%`,
          percentage: therapistPercentages[1] ?? 0,
          barStyle: 'solid',
        },
        {
          label: `Form Intake (${intakeCount})`,
          value: `${therapistPercentages[2] ?? 0}%`,
          percentage: therapistPercentages[2] ?? 0,
          barStyle: 'accent',
        },
      ]
    : [
        {
          label: `Klinis (${clinicalCount})`,
          value: `${adminPercentages[0] ?? 0}%`,
          percentage: adminPercentages[0] ?? 0,
          barStyle: 'tick',
        },
        {
          label: `Sistem (${systemCount})`,
          value: `${adminPercentages[1] ?? 0}%`,
          percentage: adminPercentages[1] ?? 0,
          barStyle: 'solid',
        },
        {
          label: `Operasional (${operationalCount})`,
          value: `${adminPercentages[2] ?? 0}%`,
          percentage: adminPercentages[2] ?? 0,
          barStyle: 'accent',
        },
      ];

  const summaryTags: FolderSummaryTag[] = isTherapist
    ? [
        { label: 'Janji Temu', count: apptCount },
        { label: 'Evaluasi RM', count: progressCount },
        { label: 'Batal Jadwal', count: cancelCount },
        { label: 'Form Intake', count: intakeCount },
      ]
    : [
        { label: 'Klinis', count: clinicalCount },
        { label: 'Sistem', count: systemCount },
        { label: 'Operasional', count: operationalCount },
        { label: 'Total Log', count: activities.length },
      ];

  // Map activities to folder items
  const items: FolderActivityItem[] = filteredActivities.slice(0, 5).map((act) => ({
    id: act.id,
    title: act.description,
    subtitle: act.actorName ? `Oleh: ${act.actorName}` : 'Sistem Klinis',
    time: getTimeAgo(new Date(act.createdAt)),
    kind: getActivityKind(act.action),
  }));

  const listTitle = isTherapist
    ? activeTabId === 'appointment'
      ? 'Jadwal Terbaru'
      : activeTabId === 'progress'
        ? 'Catatan Klinis Terbaru'
        : 'Tindakan Klinis Terbaru'
    : activeTabId === 'clinical'
      ? 'Aktivitas Klinis Terbaru'
      : activeTabId === 'system'
        ? 'Aktivitas Sistem Terbaru'
        : 'Riwayat Aktivitas Terbaru';

  return (
    <FolderTabPanel
      tabs={tabs}
      activeTabId={activeTabId}
      onTabChange={setActiveTabId}
      totalValue={activities.length}
      totalLabel={isTherapist ? 'Log Klinis' : 'Aktivitas'}
      context={[dateLabel, userName].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
      summaryVisible={activeTabId === 'all'}
      summaryTitle={isTherapist ? 'Ringkasan Aktivitas Terapi' : 'Ringkasan Aktivitas Sistem'}
      summaryTags={summaryTags}
      metrics={metrics}
      listTitle={listTitle}
      listActionHref={isAdmin ? '/dashboard/audit-logs' : '/dashboard/progress'}
      listActionLabel={isAdmin ? 'Lihat Semua' : 'Rekam Medis'}
      items={items}
      emptyMessage="Belum ada catatan aktivitas pada kategori ini."
    />
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/dashboard/skeletons/skeleton-primitives.tsx">
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function SkeletonBlock({
  className,
  style,
}: {
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      aria-hidden="true"
      style={style}
      className={cn('animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-stone-200/70', className)}
    />
  );
}

export function SkeletonLine({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return <SkeletonBlock className={cn('h-3 rounded-md bg-stone-200/60', className)} />;
}

export function SkeletonPanel({
  className,
  children,
}: {
  className?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={cn('animate-pulse rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white', className)}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

type HeaderSkeletonProps = {
  action?: 'none' | 'single' | 'double';
  className?: string;
};

export function PageHeaderSkeleton({ action = 'none', className }: HeaderSkeletonProps) {
  return (
    <header className={cn('mb-7 w-full border-b border-stone-200/90 pb-6 pt-6', className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <SkeletonBlock className="h-3 w-20 rounded-md bg-stone-100" />
        <SkeletonBlock className="h-3 w-2 rounded-md bg-stone-100" />
        <SkeletonBlock className="h-3 w-24 rounded-md bg-stone-100" />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3">
          <SkeletonBlock className="h-11 w-11 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-stone-200" />
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-2">
            <SkeletonBlock className="h-7 w-52 max-w-full rounded-lg bg-stone-200" />
            <SkeletonLine className="w-full max-w-xl" />
            <SkeletonLine className="w-3/4 max-w-md bg-stone-100" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {action !== 'none' ? (
          <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2 lg:w-auto">
            <SkeletonBlock className="h-10 w-28 rounded-full bg-stone-200" />
            {action === 'double' ? <SkeletonBlock className="h-10 w-36 rounded-full bg-stone-200" /> : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

export function ToolbarSkeleton({ tabs = 3, search = true }: { tabs?: number; search?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-hidden">
        {Array.from({ length: tabs }, (_, index) => (
          <SkeletonBlock
            key={index}
            className={cn('h-8 rounded-xl', index === 0 ? 'w-24 bg-stone-300/70' : 'w-28 bg-stone-200/70')}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      {search ? <SkeletonBlock className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl sm:w-72" /> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ListRowsSkeleton({ rows = 6 }: { rows?: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="divide-y divide-stone-100">
      {Array.from({ length: rows }, (_, index) => (
        <div key={index} className="flex items-center gap-4 py-4">
          <SkeletonBlock className="h-11 w-11 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-stone-100" />
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-2">
            <SkeletonBlock className="h-4 w-40 max-w-full rounded-md bg-stone-200/80" />
            <SkeletonLine className="w-64 max-w-full bg-stone-100" />
          </div>
          <SkeletonBlock className="hidden h-8 w-24 rounded-full bg-stone-100 sm:block" />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function TableRowsSkeleton({ rows = 6, columns = 5 }: { rows?: number; columns?: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 border-b border-stone-200 pb-3">
        {Array.from({ length: columns }, (_, index) => (
          <SkeletonBlock key={index} className="h-3 flex-1 rounded-md bg-stone-100" />
        ))}
      </div>
      {Array.from({ length: rows }, (_, row) => (
        <div key={row} className="flex items-center gap-4 border-b border-stone-100 py-4 last:border-b-0">
          {Array.from({ length: columns }, (_, column) => (
            <SkeletonBlock
              key={column}
              className={cn('h-4 flex-1 rounded-md', column === 0 ? 'bg-stone-200/80' : 'bg-stone-100')}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function FormFieldsSkeleton({ fields = 6 }: { fields?: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
      {Array.from({ length: fields }, (_, index) => (
        <div key={index} className={cn('space-y-2', index === fields - 1 && fields % 2 === 1 && 'sm:col-span-2')}>
          <SkeletonLine className="w-24" />
          <SkeletonBlock className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-stone-100" />
        </div>
      ))}
      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2 sm:col-span-2">
        <SkeletonBlock className="h-10 w-24 rounded-full bg-stone-100" />
        <SkeletonBlock className="h-10 w-36 rounded-full bg-stone-200" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="components/dashboard/therapist/therapist-analytics-bento.tsx">
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  TrendingUp,
  CalendarCheck2,
  Activity,
  Users,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Area,
  AreaChart,
  Bar,
  BarChart,
  CartesianGrid,
  Cell,
  Pie,
  PieChart,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from 'recharts';
import type { DashboardStats } from '@/server/queries/dashboard-stats';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type RangeOption = '7d' | '14d' | '30d';

export function TherapistAnalyticsBento({
  stats,
  isTherapist = true,
}: {
  stats: DashboardStats;
  isTherapist?: boolean;
}) {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<RangeOption>('14d');

  // Trend data slice according to range
  const fullTrend = stats.appointmentsTrend;
  const trendData = range === '7d' ? fullTrend.slice(-7) : fullTrend;

  // Status mapping
  const statusColors: Record<string, string> = {
    INTAKE: 'var(--hafta-ylw-950, #181700)',
    ACTIVE: 'var(--hafta-ylw-200, #e3db00)',
    COMPLETED: '#181700',
    ON_HOLD: 'var(--hafta-org-400, #e7660f)',
    SCHEDULED: 'var(--hafta-ylw-200, #e3db00)',
    IN_PROGRESS: 'var(--hafta-grn-500, #21891a)',
    CANCELLED: 'var(--hafta-red-500, #cb2b2b)',
  };

  const patientPieData = stats.patientsByStatus.map((p) => ({
    name: p.status === 'INTAKE' ? 'Baru / Intake' : p.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'Dalam Terapi' : p.status === 'COMPLETED' ? 'Selesai' : p.status,
    value: p.count,
    color: statusColors[p.status] ?? '#A8A29E',
  }));

  const totalPatients = Math.max(1, patientPieData.reduce((a, b) => a + b.value, 0));

  const apptBarData = stats.appointmentsByStatus.map((a) => ({
    name: a.status === 'SCHEDULED' ? 'Terjadwal' : a.status === 'IN_PROGRESS' ? 'Berjalan' : a.status === 'COMPLETED' ? 'Selesai' : 'Batal',
    value: a.count,
    color: statusColors[a.status] ?? '#A8A29E',
  }));

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 lg:grid-cols-12 items-stretch">
      {/* ── 1. GRAFIK UTAMA: TREN SESI & EVALUASI KLINIS (7 KOLOM) ── */}
      <div className="lg:col-span-7 rounded-3xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
        {/* Header Baris Atas */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between border-b border-stone-100 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700]">
              <TrendingUp className="h-5 w-5" strokeWidth={2.2} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">
                {isTherapist ? 'Tren Sesi & Rekam Medis' : 'Tren Aktivitas Operasional'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">
                Aktivitas pendampingan terapi dan pencatatan perkembangan
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Time-Range Switcher */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-stone-100/90 p-1 self-start sm:self-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setRange('7d')}
              className={cn(
                'rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer',
                range === '7d' ? 'bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs' : 'text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800'
              )}
            >
              7 Hari
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setRange('14d')}
              className={cn(
                'rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer',
                range === '14d' ? 'bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs' : 'text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800'
              )}
            >
              14 Hari
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Legend */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 pt-3 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)]" />
            <span className="font-semibold text-stone-700">Janji Temu</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#181700]" />
            <span className="font-semibold text-stone-700">Evaluasi Rekam Medis</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Chart View */}
        <div className="mt-3 flex-1 min-h-[200px]">
          {trendData.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex h-full min-h-[200px] items-center justify-center text-xs text-stone-400">
              Belum ada riwayat aktivitas pada rentang ini.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <AreaChart data={trendData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -20, bottom: 0 }}>
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient id="trendApptGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                    <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#e3db00" stopOpacity={0.4} />
                    <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#e3db00" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#F5F5F4" vertical={false} />
                <XAxis dataKey="day" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: '#78716c' }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
                <YAxis allowDecimals={false} tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: '#78716c' }} width={24} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
                <Tooltip
                  contentStyle={{
                    borderRadius: '16px',
                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                    border: '1px solid #E7E5E4',
                    boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(24,23,0,0.08)',
                    fontSize: '12px',
                  }}
                  itemStyle={{ color: '#181700', fontWeight: 600 }}
                />
                <Area
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="count"
                  stroke="#e3db00"
                  strokeWidth={2.5}
                  dot={{ r: 3, fill: '#e3db00', strokeWidth: 1, stroke: '#181700' }}
                  fill="url(#trendApptGrad)"
                  name="Janji Temu"
                />
                <Area
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="progressCount"
                  stroke="#181700"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  strokeDasharray="4 4"
                  dot={{ r: 3, fill: '#181700', strokeWidth: 0 }}
                  fill="none"
                  name="Evaluasi RM"
                />
              </AreaChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── 2. STATUS PASIEN & DISTRIBUSI SESI (5 KOLOM BENTO) ── */}
      <div className="lg:col-span-5 rounded-3xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-stone-100 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700]">
              <Users className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">Status Pasien &amp; Sesi</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">Komposisi penanganan pasien terapis</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Donut Chart & Distribution Bar */}
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-5 flex-1">
          {/* Donut Chart */}
          <div className="relative h-28 w-28 shrink-0">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <PieChart>
                <Pie
                  data={patientPieData.length > 0 ? patientPieData : [{ name: 'Belum Ada', value: 1, color: '#E7E5E4' }]}
                  dataKey="value"
                  nameKey="name"
                  innerRadius={36}
                  outerRadius={54}
                  paddingAngle={patientPieData.length > 1 ? 4 : 0}
                  strokeWidth={0}
                  startAngle={90}
                  endAngle={-270}
                >
                  {(patientPieData.length > 0 ? patientPieData : [{ name: 'Belum Ada', value: 1, color: '#E7E5E4' }]).map((entry) => (
                    <Cell key={entry.name} fill={entry.color} />
                  ))}
                </Pie>
              </PieChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
              <span className="font-mono text-xl font-extrabold text-[#181700] leading-none">
                {patientPieData.reduce((a, b) => a + b.value, 0)}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-stone-400 mt-0.5">Pasien</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Legenda Pasien */}
          <div className="w-full sm:flex-1 space-y-1.5">
            {patientPieData.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-stone-400">Belum ada pasien terhubung.</p>
            ) : (
              patientPieData.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.name} className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: item.color }} />
                    <span className="text-stone-600 font-medium truncate">{item.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#181700]">
                    {item.value}{' '}
                    <span className="font-normal text-stone-400 text-[10px]">
                      ({Math.round((item.value / totalPatients) * 100)}%)
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Mini Distribution Bar for Appointments */}
        <div className="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-stone-100">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-2">
            <span className="font-bold text-[#181700]">Distribusi Status Sesi</span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 font-mono">
              {apptBarData.reduce((a, b) => a + b.value, 0)} Total Sesi
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex h-2.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-stone-100 gap-0.5">
            {apptBarData.map((b) => (
              <div
                key={b.name}
                title={`${b.name}: ${b.value}`}
                className="h-full transition-all"
                style={{
                  width: `${Math.max(8, (b.value / Math.max(1, apptBarData.reduce((a, x) => a + x.value, 0))) * 100)}%`,
                  backgroundColor: b.color,
                }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-stone-600">
            {apptBarData.map((b) => (
              <div key={b.name} className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: b.color }} />
                <span>
                  {b.name} ({b.value})
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

<file path="components/dashboard/dashboard-global-search.tsx">
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useTransition, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Search, Loader2, User, Calendar, Users, FileText, ArrowRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { searchGlobalEntities, type SearchResultItem } from '@/server/actions/global-search';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { Role } from '@/lib/permissions/roles';

export function DashboardGlobalSearch({ role }: { role: Role }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = useState<SearchResultItem[]>([]);
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const trimmedQuery = useMemo(() => query.trim(), [query]);
  const activeResults = trimmedQuery ? results : [];

  // Shortcut ⌘K / Ctrl+K
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setIsOpen((prev) => !prev);
        setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  // Klik di luar untuk menutup dropdown
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  // Debounced search
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!trimmedQuery) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      startTransition(async () => {
        try {
          const res = await searchGlobalEntities(trimmedQuery);
          setResults(res);
        } catch {
          setResults([]);
        }
      });
    }, 200);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [trimmedQuery]);

  const handleSelect = (href: string) => {
    setIsOpen(false);
    setQuery('');
    setResults([]);
    router.push(href);
  };

  const getCategoryIcon = (category: SearchResultItem['category']) => {
    switch (category) {
      case 'Pasien':
        return <User className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />;
      case 'Jadwal':
        return <Calendar className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-700)]" />;
      case 'Rekam Medis':
        return <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--hafta-grn-600)]" />;
      case 'Pengguna':
        return <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />;
      default:
        return <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-stone-500" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="relative flex-1 max-w-md hidden md:block">
      {/* Search Input Bar */}
      <div
        className={cn(
          'flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl border bg-[#F7FAF8] px-3.5 py-2 transition-all',
          isOpen
            ? 'border-[#181700] bg-white ring-2 ring-[#f7f000]/30 shadow-sm'
            : 'border-stone-200 hover:border-stone-300'
        )}
      >
        <Search className="h-4 w-4 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="text"
          value={query}
          onFocus={() => setIsOpen(true)}
          onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={role === 'USER' ? 'Cari jadwal sesi, catatan terapi, atau panduan latihan...' : 'Cari pasien, jadwal, atau modul...'}
          className="flex-1 bg-transparent text-xs sm:text-[13px] text-[#181700] placeholder:text-stone-400 outline-none"
        />
        {isPending ? (
          <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
        ) : query ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setQuery('');
              setResults([]);
            }}
            className="text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-600"
          >
            <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </button>
        ) : (
          <kbd className="hidden sm:inline-flex h-5 items-center gap-0.5 rounded border border-stone-200 bg-white px-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-stone-500 shadow-2xs">
            ⌘K
          </kbd>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Floating Dropdown Modal */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full z-50 mt-2 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white shadow-xl animate-in fade-in-50 duration-150">
          <div className="p-2 max-h-[360px] overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-stone-100">
            {trimmedQuery.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-stone-400">
                {role === 'USER'
                  ? 'Cari jadwal sesi, catatan terapi final, atau pengaturan akun...'
                  : 'Ketik nama pasien, jadwal terapi, atau modul sistem...'}
              </div>
            ) : isPending ? (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-6 gap-2 text-xs text-stone-500">
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-[#181700]" />
                <span>Mencari data...</span>
              </div>
            ) : activeResults.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="px-3 py-5 text-center text-xs text-stone-500">
                Tidak ada data yang sesuai dengan kata kunci &ldquo;{query}&rdquo;.
              </div>
            ) : (
              activeResults.map((item) => (
                <button
                  key={item.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(item.href)}
                  className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-stone-50 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-stone-100">
                      {getCategoryIcon(item.category)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-[#181700] sm:text-sm">{item.title}</p>
                        <span className="rounded bg-stone-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-stone-500">
                          {item.category}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="truncate text-[11px] text-stone-500">{item.subtitle}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-stone-300" />
                </button>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/dashboard/intake-history-actions.tsx">
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FileDown, Printer, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useToast } from '@/components/ui/toast';
import { pdf } from '@react-pdf/renderer';
import { IntakeHistoryDocument } from '@/components/pdf/intake-history-document';
import { getIntakeForPdf } from '@/server/actions/intake-pdf';
import type { IntakeHistoryPdfData } from '@/server/queries/patient-intakes';

function safeFilePart(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, '-').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

export function IntakeHistoryActions({
  intakeId,
  patientName,
  submittedAt,
}: {
  intakeId: string;
  patientName: string;
  submittedAt: Date | null;
}) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [printing, setPrinting] = useState(false);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null);

  async function fetchData(): Promise<IntakeHistoryPdfData | null> {
    try {
      return await getIntakeForPdf(intakeId);
    } catch {
      showToast('error', 'Gagal mengambil data intake untuk PDF.');
      return null;
    }
  }

  const openPrintPage = async () => {
    setPrinting(true);
    try {
      const data = await fetchData();
      if (!data) {
        setPrinting(false);
        return;
      }
      const blob = await pdf(<IntakeHistoryDocument data={data} />).toBlob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

      if (iframeRef.current) {
        iframeRef.current.src = url;
        iframeRef.current.onload = () => {
          iframeRef.current?.contentWindow?.print();
          setPrinting(false);
        };
      } else {
        window.location.href = url;
        setPrinting(false);
      }
    } catch {
      showToast('error', 'Gagal memproses file PDF untuk dicetak.');
      setPrinting(false);
    }
  };

  const downloadPdf = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await fetchData();
      if (!data) {
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      const blob = await pdf(<IntakeHistoryDocument data={data} />).toBlob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

      const datePart = submittedAt
        ? new Date(submittedAt).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' })
        : '';
      const filename = `Hafta Fisioterapi - ${safeFilePart(patientName)} - Form Awal - ${datePart}.pdf`;

      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch {
      showToast('error', 'Gagal memproses file PDF.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
      <iframe ref={iframeRef} className="hidden" title="Print Frame" />
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        disabled={printing}
        className="h-8 gap-1 rounded-lg px-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
        onClick={() => void openPrintPage()}
      >
        {printing ? (
          <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
        ) : (
          <Printer className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        )}
        {printing ? '...' : 'Cetak'}
      </Button>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        disabled={loading}
        className="h-8 gap-1 rounded-lg px-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
        onClick={() => void downloadPdf()}
      >
        {loading ? (
          <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
        ) : (
          <FileDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        )}
        {loading ? '...' : 'Unduh PDF'}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/dashboard/intake-table-actions.tsx">
'use client';

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Archive, Eye } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button, buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { ConfirmDialog } from '@/components/ui/confirm-dialog';
import { archivePatientIntake } from '@/server/actions/intake-review';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function IntakeTableActions({ patientId, canArchive }: { patientId: string; canArchive: boolean }) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  function archive() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      await archivePatientIntake(patientId);
      router.refresh();
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
      <Link
        href={`/dashboard/patients/${patientId}/intake`}
        className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: 'outline', size: 'sm' }))}
      >
        <Eye /> <span className="hidden sm:inline">Buka</span>
      </Link>
      {canArchive ? (
        <>
          <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" disabled={pending} onClick={() => setShowConfirm(true)}>
            <Archive /> <span className="hidden sm:inline">Arsipkan</span>
          </Button>
          <ConfirmDialog
            isOpen={showConfirm}
            title="Arsipkan Form Awal?"
            description="Data Form Awal ini akan diarsipkan tanpa dihapus secara permanen."
            confirmLabel="Ya, Arsipkan"
            variant="destructive"
            pending={pending}
            onConfirm={archive}
            onCancel={() => setShowConfirm(false)}
          />
        </>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

type Tab = 'active' | 'archived';

interface PatientListTabsProps {

export function PatientListTabs({ active }: PatientListTabsProps) {

    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-white border border-stone-200/90 w-fit">
      <Link
        href="/dashboard/patients"
        className={cn(
          'px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs sm:text-[13px] font-semibold transition-colors',
          active === 'active'
            ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700] shadow-sm'
            : 'text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-50 hover:text-[#181700]',
        )}
      >
        Aktif
      </Link>
      <Link
        href="/dashboard/patients/archived"
        className={cn(
          'px-3 py-2 rounded-full text-xs sm:text-[13px] font-semibold transition-colors',
          active === 'archived'
            ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700] shadow-sm'
            : 'text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 hover:text-[#181700]',
        )}
      >
        Diarsipkan
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="components/dashboard/session-security-guard.tsx">
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { ShieldAlert, CheckCircle2, LogOut } from 'lucide-react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { signOut } from '@/lib/auth/client';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type Role = 'SUPER_ADMIN' | 'ADMIN' | 'THERAPIST' | 'STAFF' | 'PASIEN' | 'USER';

const IDLE_DURATIONS: Record<string, number> = {
  SUPER_ADMIN: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 menit
  ADMIN: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  THERAPIST: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  STAFF: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  PASIEN: 45 * 60 * 1000, // 45 menit
  USER: 45 * 60 * 1000,
};

const WARNING_BEFORE_EXPIRY = 60 * 1000; // 60 detik terakhir
const HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 10 * 1000; // 10 detik
const SESSION_STORAGE_KEY = 'hafta_tab_active';
const LOCAL_TAB_COUNT_KEY = 'hafta_active_tabs_count';
const LOCAL_LAST_HEARTBEAT_KEY = 'hafta_last_heartbeat';
const REMEMBER_ME_KEY = 'hafta_remember_me';

export function SessionSecurityGuard({
  role,
  userId,
  onForceLogout,
}: {
  role: Role;
  userId: string;
  onForceLogout?: () => void;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const idleTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const countdownRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const broadcastChannelRef = useRef<BroadcastChannel | null>(null);
  const heartbeatRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  // State hanya untuk UI visibility dan countdown display
  const [warningVisible, setWarningVisible] = useState(false);
  const [countdownSeconds, setCountdownSeconds] = useState(60);

  const idleDuration = IDLE_DURATIONS[role] ?? IDLE_DURATIONS.USER;

  const rememberMe =
    typeof window !== 'undefined' && Boolean(window.localStorage.getItem(REMEMBER_ME_KEY));

  // ── Close all slide overs ──
  const closeAllSlideOvers = useCallback(() => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hafta:close-all-slide-overs'));
  }, []);

  // ── Force logout ──
  const forceLogout = useCallback(async (reason: 'idle' | 'closed') => {
    if (idleTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(idleTimeoutRef.current);
    if (countdownRef.current) clearInterval(countdownRef.current);
    if (heartbeatRef.current) clearInterval(heartbeatRef.current);

    const message = JSON.stringify({ type: 'FORCE_LOGOUT', reason });
    if (broadcastChannelRef.current) {
      broadcastChannelRef.current.postMessage(message);
    } else if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem('hafta_auth_sync', message);
    }

    closeAllSlideOvers();

    if (onForceLogout) {
      onForceLogout();
    } else {
      await signOut();
      router.push(`/login?reason=${reason}`);
    }
  }, [onForceLogout, router, closeAllSlideOvers]);

  // ── 1. Tab aktif / deteksi tutup browser vs refresh ──
  useEffect(() => {
    const wasTabActive = sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_STORAGE_KEY) === '1';

    sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_STORAGE_KEY, '1');

    let activeCount = 0;
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_TAB_COUNT_KEY);
      activeCount = stored ? parseInt(stored, 10) + 1 : 1;
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_TAB_COUNT_KEY, String(activeCount));
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_LAST_HEARTBEAT_KEY, String(Date.now()));
    } catch {
      // abaikan
    }

    // Jika tab baru dan tidak ingat perangkat dan heartbeat sudah lama (>15 detik) → logout
    if (!wasTabActive && !rememberMe) {
      const lastHeartbeat = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_LAST_HEARTBEAT_KEY);
      const now = Date.now();
      const heartbeatTime = lastHeartbeat ? parseInt(lastHeartbeat, 10) : 0;
      const isStale = now - heartbeatTime > 15 * 1000;

      if (isStale) {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          const stillStale =
            sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_STORAGE_KEY) === '1' &&
            Date.now() - (parseInt(localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_LAST_HEARTBEAT_KEY) ?? '0', 10)) >
              15 * 1000;
          if (stillStale && !rememberMe) {
            forceLogout('closed');
          }
        }, 2000);
        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    }

    // BroadcastChannel untuk sinkronisasi logout antar-tab
    if (typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined') {
      broadcastChannelRef.current = new BroadcastChannel('hafta_auth_sync');
      broadcastChannelRef.current.onmessage = (event) => {
        if (event.data?.type === 'FORCE_LOGOUT') {
          closeAllSlideOvers();
          if (onForceLogout) {
            onForceLogout();
          } else {
            router.push(`/login?reason=closed`);
          }
        }
      };
    }

    // Fallback storage event listener
    const handleStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'hafta_auth_sync' && event.newValue) {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(event.newValue);
          if (data?.type === 'FORCE_LOGOUT') {
            closeAllSlideOvers();
            if (onForceLogout) {
              onForceLogout();
            } else {
              router.push(`/login?reason=closed`);
            }
          }
        } catch {
          // abaikan parse error
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);

    // Heartbeat setiap 10 detik
    heartbeatRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_LAST_HEARTBEAT_KEY, String(Date.now()));
    }, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL);

    return () => {
      sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_STORAGE_KEY);
      try {
        activeCount = Math.max(0, activeCount - 1);
        localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_TAB_COUNT_KEY, String(activeCount));
      } catch {
        // abaikan
      }
      if (broadcastChannelRef.current) {
        broadcastChannelRef.current.close();
        broadcastChannelRef.current = null;
      }
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
      if (heartbeatRef.current) {
        clearInterval(heartbeatRef.current);
        heartbeatRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [rememberMe, onForceLogout, forceLogout, closeAllSlideOvers, router]);

  // ── 2. Idle activity listener ──
  // resetIdleTimer disimpan di ref untuk menghindari dependency array effect
  const resetIdleTimerRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);

  const resetIdleTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (idleTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(idleTimeoutRef.current);
    if (countdownRef.current) clearInterval(countdownRef.current);

    setWarningVisible(false);
    setCountdownSeconds(60);

    idleTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      // Masuk ke fase peringatan 60 detik terakhir
      setWarningVisible(true);
      let remaining = 60;
      setCountdownSeconds(remaining);
      countdownRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        remaining -= 1;
        setCountdownSeconds(remaining);
        if (remaining <= 0) {
          clearInterval(countdownRef.current!);
          countdownRef.current = null;
          forceLogout('idle');
        }
      }, 1000);
    }, idleDuration);
  }, [idleDuration, forceLogout]);

  // Sync ref setelah render agar activityHandler selalu pakai versi terbaru
  useEffect(() => {
    resetIdleTimerRef.current = resetIdleTimer;
  }, [resetIdleTimer]);

  const activityHandler = useCallback(() => {
    // Saat warning tampil, aktivitas sembarangan tidak boleh reset timer
    if (warningVisible) return;

    resetIdleTimerRef.current?.();
  }, [warningVisible]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const options: AddEventListenerOptions = { passive: true };
    window.addEventListener('mousedown', activityHandler, options);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', activityHandler, options);
    window.addEventListener('touchstart', activityHandler, options);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', activityHandler, options);

    // Mulai timer idle saat montir (difered untuk menghindari cascading render)
    const timerId = setTimeout(() => resetIdleTimerRef.current?.(), 0);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timerId);
      window.removeEventListener('mousedown', activityHandler, options);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', activityHandler, options);
      window.removeEventListener('touchstart', activityHandler, options);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', activityHandler, options);
      if (idleTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(idleTimeoutRef.current);
      if (countdownRef.current) clearInterval(countdownRef.current);
      if (heartbeatRef.current) clearInterval(heartbeatRef.current);
    };
  }, [activityHandler]);

  // ── 3. Auto-save draft ke sessionStorage ──
  const saveDraft = useCallback(
    (patientId: string, formData: Record<string, string>) => {
      try {
        const key = `hafta_draft_soap_${patientId}`;
        sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ ...formData, savedAt: Date.now() }));
      } catch {
        // abaikan
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const loadDraft = useCallback((patientId: string): Record<string, string> | null => {
    try {
      const key = `hafta_draft_soap_${patientId}`;
      const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(key);
      if (!raw) return null;
      return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }, []);

  const clearDraft = useCallback((patientId: string) => {
    try {
      sessionStorage.removeItem(`hafta_draft_soap_${patientId}`);
    } catch {
      // abaikan
    }
  }, []);

  // Expose draft functions via window for drawer components
  useEffect(() => {
    (window as any).__hafta_draft__ = { saveDraft, loadDraft, clearDraft };
    return () => {
      delete (window as any).__hafta_draft__;
    };
  }, [saveDraft, loadDraft, clearDraft]);

  // ── 5. Warning Modal ──
  // Selalu di-mount untuk menghindari unmount/remount flicker;
  // visibilitas dikontrol melalui CSS opacity + pointer-events
  return (
    <>
      <div
        className={cn(
          'fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 transition-opacity duration-200 ease-in-out',
          warningVisible
            ? 'opacity-100 pointer-events-auto bg-[#181700]/45 backdrop-blur-[2px]'
            : 'opacity-0 pointer-events-none',
        )}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label="Peringatan sesi akan berakhir"
        aria-hidden={!warningVisible}
      >
        <div
          className={cn(
            'rounded-3xl bg-white border border-stone-200/90 p-6 shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full mx-4 sm:mx-0 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out',
            warningVisible ? 'opacity-100 scale-100' : 'opacity-0 scale-95 translate-y-4',
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
            <div className="flex h-11 w-11 aspect-square items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700] shrink-0">
              <ShieldAlert className="h-6 w-6" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-[#181700] text-center">
              Sesi Akan Segera Berakhir
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-stone-600 text-center leading-relaxed">
              Tidak ada aktivitas terdeteksi. Demi keamanan data rekam medis, akun akan keluar otomatis dalam:
            </p>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-2xl font-mono font-bold text-[#181700]">
              <span>{countdownSeconds}</span>
              <span className="text-sm">detik</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-6 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full pt-5 border-t border-stone-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setWarningVisible(false);
                setCountdownSeconds(60);
                if (countdownRef.current) clearInterval(countdownRef.current);
                countdownRef.current = null;
                resetIdleTimerRef.current?.();
              }}
              className="h-11 px-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] font-bold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all flex-1 shrink-0"
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              Tetap Masuk
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => forceLogout('idle')}
              className="h-11 px-5 rounded-full bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] border border-stone-200/90 font-semibold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all flex-1 shrink-0"
            >
              <LogOut className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              Keluar Sekarang
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
</file>

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import type { FeaturableReview } from '@/lib/featurable';
import { Star } from 'lucide-react';

export function ContactReviewCard({ review }: { review: FeaturableReview }) {
  const [imageError, setImageError] = useState(false);
  const initial = review.authorName.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();
  const showPhoto = Boolean(review.profilePhotoUrl && !imageError);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col justify-between rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/80 bg-[#FEFEF6] p-6 shadow-xs">
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]">
            {[...Array(review.rating)].map((_, i) => (
              <Star key={i} className="h-4 w-4 fill-current text-amber-400" />
            ))}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-stone-400">
            {review.relativeTimeDescription}
          </span>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-stone-700">
          &ldquo;{review.text}&rdquo;
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-6 flex items-center gap-3 border-t border-stone-200/60 pt-4">
        {showPhoto ? (
          <img
            src={review.profilePhotoUrl!}
            alt={`Foto profil ${review.authorName}`}
            referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
            onError={() => setImageError(true)}
            className="h-10 w-10 shrink-0 rounded-full object-cover shadow-2xs border border-stone-200"
            loading="lazy"
          />
        ) : (
          <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-xs font-bold text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]">
            {initial}
          </span>
        )}
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-stone-900">{review.authorName}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-stone-500">Pasien Terverifikasi Google</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { ArrowRight, Check, MessageCircle, ChevronRight, ShieldPlus, BadgeInfo } from 'lucide-react';

                )}

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      'inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold',
                      isActive
                        ? 'bg-white/15 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]'
                        : 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-600'
                    )}
                  >
                    {number}
                  </span>
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      'h-2 w-2 rounded-full transition-transform',
                      isActive ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] scale-110' : 'bg-stone-300'
                    )}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Baris Bawah: Nama Layanan */}
                <span className={cn('mt-2 text-xs font-bold leading-snug line-clamp-2 sm:text-sm', isActive ? 'text-white' : 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]')}>
                  {item.title}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* ── 2. DESKTOP SPLIT VIEW (4-KOLOM MENU + 8-KOLOM PANEL) ── */}
        <div className="mt-6 grid gap-6 sm:gap-8 lg:mt-8 lg:grid-cols-12 lg:items-start lg:gap-10">
          {/* SISI KIRI (4 KOLOM - DESKTOP ONLY 100% DIPERTAHANKAN) */}
          <div className="hidden space-y-2.5 lg:col-span-4 lg:block">
            {services.map((item, idx) => {
              const isActive = item.id === activeId;
              const number = String(idx + 1).padStart(2, '0');

              return (
                <button
                  key={item.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveId(item.id)}
                  className={cn(
                    'group flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-2xl p-4 text-left transition-all duration-200',

function toDateKey(value: Date | string) {
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value.slice(0, 10);
  return `${value.getFullYear()}-${String(value.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(value.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function formatLongDate(value: Date | string) {
  const date = typeof value === 'string' ? new Date(`${value.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00`) : value;
  return date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
    weekday: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

function formatShortDate(value: Date) {
  return value.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

export function PatientDashboardOverview({

<file path="components/patient/patient-dashboard-progress-hub.tsx">
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { FolderTabPanel, type FolderActivityItem } from '@/components/ui/folder-tab-panel';
import type {
  PatientAppointmentRequestView,
  PatientPortalAppointment,
} from '@/server/queries/patient-portal';
import type { TherapyProgressView } from '@/server/queries/therapy-progress';

type HubTab = 'target' | 'kehadiran' | 'aktivitas';

const TABS = [
  { id: 'target', label: 'Target' },
  { id: 'kehadiran', label: 'Hadir' },
  { id: 'aktivitas', label: 'Aktivitas' },
];

function toDateKey(value: Date | string) {
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value.slice(0, 10);
  return `${value.getFullYear()}-${String(value.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(value.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function formatShortDate(value: Date | string) {
  const date = typeof value === 'string' ? new Date(`${value.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00`) : value;
  return date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
}

function statusLabel(status: string) {
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    COMPLETED: 'Selesai',
    NO_SHOW: 'Tidak hadir',
    CANCELLED: 'Dibatalkan',
    SCHEDULED: 'Terjadwal',
    CONFIRMED: 'Terkonfirmasi',
  };
  return labels[status] ?? status;
}

export function PatientDashboardProgressHub({
  treatmentGoal,
  appointments,
  requests,
  records,
  totalRecords,
}: {
  treatmentGoal: string | null;
  appointments: PatientPortalAppointment[];
  requests: PatientAppointmentRequestView[];
  records: TherapyProgressView[];
  totalRecords: number;
}) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<HubTab>('target');

  const completed = appointments.filter((appointment) => appointment.status === 'COMPLETED').length;
  const noShow = appointments.filter((appointment) => appointment.status === 'NO_SHOW').length;
  const eligibleSessions = completed + noShow;
  const attendance = eligibleSessions ? Math.round((completed / eligibleSessions) * 100) : 0;
  const scheduled = appointments.filter((appointment) =>
    ['SCHEDULED', 'CONFIRMED'].includes(appointment.status),
  ).length;
  const pendingRequests = requests.filter((request) => request.status === 'PENDING').length;
  const today = toDateKey(new Date());

  const recentRecords: FolderActivityItem[] = records.map((record) => ({
    id: `record-${record.id}`,
    title: 'Evaluasi terapi',
    subtitle: record.summary ?? record.diagnosis ?? record.therapistName ?? 'Catatan fisioterapis',
    time: formatShortDate(record.recordedAt),
    kind: 'Catatan',
    href: '/dashboard/progress',
  }));

  const sessionHistory: FolderActivityItem[] = appointments
    .filter((appointment) => toDateKey(appointment.scheduledDate) <= today)
    .sort((a, b) => toDateKey(b.scheduledDate).localeCompare(toDateKey(a.scheduledDate)))
    .slice(0, 4)
    .map((appointment) => ({
      id: `session-${appointment.id}`,
      title: `Sesi ${appointment.startTime}`,
      subtitle: `${appointment.therapistName ?? 'Fisioterapis Hafta'} · ${statusLabel(appointment.status)}`,
      time: formatShortDate(appointment.scheduledDate),
      kind: statusLabel(appointment.status),
      href: '/dashboard/appointments',
    }));

  const latestActivity: FolderActivityItem[] = [
    ...records.map((record) => ({
      id: `activity-record-${record.id}`,
      title: 'Evaluasi terapi dibagikan',
      subtitle: record.summary ?? record.therapistName ?? 'Catatan fisioterapis',
      time: formatShortDate(record.recordedAt),
      kind: 'Catatan',
      href: '/dashboard/progress',
      date: record.recordedAt,
    })),
    ...requests.map((request) => ({
      id: `activity-request-${request.id}`,
      title: request.status === 'PENDING' ? 'Pengajuan jadwal dikirim' : 'Status pengajuan diperbarui',
      subtitle: `${formatShortDate(request.requestedDate)} · ${request.startTime}`,
      time: formatShortDate(request.createdAt),
      kind: 'Pengajuan',
      href: '/dashboard/appointments',
      date: request.createdAt,
    })),
    ...appointments.map((appointment) => ({
      id: `activity-session-${appointment.id}`,
      title: 'Sesi terapi terjadwal',
      subtitle: `${appointment.therapistName ?? 'Fisioterapis Hafta'} · ${statusLabel(appointment.status)}`,
      time: formatShortDate(appointment.scheduledDate),
      kind: 'Jadwal',
      href: '/dashboard/appointments',
      date: new Date(`${toDateKey(appointment.scheduledDate)}T${appointment.startTime}:00`),
    })),
  ]
    .sort((a, b) => b.date.getTime() - a.date.getTime())
    .slice(0, 4)
    .map(({ id, title, subtitle, time, kind, href }) => ({ id, title, subtitle, time, kind, href }));

  const tabContent: Record<
    HubTab,
    {
      totalValue: string | number;
      totalLabel: string;
      context: string;
      summaryTitle: string;
      summaryTags: { label: string; count: number }[];
      metrics: { label: string; value: string | number; percentage: number; barStyle: 'tick' | 'solid' | 'accent' }[];
      listTitle: string;
      items: FolderActivityItem[];
      emptyMessage: string;
      listActionHref: string;
      listActionLabel: string;
    }
  > = {
    target: {
      totalValue: treatmentGoal ? 'Aktif' : '—',
      totalLabel: 'TARGET',
      context: treatmentGoal ?? 'Target terapi akan tampil setelah asesmen awal selesai.',
      summaryTitle: 'Fokus Program',
      summaryTags: [
        { label: 'Sesi selesai', count: completed },
        { label: 'Catatan medis', count: totalRecords },
        { label: 'Jadwal aktif', count: scheduled + pendingRequests },
      ],
      metrics: [
        {
          label: 'Target',
          value: treatmentGoal ? 'Aktif' : '—',
          percentage: treatmentGoal ? 100 : 0,
          barStyle: 'accent',
        },
        { label: 'Kehadiran', value: `${attendance}%`, percentage: attendance, barStyle: 'solid' },
        {
          label: 'Catatan',
          value: totalRecords,
          percentage: totalRecords ? 100 : 0,
          barStyle: 'tick',
        },
      ],
      listTitle: 'Catatan Pendukung Target',
      items: recentRecords,
      emptyMessage: 'Catatan perkembangan akan tampil setelah sesi pertama Anda.',
      listActionHref: '/dashboard/progress',
      listActionLabel: 'Rekam Medis',
    },
    kehadiran: {
      totalValue: `${attendance}%`,
      totalLabel: 'KEHADIRAN',
      context: eligibleSessions
        ? `${completed} dari ${eligibleSessions} sesi terlaksana`
        : 'Belum ada sesi yang dapat dihitung.',
      summaryTitle: 'Rekap Kehadiran',
      summaryTags: [
        { label: 'Hadir', count: completed },
        { label: 'Tidak hadir', count: noShow },
        { label: 'Terjadwal', count: scheduled },
      ],
      metrics: [
        { label: 'Kehadiran', value: `${attendance}%`, percentage: attendance, barStyle: 'solid' },
        { label: 'Sesi selesai', value: completed, percentage: completed ? 100 : 0, barStyle: 'accent' },
        { label: 'Jadwal aktif', value: scheduled, percentage: scheduled ? 100 : 0, barStyle: 'tick' },
      ],
      listTitle: 'Sesi Terakhir',
      items: sessionHistory,
      emptyMessage: 'Belum ada riwayat sesi terapi.',
      listActionHref: '/dashboard/appointments',
      listActionLabel: 'Jadwal',
    },
    aktivitas: {
      totalValue: totalRecords,
      totalLabel: 'AKTIVITAS',
      context: 'Jejak terbaru dari catatan, jadwal, dan pengajuan Anda.',
      summaryTitle: 'Jejak Aktivitas',
      summaryTags: [
        { label: 'Catatan medis', count: totalRecords },
        { label: 'Jadwal aktif', count: scheduled },
        { label: 'Pengajuan', count: pendingRequests },
      ],
      metrics: [
        {
          label: 'Catatan',
          value: totalRecords,
          percentage: totalRecords ? 100 : 0,
          barStyle: 'accent',
        },
        { label: 'Jadwal', value: appointments.length, percentage: appointments.length ? 100 : 0, barStyle: 'solid' },
        { label: 'Pengajuan', value: requests.length, percentage: requests.length ? 100 : 0, barStyle: 'tick' },
      ],
      listTitle: 'Aktivitas Terbaru',
      items: latestActivity,
      emptyMessage: 'Belum ada aktivitas terbaru.',
      listActionHref: '/dashboard/history',
      listActionLabel: 'Riwayat',
    },
  };

  const content = tabContent[activeTab];

  return (
    <FolderTabPanel
      tabs={TABS}
      activeTabId={activeTab}
      onTabChange={(tabId) => setActiveTab(tabId as HubTab)}
      totalValue={content.totalValue}
      totalLabel={content.totalLabel}
      context={content.context}
      summaryTitle={content.summaryTitle}
      summaryTags={content.summaryTags}
      metrics={content.metrics}
      listTitle={content.listTitle}
      listActionHref={content.listActionHref}
      listActionLabel={content.listActionLabel}
      items={content.items}
      emptyMessage={content.emptyMessage}
    />
  );
}

function formatDate(value: Date | null) {
  if (!value) return '-';
  return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}
