<file path="components/patient/therapy-schedule-form.tsx">
'use client';

import { useTransition } from 'react';
import { useForm, Controller } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Save } from 'lucide-react';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { DatePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker';
import { updateTherapySchedule } from '@/server/actions/therapy-schedule';
import type { TherapyScheduleInput } from '@/lib/validators/therapy-schedule';

type Props = {
  patientId: string;
  initialValues: {
    nextTherapyAt: Date | null;
    therapyFrequencyText: string | null;
    therapyGoal: string | null;
    therapistNote: string | null;
  };
};

function formatDateForInput(date: Date | null): string {
  if (!date) return '';
  const d = new Date(date);
  const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
}

export function TherapyScheduleForm({ patientId, initialValues }: Props) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    control,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitSuccessful, isDirty },
    setError,
  } = useForm<TherapyScheduleInput>({
    defaultValues: {
      nextTherapyAt: formatDateForInput(initialValues.nextTherapyAt),
      therapyFrequencyText: initialValues.therapyFrequencyText ?? '',
      therapyGoal: initialValues.therapyGoal ?? '',
      therapistNote: initialValues.therapistNote ?? '',
    },
  });

  return (
    <form
      className="space-y-5"
      onSubmit={handleSubmit((data) =>
        startTransition(async () => {
          try {
            await updateTherapySchedule(patientId, data);
          } catch {
            setError('root', { message: 'Data jadwal terapi tidak dapat disimpan. Coba lagi.' });
          }
        }),
      )}
    >
      {isSubmitSuccessful && !isDirty ? (
        <Alert variant="success">
          <AlertDescription>Data jadwal terapi berhasil disimpan.</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}
      {errors.root ? (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{errors.root.message}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="nextTherapyAt">Kunjungan Berikutnya</Label>
          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="nextTherapyAt"
            render={({ field }) => (
              <DatePicker
                id="nextTherapyAt"
                value={field.value ?? ''}
                onChange={field.onChange}
                disabled={pending}
              />
            )}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="therapyFrequencyText">Frekuensi Terapi</Label>
          <Input
            id="therapyFrequencyText"
            placeholder="contoh: 2x seminggu"
            disabled={pending}
            {...register('therapyFrequencyText')}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="therapyGoal">Tujuan Terapi</Label>
        <Input
          id="therapyGoal"
          placeholder="contoh: Peningkatan ROM sendi bahu"
          disabled={pending}
          {...register('therapyGoal')}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="therapistNote">Catatan Terapis</Label>
        <textarea
          id="therapistNote"
          disabled={pending}
          placeholder="Catatan tindak lanjut, edukasi, atau instruksi khusus..."
          className="flex min-h-20 w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm leading-relaxed placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          {...register('therapistNote')}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-end border-t border-border pt-4">
        <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={pending || !isDirty}>
          {pending ? 'Menyimpan...' : (
            <>
              <Save className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Simpan
            </>
          )}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

<file path="components/ui/alert.tsx">
import * as React from 'react';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const alertVariants = cva('relative w-full rounded-xl border p-4', {
  variants: {
    variant: {
      default: 'bg-background text-foreground',
      destructive: 'border-destructive/50 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive',
      success: 'border-success/50 bg-success/10 text-success',
      warning: 'border-warning/50 bg-warning/10 text-warning',
      info: 'border-primary/50 bg-primary/10 text-primary',
    },
  },
  defaultVariants: { variant: 'default' },
});

function Alert({ className, variant, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'> & VariantProps<typeof alertVariants>) {
  return <div role="alert" className={cn(alertVariants({ variant }), className)} {...props} />;
}

function AlertTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'h5'>) {
  return <h5 className={cn('mb-1 font-semibold leading-none tracking-tight', className)} {...props} />;
}

function AlertDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return <div className={cn('text-sm [&_p]:leading-relaxed', className)} {...props} />;
}

export { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription };

const badgeVariants = cva(

      variant: "default",

  extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>,

<file path="components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx">
import Link from 'next/link';
import { ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  label: string;
  href?: string;
}

interface BreadcrumbProps {
  items: BreadcrumbItem[];
  className?: string;
}

export function Breadcrumb({ items, className }: BreadcrumbProps) {
  return (
    <nav
      aria-label="Breadcrumb"
      className={cn('flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground sm:text-sm', className)}
    >
      {items.map((item, index) => {
        const isLast = index === items.length - 1;

        return (
          <div key={item.label} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {index > 0 && <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />}
            {item.href && !isLast ? (
              <Link href={item.href} className="transition-colors hover:text-foreground">
                {item.label}
              </Link>
            ) : (
              <span className={isLast ? 'font-medium text-foreground' : undefined}>{item.label}</span>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
}

export interface FolderSummaryTag {

export interface FolderActivityItem {

  time: string;
  kind: string;
  href?: string;
}

export interface FolderTabPanelProps {

  activeTabId: string;

  // Header ringkasan utama
  totalValue: string | number;

export function FolderTabPanel({
  tabs,
  activeTabId,
  onTabChange,
  totalValue,
  totalLabel,
  context,
  summaryVisible = true,
  summaryTitle = 'Ringkasan Aktivitas',
  summaryTags = [],
  metrics = [],
  items = [],
  listTitle = 'Tindakan Klinis Terbaru',
  listActionHref,
  listActionLabel = 'Rekam Medis',
  emptyMessage = 'Belum ada aktivitas pada kategori ini.',
  className,
}: FolderTabPanelProps) {
  const uid = React.useId().replace(/:/g, '');
  const hatchId = `activity-hatch-${uid}`;
  const clipId = `activity-hatch-clip-${uid}`;

  return (
    <div className={cn('overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white', className)}>
      {/* ── TRUE FOLDER TABS ── */}

        role="tablist"

      >
        {tabs.map((tab) => {

              key={tab.id}

              onClick={() => onTabChange(tab.id)}

              )}
            >
              {isActive && (
                <>
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"

                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-2 bottom-0 h-2 w-2"
                    style={{
                      background:
                        'radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0, transparent 0, transparent 7px, #ffffff 7.5px)',
                    }}
                  />
                </>
              )}
              <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{tab.label}</span>
              {typeof tab.count === 'number' && (
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    'flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold',
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-[#181700] text-white'
                      : 'border border-stone-300 bg-white font-medium text-[#181700]'
                  )}
                >
                  {tab.count}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ── BADAN KARTU ── */}
      <div className="bg-white p-4 sm:p-5">
        {/* Header utama */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#181700] sm:text-[26px]">
              {totalValue}
              <sup className="ml-1 align-super text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[0.14em] text-stone-400">
                {totalLabel}
              </sup>
            </p>
            {context ? (
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-stone-400">{context}</p>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          {listActionHref ? (
            <Link
              href={listActionHref}
              className="shrink-0 rounded-full border border-stone-200/90 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[#181700] transition-all hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]"
            >
              {listActionLabel}
            </Link>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {/* Sub-card ringkasan */}
        {summaryVisible && (
          <div className="mt-5 rounded-3xl bg-[#F7F7F5] p-5 sm:p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold tracking-normal text-[#181700] sm:text-base">
                {summaryTitle}
              </h3>
              {listActionHref ? (
                <Link
                  href={listActionHref}
                  aria-label={listActionLabel}
                  className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]"
                >
                  <ArrowUpRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                </Link>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <div className="my-5 grid grid-cols-12 items-center gap-3">
              {/* Tag pill real — strict left column */}
              <div className="col-span-7 flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2 pr-1">
                {summaryTags.slice(0, 4).map((tag) => (
                  <span
                    key={tag.label}
                    className="flex w-full max-w-[175px] items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#EFEFED] px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-stone-700"
                  >
                    <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{tag.label}</span>
                    <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-white/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-stone-600">
                      {tag.count}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Architectural circle dengan arsiran diagonal — strict right column */}
              <div className="col-span-5 flex min-w-0 items-center justify-center">
                <div className="relative flex aspect-square w-full max-w-28 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-stone-200/80 bg-white shadow-2xs sm:max-w-32">
                <svg className="h-full w-full" viewBox="0 0 100 100" aria-hidden="true">
                  <defs>
                    <pattern
                      id={hatchId}
                      width="6"
                      height="6"
                      patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
                      patternTransform="rotate(45)"
                    >
                      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="6" stroke="#d6d3d1" strokeWidth="1" />
                    </pattern>
                    <clipPath id={clipId}>
                      <rect x="0" y="0" width="50" height="100" />
                    </clipPath>
                  </defs>
                  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="48" fill="#FFFFFF" />
                  <circle
                    cx="50"
                    cy="50"
                    r="48"
                    fill={`url(#${hatchId})`}
                    clipPath={`url(#${clipId})`}
                  />
                </svg>
                <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <span className="text-xl font-bold leading-none text-[#181700] sm:text-2xl">
                    {totalValue}
                  </span>
                  <span className="ml-1 -translate-y-1 text-[9px] font-medium leading-none text-stone-500 sm:text-[11px]">
                    Aktivitas
                  </span>
                </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 3 kolom metrik */}
            {metrics.length > 0 && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-2">
                {metrics.map((metric) => {
                  const width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, metric.percentage));
                  return (
                    <div key={metric.label} className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="truncate text-base font-bold leading-none text-[#181700] sm:text-lg">
                        {metric.value}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mb-2.5 mt-1 text-[10px] leading-tight text-stone-500 sm:text-[11px]">
                        {metric.label}
                      </p>
                      <div className="h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-stone-200/80">
                        <div
                          className={cn(
                            'h-full rounded-full',
                            metric.barStyle === 'solid'
                              ? 'bg-[#181700]'
                              : metric.barStyle === 'accent'
                                ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]'
                                : ''
                          )}
                          style={{
                            width: `${width}%`,
                            ...(metric.barStyle === 'tick'
                              ? {
                                  backgroundImage:
                                    'repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #57534e 0px, #57534e 1.5px, transparent 1.5px, transparent 4px)',
                                }
                              : {}),
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Daftar tindakan */}
        <div className="mt-5 rounded-3xl bg-[#F7F7F5] p-5">
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[#181700]">{listTitle}</h3>
            {listActionHref ? (
              <Link
                href={listActionHref}
                aria-label={listActionLabel}
                className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]"
              >
                <ArrowUpRight className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Link>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          {items.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-stone-400">{emptyMessage}</div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {items.map((item, index) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3">
                    <span className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#EFEFED] text-xs font-semibold text-stone-600">
                      {index + 1}
                    </span>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="break-words text-[12px] font-bold leading-tight text-[#181700]">
                        {item.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="break-words text-xs text-stone-400 pt-1">{item.subtitle}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="w-24 shrink-0 text-right">
                    <div className="mb-1 ml-auto flex w-16 items-center gap-1">
                      <span className="h-1 w-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]" />
                      <span className="h-0.5 flex-1 border-b-2 border-dotted border-stone-400" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold leading-none text-[#181700] sm:text-xs">
                        {item.time}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-medium capitalize text-stone-400">
                        {item.kind}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="components/ui/notched-card.tsx">
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { ArrowRight, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export type NotchedCardVariant = 'white' | 'accent' | 'dark';

export interface NotchedCardProps {
  icon?: LucideIcon | React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }> | React.ReactNode;
  badge?: React.ReactNode;
  title: React.ReactNode;
  description?: React.ReactNode;
  href?: string;
  onClick?: () => void;
  buttonText?: string;
  variant?: NotchedCardVariant;
  className?: string;
  showRings?: boolean;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}

const variantStyles: Record<
  NotchedCardVariant,
  {
    fillColor: string;
    strokeColor: string;
    dropShadow: string;
    textTitle: string;
    textBody: string;
    badgeBg: string;
    badgeText: string;
    iconBg: string;
    buttonBg: string;
    buttonText: string;
    buttonBorder: string;
    ringColor: string;
  }
> = {
  white: {
    fillColor: '#FFFFFF',
    strokeColor: '#E7E5E4', // stone-200
    dropShadow: 'drop-shadow(0 10px 25px rgba(24, 23, 0, 0.04))',
    textTitle: 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]',
    textBody: 'text-stone-600',
    badgeBg: 'bg-stone-100',
    badgeText: 'text-stone-700',
    iconBg: 'bg-[#FEFEF6] border border-stone-200/90 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]',
    buttonBg: 'bg-white hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]',
    buttonText: 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]',
    buttonBorder: 'border border-stone-200/90 hover:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] shadow-2xs',
    ringColor: 'stroke-stone-300/45',
  },
  accent: {
    fillColor: 'var(--hafta-ylw-100, #f7f000)', // Hafta Yellow
    strokeColor: 'var(--hafta-ylw-200, #e3db00)',
    dropShadow: 'drop-shadow(0 14px 28px rgba(247, 240, 0, 0.22))',
    textTitle: 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]',
    textBody: 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-900)]/85',
    badgeBg: 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]/10',
    badgeText: 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]',
    iconBg: 'bg-white text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)] shadow-2xs',
    buttonBg: 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)]',
    buttonText: 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]',
    buttonBorder: 'border border-[var(--hafta-ylw-300)]/60 shadow-2xs',
    ringColor: 'stroke-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]/12',
  },
  dark: {
    fillColor: 'var(--hafta-ylw-950, #181700)', // Deep Hafta Charcoal
    strokeColor: 'var(--hafta-ylw-800, #3a3700)',
    dropShadow: 'drop-shadow(0 14px 30px rgba(24, 23, 0, 0.2))',
    textTitle: 'text-white',
    textBody: 'text-stone-300',
    badgeBg: 'bg-white/10',
    badgeText: 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]',
    iconBg: 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-900)] text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] border border-[var(--hafta-ylw-800)]',
    buttonBg: 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]',
    buttonText: 'text-white hover:text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]',
    buttonBorder: 'border border-[var(--hafta-ylw-800)] hover:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] shadow-2xs',
    ringColor: 'stroke-white/12',
  },
};

export function NotchedCard({
  icon: Icon,
  badge,
  title,
  description,
  href,
  onClick,
  buttonText = 'Lihat Detail',
  variant = 'white',
  className,
  showRings = false,
  children,
}: NotchedCardProps) {
  const styles = variantStyles[variant];
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [size, setSize] = useState({ w: 320, h: 320 });

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = containerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const updateSize = () => {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) {
        setSize({ w: Math.round(rect.width), h: Math.round(rect.height) });
      }
    };
    updateSize();
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(updateSize);
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  // Geometri Notch & Radius
  const { w, h } = size;
  const R = 28; // Radius sudut utama kartu
  const r = 20; // Radius sudut sekeliling ceruk (notch) & inverted fillet
  const nw = Math.min(230, Math.max(180, w * 0.6)); // Lebar ceruk (notch width) di kiri bawah
  const nh = 56; // Tinggi ceruk (notch height) di kiri bawah
  const s = 0.75; // Inset 0.75px agar stroke 1.5px tidak terpotong di tepi viewBox

  // Single continuous SVG path untuk kartu dengan ceruk kiri-bawah yang 100% transparan
  const notchedPath = `
    M ${R} ${s}
    H ${w - R}
    A ${R - s} ${R - s} 0 0 1 ${w - s} ${R}
    V ${h - R}
    A ${R - s} ${R - s} 0 0 1 ${w - R} ${h - s}
    H ${nw + r}
    A ${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${nw} ${h - s - r}
    V ${h - nh + r}
    A ${r} ${r} 0 0 0 ${nw - r} ${h - nh}
    H ${r}
    A ${r - s} ${r - s} 0 0 1 ${s} ${h - nh - r}
    V ${R}
    A ${R - s} ${R - s} 0 0 1 ${R} ${s}
    Z
  `;

  const clipId = React.useId();

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={cn(
        'group relative flex flex-col justify-between transition-transform duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1.5',
        className
      )}
    >
      {/* ── 1. TRUE TRANSPARENT SVG SILHOUETTE & CONTINUOUS BORDER ── */}
      <svg
        width={w}
        height={h}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`}
        fill="none"
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 h-full w-full select-none"
        style={{ filter: styles.dropShadow }}
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <defs>
          <clipPath id={clipId}>
            <path d={notchedPath} />
          </clipPath>
        </defs>

        {/* Badan Kartu + Garis Tepi (Inverted Outline 100% Mulus Tanpa Garis Bocor) */}
        <path
          d={notchedPath}
          fill={styles.fillColor}
          stroke={styles.strokeColor}
          strokeWidth="1.25"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
        />

        {/* Watermark Concentric Rings (Terkunci di dalam clipPath kartu) */}
        {showRings && (
          <g clipPath={`url(#${clipId})`}>
            <circle cx={w + 10} cy={h + 10} r="36" strokeWidth="1.5" className={styles.ringColor} />
            <circle cx={w + 10} cy={h + 10} r="62" strokeWidth="1.5" className={styles.ringColor} />
            <circle cx={w + 10} cy={h + 10} r="88" strokeWidth="1.5" className={styles.ringColor} />
            <circle cx={w + 10} cy={h + 10} r="114" strokeWidth="1.5" className={styles.ringColor} />
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>

      {/* ── 2. CARD CONTENT ── */}
      <div
        className="relative z-10 flex flex-1 flex-col justify-between p-5 sm:p-6"
        style={{ paddingBottom: nh + 20 }}
      >
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            {Icon && (
              <div className={cn('flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full', styles.iconBg)}>
                {React.isValidElement(Icon) ? (
                  Icon
                ) : typeof Icon === 'function' || (typeof Icon === 'object' && Icon !== null) ? (
                  // @ts-expect-error dynamic component
                  <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
                ) : null}
              </div>
            )}
            {badge && (
              <div className="flex justify-end">
                {typeof badge === 'string' ? (
                  <span className={cn('rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold', styles.badgeBg, styles.badgeText)}>
                    {badge}
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  badge
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4">
            <h3 className={cn('text-base sm:text-lg font-bold tracking-tight', styles.textTitle)}>
              {title}
            </h3>
            {description && (
              <div className={cn('mt-2 text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed', styles.textBody)}>
                {description}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {children}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── 3. PILL BUTTON (DI DALAM CERUK TRANSPARAN KIRI BAWAH) ── */}
      <div
        className="absolute bottom-1.5 left-1 z-20 flex items-center"
        style={{
          height: nh - 10,
          maxWidth: nw - 10,
        }}
      >
        {href ? (
          <Link
            href={href}
            className={cn(
              'inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold transition-all duration-200 group-hover:gap-2 sm:gap-2 sm:px-4 sm:text-xs',
              styles.buttonBg,
              styles.buttonText,
              styles.buttonBorder
            )}
          >
            <span>{buttonText}</span>
            <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />
          </Link>
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClick}
            className={cn(
              'inline-flex max-w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold transition-all duration-200 group-hover:gap-2 sm:gap-2 sm:px-4 sm:text-xs',
              styles.buttonBg,
              styles.buttonText,
              styles.buttonBorder
            )}
          >
            <span>{buttonText}</span>
            <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/ui/notification-inbox-popover.tsx">
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent } from "@/components/ui/popover";
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import {
  Bell,
  GitMerge,
  FileText,
  ClipboardCheck,
  Mail,
  MessageSquareQuote,
  AlertCircle,
  LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

interface Notification {
  id: number;
  user: string;
  action: string;
  target: string;
  timestamp: string;
  unread: boolean;
  icon: LucideIcon;
}

const initialNotifications: Notification[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    user: "Alicia Keys",
    action: "merged",
    target: "PR #105: Dark mode support",
    timestamp: "10 minutes ago",
    unread: true,
    icon: GitMerge,
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    user: "Daniel Green",
    action: "shared file",
    target: "Quarterly Report.pdf",
    timestamp: "30 minutes ago",
    unread: true,
    icon: FileText,
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    user: "Sophia Turner",
    action: "assigned you a task",
    target: "Marketing campaign brief",
    timestamp: "2 hours ago",
    unread: false,
    icon: ClipboardCheck,
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    user: "Michael Ross",
    action: "sent you a message",
    target: "Project feedback discussion",
    timestamp: "5 hours ago",
    unread: false,
    icon: Mail,
  },
  {
    id: 5,
    user: "Priya Sharma",
    action: "added a comment",
    target: "UX Review Notes",
    timestamp: "1 day ago",
    unread: false,
    icon: MessageSquareQuote,
  },
  {
    id: 6,
    user: "System",
    action: "alert",
    target: "Server downtime scheduled",
    timestamp: "3 days ago",
    unread: false,
    icon: AlertCircle,
  },
];

function NotificationInboxPopover() {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState(initialNotifications);
  const unreadCount = notifications.filter((n) => n.unread).length;
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("all");

  const filtered = tab === "unread" ? notifications.filter((n) => n.unread) : notifications;

  const markAsRead = (id: number) => {
    setNotifications(
      notifications.map((n) => (n.id === id ? { ...n, unread: false } : n)),
    );
  };

  const markAllAsRead = () => {
    setNotifications(notifications.map((n) => ({ ...n, unread: false })));
  };

  return (
    <Popover>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button size="icon" variant="outline" className="relative" aria-label="Open notifications">
          <Bell size={16} strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden="true" />
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <Badge className="absolute -top-2 left-full min-w-5 -translate-x-1/2 px-1">
              {unreadCount > 99 ? "99+" : unreadCount}
            </Badge>
          )}
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent className="w-[380px] p-0">
        {/* Header with Tabs + Mark All */}
        <Tabs value={tab} onValueChange={setTab}>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b px-3 py-2">
            <TabsList className="bg-transparent">
              <TabsTrigger value="all" className="text-sm">All</TabsTrigger>
              <TabsTrigger value="unread" className="text-sm">
                Unread {unreadCount > 0 && <Badge className="ml-1">{unreadCount}</Badge>}
              </TabsTrigger>
            </TabsList>
            {unreadCount > 0 && (
              <button
                onClick={markAllAsRead}
                className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:underline cursor-pointer"
              >
                Mark all as read
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Notifications List */}
          <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="px-3 py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                No notifications
              </div>
            ) : (
              filtered.map((n) => {
                const Icon = n.icon;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={n.id}
                    onClick={() => markAsRead(n.id)}
                    className="flex w-full items-start gap-3 border-b px-3 py-3 text-left hover:bg-accent cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <div className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground">
                      <Icon size={18} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 space-y-1">
                      <p
                        className={`text-sm ${
                          n.unread ? "font-semibold text-foreground" : "text-foreground/80"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {n.user} {n.action}{" "}
                        <span className="font-medium">{n.target}</span>
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{n.timestamp}</p>
                    </div>
                    {n.unread && (
                      <span className="mt-1 inline-block size-2 rounded-full bg-primary" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </Tabs>

function getSignatureDataUrl(): string {
  const filePath = join(process.cwd(), 'public/images/signs/sign_sample.png');
  const buffer = readFileSync(filePath);
  const base64 = buffer.toString('base64');
  return `data:image/png;base64,${base64}`;
}

<file path="components/ui/scroll-reveal.tsx">
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from 'framer-motion';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export type ScrollRevealDirection = 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right' | 'none';

export interface ScrollRevealProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  delay?: number;
  duration?: number;
  direction?: ScrollRevealDirection;
  distance?: number;
  once?: boolean;
}

const directionOffsets: Record<ScrollRevealDirection, { x: number; y: number }> = {
  up: { x: 0, y: 24 },
  down: { x: 0, y: -24 },
  left: { x: 24, y: 0 },
  right: { x: -24, y: 0 },
  none: { x: 0, y: 0 },
};

export function ScrollReveal({
  children,
  className,
  delay = 0,
  duration = 0.55,
  direction = 'up',
  distance,
  once = true,
}: ScrollRevealProps) {
  const shouldReduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const defaultOffset = directionOffsets[direction];
  const offset = distance
    ? {
        x: direction === 'left' ? distance : direction === 'right' ? -distance : 0,
        y: direction === 'up' ? distance : direction === 'down' ? -distance : 0,
      }
    : defaultOffset;

  if (shouldReduceMotion) {
    return <div className={className}>{children}</div>;
  }

  return (
    <motion.div
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: offset.x, y: offset.y }}
      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, x: 0, y: 0 }}
      viewport={{ once, margin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' }}
      transition={{
        duration,
        delay,
        ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1],
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export const ScrollAnimation = ScrollReveal;
export default ScrollReveal;
</file>

<file path="components/ui/use-overlay-layer.ts">
'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

let openOverlays: string[] = [];
let revision = 0;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function notify() {
  revision += 1;
  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
}

function subscribe(listener: () => void) {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

function getRevision() {
  return revision;
}

function register(id: string) {
  if (openOverlays[openOverlays.length - 1] === id) return;
  openOverlays = [...openOverlays.filter((item) => item !== id), id];
  notify();
}

function unregister(id: string) {
  if (!openOverlays.includes(id)) return;
  openOverlays = openOverlays.filter((item) => item !== id);
  notify();
}

const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window === 'undefined' ? useEffect : useLayoutEffect;

export function useOverlayLayer(isOpen: boolean) {
  const id = useId();
  const currentRevision = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getRevision, () => 0);
  void currentRevision;

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    register(id);
    return () => unregister(id);
  }, [id, isOpen]);

  const index = openOverlays.indexOf(id);
  const isTopmost = index >= 0 && index === openOverlays.length - 1;
  const zIndex = 40 + Math.max(index, 0) * 2;

  return { isTopmost, zIndex };
}

<file path="lib/permissions/dashboard-routes.ts">
import type { Role } from './roles';

type DashboardRouteRule = {
  pattern: RegExp;
  roles: readonly Role[];
};

const ALL_ROLES: readonly Role[] = ['SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'THERAPIST', 'STAFF', 'USER'];
const STAFF_ROLES: readonly Role[] = ['SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'THERAPIST', 'STAFF'];
const CLINICAL_ROLES: readonly Role[] = ['SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'THERAPIST', 'USER'];
const ADMIN_ROLES: readonly Role[] = ['SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN'];
const USER_CREATE_ROLES: readonly Role[] = ['SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'THERAPIST'];
const USER_LIST_ROLES: readonly Role[] = ['SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'STAFF'];

const ROUTE_RULES: readonly DashboardRouteRule[] = [
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard$/, roles: ALL_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/profile(?:\/|$)/, roles: ['USER'] },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/patients(?:\/|$)/, roles: STAFF_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/calendar-events(?:\/|$)/, roles: ADMIN_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/calendar(?:\/|$)/, roles: STAFF_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/users\/add(?:\/|$)/, roles: USER_CREATE_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/users(?:\/|$)/, roles: USER_LIST_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/audit-logs(?:\/|$)/, roles: ADMIN_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/settings(?:\/|$)/, roles: ['SUPER_ADMIN'] },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/progress(?:\/|$)/, roles: CLINICAL_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/appointments\/new(?:\/|$)/, roles: STAFF_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/appointments(?:\/|$)/, roles: ALL_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/intake(?:\/|$)/, roles: ALL_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/history(?:\/|$)/, roles: ALL_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/notifications(?:\/|$)/, roles: ALL_ROLES },
  { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/security(?:\/|$)/, roles: ALL_ROLES },
];

export function canAccessDashboardPath(role: Role, pathname: string) {
  const normalized = pathname.split('?')[0]?.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/dashboard';
  const rule = ROUTE_RULES.find((item) => item.pattern.test(normalized));
  return rule ? rule.roles.includes(role) : false;
}
</file>

<file path="lib/permissions/require-permission.ts">
import { requireSession } from '@/lib/auth/require-session';
import { type Permission } from './constants';
import { authorize } from './policy';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';

export async function requirePermission(
  permission: Permission,
  resource?: {
    userId?: string;
    patientId?: string;
    therapistId?: string;
    status?: string;
    patientVisible?: boolean;
  },
) {
  const { session, role } = await requireSession({ redirectToLogin: true });

  const authSession = {
    user: {
      id: session.user.id,
      email: session.user.email,
      role: role,
    },
  };

  try {
    authorize({
      session: authSession,
      permission,
      resource,
    });
    return { session: authSession };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'name' in error && error.name === 'ForbiddenError') {
      // You can return a forbidden page or redirect
      redirect('/dashboard');
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

<file path="lib/permissions/resource-access.ts">
import { and, eq, or } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { getDb } from '@/db';
import { patients } from '@/db/schema/patients';
import { requireSession } from '@/lib/auth/require-session';
import { type Permission } from './constants';
import { ForbiddenError, hasPermission } from './policy';

export async function requirePatientAccess(patientId: string, permission: Permission) {
  const { session, role } = await requireSession({ redirectToLogin: true });

  if (!hasPermission(role, permission)) {
    throw new ForbiddenError();
  }

  const db = getDb();

  if (role === 'USER') {
    const [patient] = await db
      .select()
      .from(patients)
      .where(and(eq(patients.id, patientId), eq(patients.userId, session.user.id)))
      .limit(1);

    if (!patient) {
      throw new ForbiddenError();
    }

    return patient;
  }

  const [patient] = await db
    .select()
    .from(patients)
    .where(or(eq(patients.id, patientId), eq(patients.userId, patientId)))
    .limit(1);

  if (!patient) {
    throw new ForbiddenError();
  }

  return patient;
}

<file path="lib/security/host-routing.ts">
export function isPublicHost(host: string, publicAppHost: string) {
  const normalizedHost = host.toLowerCase().split(':')[0];
  const normalizedPublicHost = publicAppHost.toLowerCase();

  return (
    Boolean(normalizedPublicHost) &&
    (normalizedHost === normalizedPublicHost || normalizedHost === `www.${normalizedPublicHost}`)
  );
}

export function shouldHideDashboardOnHost(host: string, pathname: string, publicAppHost: string) {
  return isPublicHost(host, publicAppHost) && pathname.startsWith('/dashboard');
}

<file path="lib/validators/therapist-availability.ts">
import { z } from 'zod';

const timePattern = /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/;
const datePattern = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

function minutes(value: string) {
  const [hours, mins] = value.split(':').map(Number);
  return hours * 60 + mins;
}

export const therapistScheduleEntrySchema = z
  .object({
    dayOfWeek: z.number().int().min(0).max(6),
    startTime: z.string().regex(timePattern, 'Format jam tidak valid.'),
    endTime: z.string().regex(timePattern, 'Format jam tidak valid.'),
  })
  .refine((entry) => minutes(entry.endTime) > minutes(entry.startTime), {
    message: 'Jam selesai harus lebih lambat dari jam mulai.',
    path: ['endTime'],
  });

export const saveTherapistScheduleSchema = z
  .object({
    therapistId: z.string().uuid(),
    entries: z.array(therapistScheduleEntrySchema).max(50),
  })
  .superRefine((value, ctx) => {
    const byDay = new Map<number, Array<{ start: number; end: number; index: number }>>();
    value.entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
      const items = byDay.get(entry.dayOfWeek) ?? [];
      items.push({ start: minutes(entry.startTime), end: minutes(entry.endTime), index });
      byDay.set(entry.dayOfWeek, items);
    });

    for (const items of byDay.values()) {
      const sorted = [...items].sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
      for (let index = 1; index < sorted.length; index += 1) {
        if (sorted[index].start < sorted[index - 1].end) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
            message: 'Jadwal pada hari yang sama tidak boleh saling bertumpuk.',
            path: ['entries', sorted[index].index],
          });
        }
      }
    }
  });

export const therapistTimeOffSchema = z
  .object({
    therapistId: z.string().uuid(),
    startDate: z.string().regex(datePattern, 'Tanggal mulai tidak valid.'),
    endDate: z.string().regex(datePattern, 'Tanggal selesai tidak valid.'),
    reason: z.string().trim().max(300).optional().or(z.literal('')),
  })
  .refine((value) => value.endDate >= value.startDate, {
    message: 'Tanggal selesai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal mulai.',
    path: ['endDate'],
  });

export type TherapistScheduleEntryInput = z.infer<typeof therapistScheduleEntrySchema>;
export type TherapistTimeOffInput = z.infer<typeof therapistTimeOffSchema>;
</file>

'use server';

import { getDb } from '@/db';
import { auditLogs } from '@/db/schema';

type AuditLogInput = {
  action: string;
  targetType?: string;
  targetId?: string;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
  userId?: string;
};

export async function createAuditLog(input: AuditLogInput) {
  try {
    const db = getDb();
    const ipAddress = await getIpAddress();

    await db.insert(auditLogs).values({
      actorUserId: input.userId ?? null,
      action: input.action,
      targetType: input.targetType ?? null,
      targetId: input.targetId ?? null,
      meta: input.meta ?? null,
      ipAddress,
    });
  } catch {
    // Silent fail - audit logging should never break the main flow
  }
}

<file path="lib/featurable.ts">
export type FeaturableReview = {
  authorName: string;
  profilePhotoUrl: string | null;
  rating: number;
  relativeTimeDescription: string;
  text: string;
};

export type FeaturableReviewsData = {
  rating: number;
  userRatingCount: number;
  writeAReviewUri: string | null;
  reviews: FeaturableReview[];
  isLive: boolean;
};

type RawReview = {
  author?: { name?: string; avatarUrl?: string };
  reviewer?: { displayName?: string; profilePhotoUrl?: string };
  author_name?: string;
  profile_photo_url?: string;
  rating?: { value?: number } | number;
  starRating?: number;
  text?: string;
  originalText?: string;
  comment?: string;
  publishedAt?: string;
  createTime?: string;
};

type FeaturableResponse = {
  reviews?: RawReview[];
  widget?: {
    reviews?: RawReview[];
    gbpLocationSummary?: {
      reviewsCount?: number;
      rating?: number;
      writeAReviewUri?: string;
    };
  };
};

const fallbackReviews: FeaturableReview[] = [
  {
    authorName: 'Bpk. H',
    profilePhotoUrl: null,
    rating: 5,
    relativeTimeDescription: 'Ulasan pasien',
    text: 'Setelah beberapa sesi terapi, nyeri punggung saya berangsur membaik. Terapis menjelaskan setiap proses dengan sabar dan mudah dipahami.',
  },
  {
    authorName: 'Kak R',
    profilePhotoUrl: null,
    rating: 5,
    relativeTimeDescription: 'Ulasan pasien',
    text: 'Program rehabilitasi terasa terarah. Saya bisa memantau perkembangan dan kembali beraktivitas dengan lebih percaya diri.',
  },
  {
    authorName: 'Ibu M',
    profilePhotoUrl: null,
    rating: 5,
    relativeTimeDescription: 'Ulasan pasien',
    text: 'Pendampingan selama terapi sangat membantu. Program latihan mudah dipahami dan bisa dilanjutkan dengan nyaman di rumah.',
  },
];

function formatRelativeTime(value?: string): string {
  if (!value) return 'Ulasan Google';
  const date = new Date(value);
  const difference = Date.now() - date.getTime();
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) || difference < 0) return value;

  const minutes = Math.floor(difference / 60_000);
  const hours = Math.floor(difference / 3_600_000);
  const days = Math.floor(difference / 86_400_000);
  const weeks = Math.floor(days / 7);
  const months = Math.floor(days / 30);

  if (minutes < 1) return 'Baru saja';
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes} menit lalu`;
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours} jam lalu`;
  if (days < 7) return `${days} hari lalu`;
  if (weeks < 5) return `${weeks} minggu lalu`;
  if (months < 12) return `${months} bulan lalu`;
  return `${Math.floor(months / 12)} tahun lalu`;
}

function fallbackData(): FeaturableReviewsData {
  return {
    rating: 5,
    userRatingCount: 18,
    writeAReviewUri: 'https://maps.google.com/?cid=12369378807636462729',
    reviews: fallbackReviews,
    isLive: false,
  };
}

function buildFeaturableUrl(rawInput: string): string {
  const trimmed = rawInput.trim();
  if (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://')) {
    return trimmed;
  }
  const cleanId = trimmed.replace(/^widgets\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  return `https://featurable.com/api/v2/widgets/${cleanId}`;
}

export async function getFeaturableReviews(): Promise<FeaturableReviewsData> {
  const widgetId = process.env.FEATURABLE_WIDGET_ID || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURABLE_WIDGET_ID;

  if (!widgetId) return fallbackData();

  try {
    const url = buildFeaturableUrl(widgetId);
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      next: { revalidate: 60 },
    });

    if (!response.ok) return fallbackData();

    const data = (await response.json()) as FeaturableResponse;
    const rawReviews = data?.reviews || data?.widget?.reviews || [];

    const reviews = rawReviews
      .map((review): FeaturableReview | null => {
        const authorName =
          review.author?.name || review.reviewer?.displayName || review.author_name || 'Pasien Hafta';
        const profilePhotoUrl =
          review.author?.avatarUrl || review.reviewer?.profilePhotoUrl || review.profile_photo_url || null;
        const rating =
          typeof review.rating === 'number'
            ? review.rating
            : review.rating?.value ?? review.starRating ?? 5;
        const text = (review.originalText || review.text || review.comment || '').trim();

        if (!text || rating < 4) return null;

        return {
          authorName,
          profilePhotoUrl,
          rating: Math.min(5, Math.max(0, rating)),
          relativeTimeDescription: formatRelativeTime(review.publishedAt || review.createTime),
          text,
        };
      })
      .filter((review): review is FeaturableReview => review !== null);

    const summary = data?.widget?.gbpLocationSummary;
    const overallRating = summary?.rating ?? 5;
    const totalCount = summary?.reviewsCount ?? reviews.length;
    const writeUri = summary?.writeAReviewUri ?? 'https://maps.google.com/?cid=12369378807636462729';

    return reviews.length
      ? {
          rating: overallRating,
          userRatingCount: totalCount,
          writeAReviewUri: writeUri,
          reviews,
          isLive: true,
        }
      : fallbackData();
  } catch {
    return fallbackData();
  }
}

<file path="lib/ip.ts">
import { headers } from 'next/headers';

export async function getIpAddress(): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const headersList = await headers();
    return (
      headersList.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ??
      headersList.get('x-real-ip') ??
      null
    );
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export default async function CalendarPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string }>;
}) {
  const { role } = await requireSession({ redirectToLogin: true });
  const params = await searchParams;
  const now = new Date();
  const year = /^\d{4}$/.test(params.month ?? '') ? Number(params.month) : now.getFullYear();
  const start = `${year - 1}-01-01`;
  const end = `${year + 2}-12-31`;
  const canCreate = role !== 'USER' && hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.APPOINTMENT_CREATE);

    getCalendarAppointmentsRange(start, end),
    canCreate
      ? getAppointmentFormOptions().catch(() => ({ patientOptions: [], therapistOptions: [] }))
      : Promise.resolve({ patientOptions: [], therapistOptions: [] }),

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-[calc(100vh-64px)] flex-col gap-6">

        title="Jadwal Terapi (Calendar View)"
        description="Pantau dan kelola jadwal sesi terapi mingguan secara detail."

        description="Data pasien yang telah diarsipkan oleh terapis."

          { label: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard' },
          { label: 'Pasien', href: '/dashboard/patients' },
          { label: 'Diarsipkan' },
        ]}
        icon={<Archive className="h-6 w-6 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]" />}
      />

      <div>
        <Card className="rounded-2xl border-stone-200/90 shadow-sm overflow-visible">
          <CardHeader className="gap-4">
            <PatientListTabs active="archived" />
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {result.items.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex min-h-48 flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
                <Archive className="h-10 w-10 text-[#92400e]/70" />
                <p className="mt-4 font-semibold text-foreground">Tidak ada pasien diarsipkan</p>
                <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Belum ada data pasien yang diarsipkan.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Menampilkan {(result.currentPage - 1) * 10 + 1}–{Math.min(result.currentPage * 10, result.total)} dari{' '}
                  {result.total} pasien
                </p>
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead className="w-14">No.</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Nama Pasien</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Terdaftar</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Diarsipkan</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {result.items.map((patient, index) => (
                      <TableRow key={patient.id}>
                        <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                          {(result.currentPage - 1) * 10 + index + 1}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{patient.fullName}</span>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <span className="inline-flex rounded-full bg-accent/15 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-[#92400e]">
                            {patient.caseStatus}
                          </span>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-muted-foreground sm:table-cell">
                          {patient.createdAt.toLocaleDateString('id-ID')}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-muted-foreground sm:table-cell">
                          {patient.archivedAt?.toLocaleDateString('id-ID') ?? '-'}
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
                {result.totalPages > 1 ? (
                  <Pagination className="mt-6">
                    <PaginationContent>
                      <PaginationItem>
                        {result.currentPage > 1 ? (
                          <PaginationPrevious href={hrefFor(result.currentPage - 1, search)}>
                            Sebelumnya
                          </PaginationPrevious>
                        ) : null}
                      </PaginationItem>
                      {Array.from({ length: result.totalPages }, (_, index) => index + 1).map((item) => (
                        <PaginationItem key={item}>
                          <PaginationLink href={hrefFor(item, search)} isActive={item === result.currentPage}>
                            {item}
                          </PaginationLink>
                        </PaginationItem>
                      ))}
                      <PaginationItem>
                        {result.currentPage < result.totalPages ? (
                          <PaginationNext href={hrefFor(result.currentPage + 1, search)}>
                            Berikutnya
                          </PaginationNext>
                        ) : null}
                      </PaginationItem>
                    </PaginationContent>
                  </Pagination>
                ) : null}
              </>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

import type { Role } from '@/lib/permissions';

export async function fetchUserRole(): Promise<Role> {

import type { Metadata } from 'next';

import { services } from '@/components/landing/services-data';
import { Check, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';

interface ServiceDetailPageProps {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}

export function generateStaticParams() {
  return services.map((service) => ({ slug: service.id }));
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: ServiceDetailPageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const service = services.find((s) => s.id === slug);

  if (!service) return { title: 'Layanan — Hafta Fisioterapi' };

  return {
    title: `${service.title} — Hafta Fisioterapi`,
    description: service.description,
  };
}

export default async function ServiceDetailPage({ params }: ServiceDetailPageProps) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const service = services.find((s) => s.id === slug);

  if (!service) notFound();

  const related = services.filter((s) => s.id !== service.id).slice(0, 3);

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-white">
      <PublicHeader />

      <main className="flex-1">
        {/* Hero Section Detail Layanan */}

            src={service.backgroundImage}
            alt=""
            fill
            sizes="100vw"
            className="-z-20 object-cover object-[center_20%] lg:object-[center_15%]"
            quality={100}
            priority
          />
          <div
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#181700]/95 via-[#181700]/75 to-[#181700]/40 lg:bg-gradient-to-r lg:from-[#181700]/90 lg:via-[#181700]/65 lg:to-transparent"
          />
          <Container>
            <div className="py-12 md:py-16 lg:py-20">
              <ScrollReveal direction="left" className="max-w-xl">
                <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm">
                  <service.icon className="h-5 w-5" />
                </div>
                <h1 className="mt-5 text-3xl font-bold leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl">
                  {service.title}
                </h1>
                <p className="mt-4 text-base leading-relaxed text-stone-200 sm:text-lg">
                  {service.description}
                </p>

                  href="https://wa.me/6281232932872"

        )}

        {/* Section Kontak */}
        <ContactSection />

import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface AuthAlertProps {
  type: 'error' | 'success';
  message: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function AuthAlert({ type, message, className }: AuthAlertProps) {
  return (
    <div
      role="alert"
      className={cn(
        'flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm',
        type === 'error' && 'border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 text-destructive',
        type === 'success' && 'border-success/30 bg-success/5 text-success',
        className,
      )}
    >
      {type === 'error' ? (
        <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
      ) : (
        <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
      )}
      <p>{message}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="components/dashboard/appointments/new-appointment-button.tsx">
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { AppointmentFormDrawer } from '@/components/dashboard/appointments/appointment-form-drawer';
import { fetchAppointmentFormOptionsAction } from '@/server/actions/appointment-form-options';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

type SelectOption = { id: string; label: string };

type Props = {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  variant?: 'default' | 'outline' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'destructive' | 'link';
  size?: 'default' | 'xs' | 'sm' | 'lg' | 'icon' | 'icon-xs' | 'icon-sm' | 'icon-lg';
  patientOptions?: SelectOption[];
  therapistOptions?: SelectOption[];
  defaultPatientId?: string;
  defaultDate?: string;
  defaultTime?: string;
};

export function NewAppointmentButton({
  children,
  className,
  variant = 'default',
  size = 'default',
  patientOptions: initialPatientOptions,
  therapistOptions: initialTherapistOptions,
  defaultPatientId,
  defaultDate,
  defaultTime,
}: Props) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [patientOptions, setPatientOptions] = useState<SelectOption[]>(initialPatientOptions ?? []);
  const [therapistOptions, setTherapistOptions] = useState<SelectOption[]>(initialTherapistOptions ?? []);

  async function openDrawer() {
    setIsOpen(true);
    if (initialPatientOptions && initialTherapistOptions) return;

    setLoading(true);
    const result = await fetchAppointmentFormOptionsAction(defaultPatientId);
    setLoading(false);

    if (result.ok) {
      setPatientOptions(result.patientOptions);
      setTherapistOptions(result.therapistOptions);
    } else {
      setPatientOptions(result.patientOptions);
      setTherapistOptions(result.therapistOptions);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant={variant}
        size={size}
        onClick={openDrawer}
        className={className}
      >
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">{children}</span>
      </Button>
      <AppointmentFormDrawer
        isOpen={isOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)}
        patientOptions={patientOptions}
        therapistOptions={therapistOptions}
        defaultPatientId={defaultPatientId}
        defaultDate={defaultDate}
        defaultTime={defaultTime}
        loading={loading}
      />
    </>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/dashboard/patients/patient-table-client.tsx">
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { PatientDetailDrawer } from '@/components/dashboard/patients/patient-detail-drawer';
import { PatientTableActions } from '@/components/dashboard/patient-table-actions';
import type { getPatientsList } from '@/server/queries/patients';

type Patient = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getPatientsList>>['items'][number];

export function PatientTableClient({
  items,
  currentPage,
  canArchive,
}: {
  items: Patient[];
  currentPage: number;
  canArchive: boolean;
}) {
  const [selectedPatientId, setSelectedPatientId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [openRowId, setOpenRowId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  return (
    <>
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead className="w-14">No.</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Nama Pasien</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
            <TableHead className="text-right py-2.5 pl-2 pr-1 text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500 w-12">
              Aksi
            </TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {items.map((patient, index) => {
            const rowIndex = index;
            const isOpen = openRowId === patient.id;

            return (
              <TableRow key={patient.id} className={isOpen ? "relative z-30" : "relative z-0"}>
                <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                  {(currentPage - 1) * 10 + index + 1}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSelectedPatientId(patient.id)}
                    className="font-semibold text-foreground hover:text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)] hover:underline"
                  >
                    {patient.fullName}
                  </button>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <span className="inline-flex rounded-full bg-accent/15 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-[#92400e]">
                    {patient.caseStatus}
                  </span>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="py-3 pl-2 pr-1 text-right align-middle w-12">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-end w-full">
                    <PatientTableActions
                      patientId={patient.id}
                      canArchive={canArchive}
                      rowIndex={rowIndex}
                      totalRows={items.length}
                      openRowId={openRowId}
                      setOpenRowId={setOpenRowId}
                    />
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            );
          })}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
      {selectedPatientId && (
        <PatientDetailDrawer
          isOpen={!!selectedPatientId}
          onClose={() => setSelectedPatientId(null)}
          patientId={selectedPatientId}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

<file path="components/dashboard/activity-panel.tsx">
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  UserPlus,
  ClipboardList,
  CalendarDays,
  Activity,
  FileText,
  Settings,
  LogIn,
  LogOut,
  Upload,
  UserCheck,
  ShieldCheck,
  ChevronRight,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { ActivityView } from '@/server/queries/recent-activities';
import type { Role } from '@/lib/permissions/roles';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

function getTimeAgo(date: Date): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
  const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
  const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
  const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);

  if (diffMins < 1) return 'Baru saja';
  if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}m lalu`;
  if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}j lalu`;
  if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}h lalu`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
}

function getActivityIcon(action: string) {
  if (action.includes('login')) return <LogIn className="h-4 w-4" />;
  if (action.includes('logout')) return <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" />;
  if (action.includes('user.create') || action.includes('patient.create')) return <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4" />;
  if (action.includes('intake')) return <ClipboardList className="h-4 w-4" />;
  if (action.includes('appointment')) return <CalendarDays className="h-4 w-4" />;
  if (action.includes('assessment') || action.includes('session') || action.includes('progress')) return <Activity className="h-4 w-4" />;
  if (action.includes('document')) return <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />;
  if (action.includes('upload')) return <Upload className="h-4 w-4" />;
  if (action.includes('settings') || action.includes('role')) return <Settings className="h-4 w-4" />;
  return <Activity className="h-4 w-4" />;
}

function getActivityColor(action: string): string {
  if (action.includes('login') || action.includes('logout')) return 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-600';
  if (action.includes('appointment')) return 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[var(--hafta-ylw-900)]';
  if (action.includes('assessment') || action.includes('intake') || action.includes('progress')) return 'bg-[var(--hafta-grn-50)] text-[var(--hafta-grn-700)]';
  if (action.includes('user') || action.includes('patient')) return 'bg-[var(--hafta-ble-50)] text-[var(--hafta-ble-600)]';
  if (action.includes('delete') || action.includes('cancel')) return 'bg-[var(--hafta-red-50)] text-[var(--hafta-red-600)]';
  return 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-700';
}

export function ActivityPanel({
  activities,
  role = 'SUPER_ADMIN',
}: {
  activities: ActivityView[];
  role?: Role;
}) {
  const isTherapist = role === 'THERAPIST';
  const isAdmin = role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' || role === 'ADMIN';

  // State tab
  const [adminTab, setAdminTab] = useState<'all' | 'clinical' | 'system'>('all');
  const [therapistTab, setTherapistTab] = useState<'all' | 'appointment' | 'progress'>('all');

  // Filter items based on active tab
  const filtered = activities.filter((act) => {
    if (isTherapist) {
      if (therapistTab === 'appointment') return act.action.includes('appointment');
      if (therapistTab === 'progress') return act.action.includes('progress') || act.action.includes('intake') || act.action.includes('assessment');
      return true;
    }

    if (adminTab === 'clinical') {
      return (
        act.action.includes('appointment') ||
        act.action.includes('assessment') ||
        act.action.includes('intake') ||
        act.action.includes('progress') ||
        act.action.includes('patient')
      );
    }
    if (adminTab === 'system') {
      return (
        act.action.includes('user') ||
        act.action.includes('role') ||
        act.action.includes('setting') ||
        act.action.includes('login') ||
        act.action.includes('logout')
      );
    }
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* ── CARD 1: AKTIVITAS TERBARU DENGAN FILTER TAB SESUAI ROLE ── */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header Panel */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-stone-100">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[var(--hafta-ylw-900)]">
                <Activity className="h-4 w-4" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">
                {isTherapist ? 'Aktivitas Terapi' : 'Aktivitas Sistem'}
              </h3>
            </div>

            {/* Link kanan atas diarahkan sesuai role */}
            {isAdmin ? (
              <Link
                href="/dashboard/audit-logs"
                className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500 hover:text-[#181700] transition-colors"
              >
                Lihat Audit &rarr;
              </Link>
            ) : isTherapist ? (
              <Link
                href="/dashboard/progress"
                className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500 hover:text-[#181700] transition-colors"
              >
                Rekam Medis &rarr;
              </Link>
            ) : (
              <Link
                href="/dashboard/appointments"
                className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500 hover:text-[#181700] transition-colors"
              >
                Jadwal &rarr;
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Filter Tabs Dinamis Sesuai Role */}
          {isTherapist ? (
            <div className="mt-3 flex gap-1 rounded-xl bg-stone-100/80 p-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTherapistTab('all')}
                className={cn(
                  'flex-1 rounded-lg py-1 text-center font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer',
                  therapistTab === 'all'
                    ? 'bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs font-bold'
                    : 'text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800'
                )}
              >
                Semua
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTherapistTab('appointment')}
                className={cn(
                  'flex-1 rounded-lg py-1 text-center font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer',
                  therapistTab === 'appointment'
                    ? 'bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs font-bold'
                    : 'text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800'
                )}
              >
                Jadwal
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTherapistTab('progress')}
                className={cn(
                  'flex-1 rounded-lg py-1 text-center font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer',
                  therapistTab === 'progress'
                    ? 'bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs font-bold'
                    : 'text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800'
                )}
              >
                Rekam Medis
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-3 flex gap-1 rounded-xl bg-stone-100/80 p-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTab('all')}
                className={cn(
                  'flex-1 rounded-lg py-1 text-center font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer',
                  adminTab === 'all'
                    ? 'bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs font-bold'
                    : 'text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800'
                )}
              >
                Semua
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTab('clinical')}
                className={cn(
                  'flex-1 rounded-lg py-1 text-center font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer',
                  adminTab === 'clinical'
                    ? 'bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs font-bold'
                    : 'text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800'
                )}
              >
                Klinis
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTab('system')}
                className={cn(
                  'flex-1 rounded-lg py-1 text-center font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer',
                  adminTab === 'system'
                    ? 'bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs font-bold'
                    : 'text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800'
                )}
              >
                Sistem
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* List Aktivitas */}
        <div className="divide-y divide-stone-100 max-h-[360px] overflow-y-auto">
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-8 text-center px-4">
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-400">Tidak ada riwayat aktivitas pada kategori ini.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            filtered.map((activity) => (
              <div key={activity.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3.5 hover:bg-stone-50/70 transition-colors">
                <div className={cn('flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg shadow-2xs', getActivityColor(activity.action))}>
                  {getActivityIcon(activity.action)}
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#181700] leading-snug line-clamp-1">
                    {activity.description}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-stone-500 truncate">
                    Oleh: {activity.actorName || 'Sistem'}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-stone-400 shrink-0">
                  {getTimeAgo(new Date(activity.createdAt))}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── CARD 2: STATUS OPERASIONAL KLINIK HARI INI ── */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-stone-100 pb-3">
          <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-500">
            Operasional Hari Ini
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
            Aktif
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-3 space-y-2.5 text-xs text-stone-600">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <UserCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-900)]" />
              Sesi 1-on-1 Klinik
            </span>
            <span className="font-bold text-[#181700]">Tersedia</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
              Patient Portal Sync
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">Online</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-stone-100">
          <Link
            href="/dashboard/appointments"
            className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-[#181700] hover:text-stone-700 transition-colors"
          >
            <span>Buka Kalender Jadwal</span>
            <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
