type ViewMode = 'list' | 'grid';
type StatusFilter = 'ALL' | 'SCHEDULED' | 'CONFIRMED' | 'CANCELLED';

function toDateKey(date: Date): string {
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function toDayKey(value: string): string {
  return value.slice(0, 10);
}

function addDays(date: Date, days: number): Date {
  const next = new Date(date);
  next.setDate(next.getDate() + days);
  return next;
}

function formatEndTime(startTime: string, durationMinutes: number): string {
  const [hours, minutes] = startTime.split(':').map(Number);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hours) || !Number.isFinite(minutes)) return startTime;
  const total = hours * 60 + minutes + durationMinutes;
  const endHours = Math.floor((total % (24 * 60)) / 60);
  const endMinutes = total % 60;
  return `${String(endHours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(endMinutes).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function formatLongDate(dateKey: string): string {
  const [year, month, day] = dateKey.split('-').map(Number);
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
    weekday: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

function formatStripMonthLabel(dates: Date[]): string {
  if (dates.length === 0) return '';
  const first = dates[0];
  const last = dates[dates.length - 1];

  if (first.getFullYear() === last.getFullYear()) {
    if (first.getMonth() === last.getMonth()) {
      return `${MONTH_NAMES[first.getMonth()]} ${first.getFullYear()}`;
    }
    return `${MONTH_NAMES[first.getMonth()]} – ${MONTH_NAMES[last.getMonth()]} ${last.getFullYear()}`;
  }

  return `${MONTH_NAMES[first.getMonth()]} ${first.getFullYear()} – ${MONTH_NAMES[last.getMonth()]} ${last.getFullYear()}`;
}

function getStatusMeta(status: string) {
  if (status === 'SCHEDULED' || status === 'CONFIRMED') {
    return {
      label: status === 'CONFIRMED' ? 'Dikonfirmasi' : 'Terjadwal',
      accent: 'bg-[var(--hafta-grn-500)]',
      badge: 'bg-[var(--hafta-grn-50)] text-[var(--hafta-grn-600)]',
      icon: Check,
    };
  }
  if (status === 'RESCHEDULED') {
    return {
      label: 'Perubahan Jadwal',
      accent: 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)]',
      badge: 'border border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[#181700]',
      icon: Clock,
    };
  }
  if (status === 'CANCELLED' || status === 'NO_SHOW') {
    return {
      label: status === 'NO_SHOW' ? 'Tidak Hadir' : 'Dibatalkan',
      accent: 'bg-[var(--hafta-red-500)]',
      badge: 'bg-[var(--hafta-red-50)] text-[var(--hafta-red-600)]',
      icon: X,
    };
  }
  return {
    label: 'Selesai',
    accent: 'bg-stone-300',
    badge: 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-600',
    icon: Check,
  };
}

export function TherapistScheduleCalendar({
  appointments,
  canCreate = false,
  canComplete = false,
  holidays = [],
}: {
  appointments: ScheduleAppointment[];
  canCreate?: boolean;
  canComplete?: boolean;
  holidays?: { date: string; name: string }[];
}) {
  const today = useMemo(() => {
    const now = new Date();
    return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  }, []);
  const todayKey = toDateKey(today);

  const sessionsByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const appointment of appointments) {
      const dayKey = toDayKey(appointment.scheduledDate);
      map.set(dayKey, (map.get(dayKey) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
    return map;
  }, [appointments]);

  const holidayDateSet = useMemo(() => new Set(holidays.map((holiday) => holiday.date)), [holidays]);
  const holidayNameByDate = useMemo(
    () => new Map(holidays.map((holiday) => [holiday.date, holiday.name])),
    [holidays]
  );

  const initialSelectedDate = useMemo(() => {
    if (sessionsByDate.has(todayKey)) return todayKey;
    const nextAppointment = appointments.find(
      (appointment) => toDayKey(appointment.scheduledDate) >= todayKey
    );
    return nextAppointment ? toDayKey(nextAppointment.scheduledDate) : null;
  }, [appointments, sessionsByDate, todayKey]);

  const [stripStart, setStripStart] = useState<Date>(() => {
    if (!initialSelectedDate) return today;
    const [year, month, day] = initialSelectedDate.split('-').map(Number);
    return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
  });
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState<string | null>(initialSelectedDate);
  const [view, setView] = useState<ViewMode>('list');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<StatusFilter>('ALL');
  const [filterOpen, setFilterOpen] = useState(false);
  const [menuOpenId, setMenuOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [detailAppointment, setDetailAppointment] = useState<ScheduleAppointment | null>(null);
  const appointmentEditor = useAppointmentEditDrawer();
  const [evaluationAppointment, setEvaluationAppointment] = useState<ScheduleAppointment | null>(null);
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(5);

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateVisibleCount = () => {
      const width = window.innerWidth;
      setVisibleCount(width >= 1280 ? 14 : width >= 1024 ? 10 : width >= 640 ? 7 : 5);
    };
    const frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(updateVisibleCount);

    window.addEventListener('resize', updateVisibleCount);
    return () => {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', updateVisibleCount);
    };
  }, []);

  const stripDates = useMemo(
    () => Array.from({ length: visibleCount }, (_, index) => addDays(stripStart, index)),
    [stripStart, visibleCount]
  );

  const monthRangeLabel = useMemo(() => formatStripMonthLabel(stripDates), [stripDates]);

  const filteredAppointments = useMemo(() => {
    return appointments.filter((appointment) => {
      if (selectedDate && toDayKey(appointment.scheduledDate) !== selectedDate) return false;
      if (statusFilter === 'ALL') return true;
      if (statusFilter === 'CANCELLED') {
        return appointment.status === 'CANCELLED' || appointment.status === 'NO_SHOW';
      }
      return appointment.status === statusFilter;
    });
  }, [appointments, selectedDate, statusFilter]);

  const statusOptions: { value: StatusFilter; label: string }[] = [
    { value: 'ALL', label: 'Semua Status' },
    { value: 'SCHEDULED', label: 'Terjadwal' },
    { value: 'CONFIRMED', label: 'Dikonfirmasi' },
    { value: 'CANCELLED', label: 'Dibatalkan' },
  ];

  return (
    <section className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200/80 bg-white p-5 shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(24,23,0,0.03)] sm:p-7">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-start lg:justify-between">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700]">
            <CalendarDays className="h-5 w-5" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700] sm:text-lg">
              Jadwal Terapi Mendatang
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500 sm:text-sm">
              {monthRangeLabel}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 lg:w-auto lg:justify-end">
          {selectedDate && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelectedDate(null)}
              className="cursor-pointer rounded-full border border-stone-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[#181700] transition-colors hover:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]"
            >
              Reset ke Semua Jadwal
            </button>
          )}

          <div className="relative">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterOpen((open) => !open)}
              className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-stone-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-stone-600 transition-colors hover:bg-stone-50"
            >
              <Filter className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Filter
            </button>
            {filterOpen && (
              <>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label="Tutup filter"
                  className="fixed inset-0 z-10 cursor-default"
                  onClick={() => setFilterOpen(false)}
                />
                <div className="absolute right-0 z-10 mt-2 w-40 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-1.5 shadow-lg">
                  {statusOptions.map((option) => (
                    <button
                      key={option.value}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setStatusFilter(option.value);
                        setFilterOpen(false);
                      }}
                      className={cn(
                        'flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium transition-colors',
                        statusFilter === option.value
                          ? 'bg-stone-100 text-[#181700]'
                          : 'text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-50'
                      )}
                    >
                      {option.label}
                      {statusFilter === option.value && <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center rounded-full bg-stone-100 p-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Tampilan daftar"
              onClick={() => setView('list')}
              className={cn(
                'flex h-7 w-7 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-colors',
                view === 'list' ? 'bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-sm' : 'text-stone-500'
              )}
            >
              <List className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Tampilan grid"
              onClick={() => setView('grid')}
              className={cn(
                'flex h-7 w-7 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-colors',
                view === 'grid' ? 'bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-sm' : 'text-stone-500'
              )}
            >
              <LayoutGrid className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {canCreate && (
            <NewAppointmentButton className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#181700] transition-all hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)]">
              <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Buat Jadwal
            </NewAppointmentButton>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Date strip */}
      <div className="my-6 flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 sm:gap-4">
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={`${visibleCount} hari sebelumnya`}
          onClick={() => setStripStart((date) => addDays(date, -visibleCount))}
          className="flex h-10 w-10 aspect-square shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-stone-200/90 bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs transition-all hover:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>

        <div className="grid flex-1 grid-cols-5 items-center justify-items-center gap-1.5 sm:grid-cols-7 sm:gap-2 lg:grid-cols-10 xl:grid-cols-14">
          {stripDates.map((date) => {
            const dateKey = toDateKey(date);
            const isSelected = selectedDate === dateKey;
            const isFirstOfMonth = date.getDate() === 1;
            const isHoliday = date.getDay() === 0 || holidayDateSet.has(dateKey);
            const count = sessionsByDate.get(dateKey) ?? 0;
            const holidayName = holidayNameByDate.get(dateKey);
            const sessionLabel = count === 1 ? '1 sesi' : `${count} sesi`;

            return (
              <div key={dateKey} className="flex min-w-0 flex-col items-center">
                <span
                  aria-hidden={!isFirstOfMonth}
                  className={cn(
                    'flex h-3 items-center rounded-full px-1 text-[8px] font-bold leading-none',
                    isFirstOfMonth ? 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-500' : 'text-transparent'
                  )}
                >
                  {isFirstOfMonth ? MONTH_SHORT[date.getMonth()] : '•'}
                </span>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  title={
                    [holidayName, count > 0 ? sessionLabel : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') ||
                    undefined
                  }
                  aria-label={`${formatLongDate(dateKey)}${holidayName ? `, ${holidayName}` : ''}${
                    count > 0 ? `, ${sessionLabel}` : ''
                  }`}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedDate(dateKey)}
                  className={cn(
                    'relative mt-1 flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 cursor-pointer select-none items-center justify-center rounded-full p-0 text-sm font-bold leading-none aspect-square transition-all duration-200 sm:h-11 sm:w-11',
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-[#181700] font-bold text-white shadow-md'
                      : isHoliday
                        ? 'border border-[var(--hafta-red-100)] bg-[var(--hafta-red-50)]/70 text-[var(--hafta-red-600)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-red-100)]/80'
                        : count > 0
                          ? 'border-2 border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] font-extrabold text-[#181700] shadow-2xs hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]'
                          : 'bg-stone-50 text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100'
                  )}
                >
                  {date.getDate()}
                  {count > 0 && (
                    <span
                      className={cn(
                        'pointer-events-none absolute bottom-1.5 left-1/2 h-1.5 w-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full',
                        isSelected ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]' : 'bg-[#181700]'
                      )}
                    />
                  )}
                  {count > 1 && (
                    <span className="absolute -right-1 -top-1 flex h-3.5 min-w-3.5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#181700] px-1 text-[8px] font-bold leading-none text-white">
                      {count}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>

                <span
                  className={cn(
                    'mt-1 text-[10px] font-semibold',
                    isSelected
                      ? 'font-bold text-[#181700]'
                      : isHoliday
                        ? 'font-bold text-[var(--hafta-red-500)]'
                        : 'text-stone-400'
                  )}
                >
                  {DAY_LABELS[date.getDay()]}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={`${visibleCount} hari berikutnya`}
          onClick={() => setStripStart((date) => addDays(date, visibleCount))}
          className="flex h-10 w-10 aspect-square shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-stone-200/90 bg-white text-[#181700] shadow-2xs transition-all hover:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]"
        >
          <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Appointment list */}
      {filteredAppointments.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-stone-200 bg-stone-50/60 px-5 py-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#181700]">
            {selectedDate ? 'Belum ada jadwal pada tanggal ini' : 'Belum ada jadwal terapi mendatang'}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-stone-500">
            {selectedDate ? formatLongDate(selectedDate) : 'Belum ada jadwal mendatang yang tercatat.'}
          </p>
          {selectedDate && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelectedDate(null)}
              className="mt-3 cursor-pointer rounded-full bg-stone-100 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[#181700] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]"
            >
              Reset ke Semua Jadwal
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div
          className={cn(
            'mt-5',
            view === 'grid' ? 'grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2' : 'space-y-3'
          )}
        >
          {filteredAppointments.map((appointment) => {
            const statusMeta = getStatusMeta(appointment.status);
            const StatusIcon = statusMeta.icon;
            const typeLabel = TYPE_LABELS[appointment.type] ?? appointment.type;
            const endTime = formatEndTime(appointment.startTime, appointment.durationMinutes);
            const phone = appointment.patientPhone?.replace(/\D/g, '');

            return (
              <div
                key={appointment.id}
                className="relative rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/60 bg-[#F8F8F6] p-4 transition-all hover:bg-[#F3F3EE] sm:px-6 sm:py-4"
              >
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    'absolute bottom-3 left-0 top-3 w-1.5 rounded-full',
                    statusMeta.accent
                  )}
                />

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 pl-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-4">
                    <div className="shrink-0 border-r border-stone-200/80 pr-4 sm:pr-6">
                      <p className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700] sm:text-lg">
                        {appointment.startTime}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-400">{endTime}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-[#181700] sm:text-base">
                        {appointment.patientName}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-stone-500">{typeLabel}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 sm:justify-end">
                    <span
                      className={cn(
                        'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold',
                        statusMeta.badge
                      )}
                    >
                      <StatusIcon className="h-3 w-3" />
                      {statusMeta.label}
                    </span>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {phone ? (
                        <a
                          href={`https://wa.me/${phone}`}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noopener noreferrer"
                          aria-label={`Hubungi ${appointment.patientName}`}
                          className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#181700] text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:text-[#181700]"
                        >
                          <Phone className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </a>
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setDetailAppointment(appointment)}
                          aria-label={`Lihat kontak ${appointment.patientName}`}
                          className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#181700] text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:text-[#181700]"
                        >
                          <Phone className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </button>
                      )}

                      <div className="relative">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          aria-label="Menu opsi jadwal"
                          onClick={() =>
                            setMenuOpenId((current) =>
                              current === appointment.id ? null : appointment.id
                            )
                          }
                          className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-stone-200/80 bg-white text-[#181700] transition-colors hover:bg-stone-100"
                        >
                          <MoreVertical className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </button>

                        {menuOpenId === appointment.id && (
                          <>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              aria-label="Tutup menu"
                              className="fixed inset-0 z-10 cursor-default"
                              onClick={() => setMenuOpenId(null)}
                            />
                            <div className="absolute bottom-full right-0 z-10 mb-2 w-56 origin-bottom-right rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-2 shadow-xl">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setMenuOpenId(null);
                                  setDetailAppointment(appointment);
                                }}
                                className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-stone-700 transition-colors hover:bg-stone-50"
                              >
                                <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-2 shrink-0" />
                                Lihat Detail
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setMenuOpenId(null);
                                  setEvaluationAppointment(appointment);
                                }}
                                className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-stone-700 transition-colors hover:bg-stone-50"
                              >
                                <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-2 shrink-0" />
                                Evaluasi RM
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setMenuOpenId(null);
                                  appointmentEditor.openEdit(appointment.id);
                                }}
                                className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-stone-700 transition-colors hover:bg-stone-50"
                              >
                                <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-2 shrink-0" />
                                Ubah Jadwal Terapi
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <GlobalSlideOver
        isOpen={detailAppointment !== null}
        onClose={() => setDetailAppointment(null)}
        title="Detail Jadwal"
        subtitle={detailAppointment?.patientName}
        icon={<CalendarDays className="h-5 w-5" />}
        size="md"
            footer={
          detailAppointment ? (
            <div className="shrink-0 bg-[#FEFEF6] py-4 flex flex-col gap-2.5 w-full">
              {/* Baris 1: Aksi utama (full width) */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setDetailAppointment(null);
                  setEvaluationAppointment(detailAppointment);
                }}
                className="w-full h-11 px-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] font-bold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
              >
                <FileText className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                Mulai Evaluasi Rekam Medis
              </button>
              {/* Baris 2: Aksi pendukung (2 kolom simetris) */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 w-full">
                {canComplete &&
                (detailAppointment.status === 'SCHEDULED' ||
                  detailAppointment.status === 'CONFIRMED') ? (
                  <CompleteSessionButton
                    appointmentId={detailAppointment.id}
                    className="w-full h-10 px-4 rounded-full bg-white hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] hover:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] border border-stone-200/90 font-semibold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                  />
                ) : null}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    appointmentEditor.openEdit(detailAppointment.id);
                    setDetailAppointment(null);
                  }}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-4 rounded-full bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] border border-stone-200/90 font-semibold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                >
                  <Pencil className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  Ubah Jadwal
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : undefined
        }
      >
        {detailAppointment ? (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">
                Pasien
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">
                {detailAppointment.patientName}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">
                  Tanggal
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-medium text-[#181700]">
                  {formatLongDate(toDayKey(detailAppointment.scheduledDate))}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">
                  Waktu
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-medium text-[#181700]">
                  {detailAppointment.startTime} -{' '}
                  {formatEndTime(detailAppointment.startTime, detailAppointment.durationMinutes)}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">
                  Layanan
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-medium text-[#181700]">
                  {TYPE_LABELS[detailAppointment.type] ?? detailAppointment.type}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">
                  Durasi
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-medium text-[#181700]">
                  {detailAppointment.durationMinutes} menit
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>
        ) : null}
      </GlobalSlideOver>

      <AppointmentEditDrawer
        isOpen={appointmentEditor.isOpen}
        isLoading={appointmentEditor.isLoading}
        data={appointmentEditor.data}
        onClose={appointmentEditor.closeEdit}
      />

      <MedicalRecordFormDrawer
        isOpen={evaluationAppointment !== null}
        onClose={() => setEvaluationAppointment(null)}
        defaultPatientId={evaluationAppointment?.patientId}
        defaultAppointmentId={evaluationAppointment?.id}
        patientOptions={
          evaluationAppointment
            ? [{ id: evaluationAppointment.patientId, label: evaluationAppointment.patientName }]
            : []
        }
      />
    </section>
  );
}

<file path="components/dashboard/appointment-calendar.tsx">
'use client';

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { CalendarDays, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Clock3, UserRound } from 'lucide-react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { markCalendarAppointmentsRead } from '@/server/actions/appointment-notifications';
import type { CalendarAppointment } from '@/server/queries/appointment-calendar';
import type { IndonesianHoliday } from '@/server/queries/indonesian-holidays';
import type { InternalCalendarEvent } from '@/server/queries/internal-calendar-events';

const monthFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('id-ID', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
const weekdayLabels = ['Min', 'Sen', 'Sel', 'Rab', 'Kam', 'Jum', 'Sab'];
const typeLabel: Record<string, string> = {
  INITIAL_ASSESSMENT: 'Assessment Awal',
  THERAPY_SESSION: 'Sesi Terapi',
  FOLLOW_UP: 'Tindak Lanjut',
  EVALUATION: 'Evaluasi',
};

function monthKey(date: Date) {
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
function dateKey(date: Date) {
  return `${monthKey(date)}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
function appointmentDateKey(value: string) {
  return value.slice(0, 10);
}

export function AppointmentCalendar({
  appointments,
  initialMonth,
  holidays,
  internalEvents,
}: {
  appointments: CalendarAppointment[];
  initialMonth: string;
  holidays: IndonesianHoliday[];
  internalEvents: InternalCalendarEvent[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(() => {
    const [year, currentMonth] = initialMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    return new Date(year, currentMonth - 1, 1);
  });
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const unreadIds = useMemo(
    () => appointments.filter((appointment) => appointment.isNew).map((appointment) => appointment.id),
    [appointments],
  );
  const eventsByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, CalendarAppointment[]>();
    appointments.forEach((appointment) => {
      const key = appointmentDateKey(appointment.scheduledDate);
      map.set(key, [...(map.get(key) ?? []), appointment]);
    });
    return map;
  }, [appointments]);
  const holidaysByDate = useMemo(() => new Map(holidays.map((holiday) => [holiday.date, holiday])), [holidays]);
  const internalEventsByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, InternalCalendarEvent[]>();
    internalEvents.forEach((event) => {
      const key = appointmentDateKey(event.scheduledDate);
      map.set(key, [...(map.get(key) ?? []), event]);
    });
    return map;
  }, [internalEvents]);
  const selectedAppointments = selectedDate ? (eventsByDate.get(selectedDate) ?? []) : [];
  const selectedInternalEvents = selectedDate ? (internalEventsByDate.get(selectedDate) ?? []) : [];
  const days = useMemo(() => {
    const firstDay = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth(), 1);
    const lastDay = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth() + 1, 0);
    return Array.from({ length: firstDay.getDay() + lastDay.getDate() }, (_, index) =>
      index < firstDay.getDay() ? null : new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth(), index - firstDay.getDay() + 1),
    );
  }, [month]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (unreadIds.length === 0) return;
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(async () => {
      await markCalendarAppointmentsRead(unreadIds);
      router.refresh();
    }, 2500);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [router, unreadIds]);
  function changeMonth(offset: number) {
    const next = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth() + offset, 1);
    setMonth(next);
    setSelectedDate(null);
    router.push(`/dashboard?month=${monthKey(next)}`);
  }

  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#E8ECEB] bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-[#E8ECEB] pb-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-hafta-ylw-50">
            <CalendarDays className="h-4 w-4 text-hafta-ylw-700" strokeWidth={2.25} />
          </span>
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-semibold text-[#111827]">Kalender Terapi</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#6B7280]">Pilih tanggal untuk melihat jadwal.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 rounded-xl border border-[#E8ECEB] bg-[#F9FAFB] p-1">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Bulan sebelumnya" onClick={() => changeMonth(-1)}>
            <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
          <p className="min-w-32 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-[#111827]">{monthFormatter.format(month)}</p>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Bulan berikutnya" onClick={() => changeMonth(1)}>
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.35fr)_minmax(15rem,.65fr)]">
        <div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 text-center text-[10px] font-semibold text-[#9CA3AF]">
            {weekdayLabels.map((label, index) => (
              <span key={label} className={cn('py-1', index === 0 && 'text-hafta-red-500 font-bold')}>
                {label}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
            {days.map((day, index) => {
              if (!day)
                return <span key={`empty-${index}`} className="min-h-10 rounded-xl bg-[#F9FAFB] sm:min-h-12" />;
              const key = dateKey(day);
              const holiday = holidaysByDate.get(key);
              const isSunday = day.getDay() === 0;
              const isRedDay = isSunday || Boolean(holiday);
              const dayAppointments = eventsByDate.get(key) ?? [];
              const dayInternalEvents = internalEventsByDate.get(key) ?? [];
              const hasNew = dayAppointments.some((appointment) => appointment.isNew);
              const isSelected = selectedDate === key;
              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  key={key}
                  title={holiday?.name ?? (isSunday ? 'Minggu' : undefined)}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedDate(key)}
                  className={cn(
                    'relative flex min-h-12 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl p-1 text-center transition-all duration-150 sm:min-h-14',
                     isSelected
                       ? 'bg-hafta-ylw-200 text-hafta-ylw-900 shadow-md'
                       : dayAppointments.length
                         ? 'bg-hafta-ylw-50 text-hafta-ylw-900 ring-1 ring-hafta-ylw-100 hover:bg-hafta-ylw-100'
                         : 'hover:bg-[#F9FAFB]',
                  )}
                >
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                       'text-[13px] font-semibold leading-none',
                       !isSelected && isRedDay ? 'text-hafta-red-600' : 'text-[#111827]',
                       isSelected && 'text-hafta-ylw-900'
                    )}
                  >
                    {day.getDate()}
                  </span>
                  
                  {/* Indicator Dot untuk janji temu */}
                  {dayAppointments.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className="mt-1 flex gap-0.5">
                      {dayAppointments.slice(0, 3).map((_, i) => (
                        <span
                          key={i}
                          className={cn(
                            'h-1 w-1 rounded-full',
                            isSelected ? 'bg-hafta-ylw-900' : 'bg-hafta-ylw-600'
                          )}
                        />
                      ))}
                      {dayAppointments.length > 3 && (
                        <span className={cn('text-[7px] leading-[4px] font-bold', isSelected ? 'text-hafta-ylw-900' : 'text-hafta-ylw-600')}>+</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="mt-1 h-1 w-1" /> /* Spacer agar angka tetap seimbang di tengah */
                  )}

                  {/* Indicator Dot untuk internal events */}
                  {dayInternalEvents.length > 0 ? (
                    <span
                      className={cn(
                        'absolute right-2 top-2 h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-hafta-ylw-400',
                        isSelected && 'bg-hafta-ylw-800'
                      )}
                      title={dayInternalEvents.map((event) => event.title).join(', ')}
                    />
                  ) : null}
                  {hasNew ? (
                    <motion.span
                      initial={{ scale: 0.8, opacity: 0 }}
                      animate={{ scale: [1, 1.08, 1], opacity: 1 }}
                      transition={{ duration: 0.5, repeat: Infinity, repeatDelay: 1.8 }}
                      className="absolute left-2 top-2 h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-hafta-ble-500"
                    />
                  ) : null}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-[#F9FAFB] p-3">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#111827]">
            {selectedDate
              ? new Date(`${selectedDate}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
                  weekday: 'long',
                  day: 'numeric',
                  month: 'long',
                })
              : 'Pilih tanggal'}
          </p>
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            {selectedDate ? (
              <motion.div
                key={selectedDate}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }}
                className="mt-3 space-y-2"
              >
                {selectedInternalEvents.map((event) => (
                  <div key={event.id} className="rounded-xl border border-hafta-ylw-100 bg-hafta-ylw-50 p-4 shadow-sm">
                    <p className="text-sm font-bold text-hafta-ylw-900">{event.title}</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-hafta-ylw-700">
                      {event.startTime ?? 'Seharian'} · {event.eventType.replaceAll('_', ' ')}
                    </p>
                    {event.description ? (
                      <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-hafta-ylw-800">{event.description}</p>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                ))}
                {selectedAppointments.length === 0 && selectedInternalEvents.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-sm text-[#6B7280] text-center mt-6">Tidak ada jadwal pada tanggal ini.</p>
                ) : (
                  selectedAppointments.map((appointment) => (
                    <motion.div
                      key={appointment.id}
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -6 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                      className="rounded-xl border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white p-4 shadow-sm"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5">
                        <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#F1F5F9] text-[#64748B]">
                          {appointment.therapistImage ? (
                            <Image
                              src={appointment.therapistImage}
                              alt={appointment.therapistName ?? 'Terapis'}
                              width={44}
                              height={44}
                              className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                              unoptimized
                            />
                          ) : (
                            <UserRound className="h-5 w-5" strokeWidth={2} />
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <p className="text-[13px] font-bold text-[#111827] truncate">{typeLabel[appointment.type] ?? appointment.type}</p>
                              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-[#6B7280] truncate">Dengan {appointment.therapistName ?? 'Terapis Hafta'}</p>
                            </div>
                            {appointment.isNew ? (
                              <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-hafta-ble-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-hafta-ble-600">Baru</span>
                            ) : null}
                          </div>
                          
                          <div className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#64748B]">
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Clock3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-hafta-ylw-600" strokeWidth={2.25} />
                              {appointment.startTime}
                            </span>
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                              <span className="h-1 w-1 rounded-full bg-[#D1D5DB]" />
                              {appointment.durationMinutes} menit
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#9CA3AF]">Status: {appointment.status.replaceAll('_', ' ')}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </motion.div>
                  ))
                )}
              </motion.div>
            ) : (
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#6B7280]">
                Jadwal terapi pada tanggal yang dipilih akan tampil di sini.
              </p>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

<file path="components/dashboard/change-password-form.tsx">
'use client';

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { KeyRound, Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { authClient } from '@/lib/auth/client';
import { notifyPasswordChanged } from '@/server/actions/security';

export function ChangePasswordForm() {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [showCurrent, setShowCurrent] = useState(false);
  const [showNew, setShowNew] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(false);

  function submit(event: React.FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (newPassword.length < 8) {
      toast.error('Kata sandi baru minimal 8 karakter.');
      return;
    }
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      toast.error('Konfirmasi kata sandi tidak cocok.');
      return;
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const result = await authClient.changePassword({
          currentPassword,
          newPassword,
          revokeOtherSessions: true,
        });
        if (result.error) {
          toast.error(result.error.message ?? 'Gagal mengubah kata sandi.');
          return;
        }
        await notifyPasswordChanged();
        toast.success('Kata sandi berhasil diubah.');
        setCurrentPassword('');
        setNewPassword('');
        setConfirmPassword('');
      } catch {
        toast.error('Kata sandi tidak dapat diubah saat ini. Coba lagi nanti.');
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4" data-testid="change-password-form">
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">Kata sandi saat ini</span>
        <div className="relative">
          <input
            type={showCurrent ? 'text' : 'password'}
            autoComplete="current-password"
            value={currentPassword}
            onChange={(e) => setCurrentPassword(e.target.value)}
            disabled={pending}
            required
            className="flex h-10 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:border-accent focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-input/50 disabled:opacity-50 pr-10"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowCurrent(!showCurrent)}
            className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors"
            tabIndex={-1}
          >
            {showCurrent ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">Kata sandi baru</span>
        <div className="relative">
          <input
            type={showNew ? 'text' : 'password'}
            autoComplete="new-password"
            value={newPassword}
            onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
            disabled={pending}
            required
            className="flex h-10 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:border-accent focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-input/50 disabled:opacity-50 pr-10"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowNew(!showNew)}
            className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors"
            tabIndex={-1}
          >
            {showNew ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">Konfirmasi kata sandi baru</span>
        <div className="relative">
          <input
            type={showConfirm ? 'text' : 'password'}
            autoComplete="new-password"
            value={confirmPassword}
            onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
            disabled={pending}
            required
            className="flex h-10 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:border-accent focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-input/50 disabled:opacity-50 pr-10"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowConfirm(!showConfirm)}
            className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors"
            tabIndex={-1}
          >
            {showConfirm ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
        <KeyRound className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        {pending ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Ubah Kata Sandi'}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/dashboard/create-patient-form.tsx">
'use client';

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { GlobalSlideOver } from '@/components/ui/global-slide-over';
import { Loader2, UserPlus, ArrowLeft, Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Select } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { createPatientFromUser } from '@/server/actions/patients';
import { createUser } from '@/server/actions/create-user';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type UserOption = { id: string; name: string | null; email: string };

type Mode = 'pick-user' | 'create-user';

export function CreatePatientForm({
  userOptions,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSaved,
}: {
  userOptions: UserOption[];
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved?: () => void;
}) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>('pick-user');
  const [createPending, setCreatePending] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  const [pendingSubmit, setPendingSubmit] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newEmail, setNewEmail] = useState('');
  const [newPhone, setNewPhone] = useState('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [nameError, setNameError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [emailError, setEmailError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  function clearErrors() {
    setError(null);
    setNameError(null);
    setEmailError(null);
    setPasswordError(null);
  }

  function validateCreateUser(): boolean {
    let valid = true;
    if (!newName.trim()) {
      setNameError('Nama lengkap wajib diisi.');
      valid = false;
    } else {
      setNameError(null);
    }
    if (!newEmail.trim()) {
      setEmailError('Email wajib diisi.');
      valid = false;
    } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(newEmail)) {
      setEmailError('Format email tidak valid.');
      valid = false;
    } else {
      setEmailError(null);
    }
    if (!newPassword.trim()) {
      setPasswordError('Kata sandi wajib diisi.');
      valid = false;
    } else if (newPassword.length < 12) {
      setPasswordError('Kata sandi minimal 12 karakter.');
      valid = false;
    } else {
      setPasswordError(null);
    }
    return valid;
  }

  function submit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const userId = String(new FormData(event.currentTarget).get('userId') ?? '');
    setError(null);
    setPendingSubmit(true);
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await createPatientFromUser(userId);
        router.refresh();
        onSaved?.();
        onClose();
      } catch {
        setError('Pasien tidak dapat ditambahkan. Pilih akun USER yang belum terhubung.');
      } finally {
        setPendingSubmit(false);
      }
    });
  }

  async function handleCreateUser() {
    clearErrors();
    if (!validateCreateUser()) return;
    setCreatePending(true);
    try {
      const result = await createUser({
        name: newName,
        email: newEmail,
        phone: newPhone || undefined,
        password: newPassword,
        role: 'USER',
      });
      if (result.ok) {
        router.refresh();
        onSaved?.();
        onClose();
      } else {
        setError(result.error || 'Gagal membuat akun pasien.');
      }
    } catch {
      setError('Gagal membuat akun pasien.');
    } finally {
      setCreatePending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <GlobalSlideOver
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      size="lg"
      icon={<UserPlus className="h-5 w-5" />}
      title="Daftarkan Pasien"
      subtitle={mode === 'create-user' ? 'Buat akun USER baru untuk pasien yang belum memilikinya.' : 'Pilih akun USER yang belum terhubung agar dibuatkan record pasien.'}
      footer={
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 w-full">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {mode === 'create-user' ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setMode('pick-user')}
                className="h-10 sm:h-11 px-5 rounded-full bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] border border-stone-200/90 font-semibold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                Kembali
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={createPending}
                onClick={() => setMode('create-user')}
                className="h-10 sm:h-11 px-5 rounded-full bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] border border-stone-200/90 font-semibold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                {createPending ? <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <UserPlus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />}
                Buat baru
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {mode === 'create-user' ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={createPending || !newName.trim() || !newEmail.trim() || !newPassword.trim()}
                onClick={handleCreateUser}
                className="h-10 sm:h-11 px-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] font-bold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                {createPending ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4" />}
                Simpan & Daftarkan
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="submit"
                form="create-patient-form"
                disabled={pendingSubmit || pending || userOptions.length === 0}
                className="h-10 sm:h-11 px-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] font-bold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
              >
                {pendingSubmit || pending ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4" />}
                Simpan & Daftarkan
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={mode === 'create-user' ? createPending : false}
              onClick={onClose}
              className="h-10 sm:h-11 px-5 rounded-full bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] border border-stone-200/90 font-semibold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              Batal
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <form id="create-patient-form" onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
        {error ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}
        {mode === 'pick-user' ? (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="userId">Akun pasien</Label>
            <Select id="userId" name="userId" required disabled={pending || userOptions.length === 0}>
              <option value="">Pilih akun pasien</option>
              {userOptions.map((user) => (
                <option key={user.id} value={user.id}>
                  {user.name || 'Tanpa nama'} · {user.email}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
            {userOptions.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-stone-500">
                Belum ada akun USER yang tersedia. Klik tombol <strong>Buat akun baru</strong> di bawah untuk membuat akun pasien baru dari nol.
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="create-name">Nama lengkap pasien</Label>
              <Input
                id="create-name"
                value={newName}
                onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Masukkan nama lengkap pasien"
                className={cn(
                  'text-xs sm:text-sm border rounded-lg p-2',
                  nameError ? 'border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500' : 'border-stone-200 focus:border-stone-400'
                )}
              />
              {nameError && <p className="text-[11px] text-red-600">{nameError}</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="create-email">Email</Label>
              <Input
                id="create-email"
                type="email"
                value={newEmail}
                onChange={(e) => setNewEmail(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="masukkan@email.com"
                className={cn(
                  'text-xs sm:text-sm border rounded-lg p-2',
                  emailError ? 'border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500' : 'border-stone-200 focus:border-stone-400'
                )}
              />
              {emailError && <p className="text-[11px] text-red-600">{emailError}</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="create-phone">Nomor telepon (opsional)</Label>
              <Input
                id="create-phone"
                type="tel"
                value={newPhone}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const digits = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
                  setNewPhone(digits.slice(0, 12));
                }}
                placeholder="08123456789"
                className="text-xs sm:text-sm border rounded-lg p-2 border-stone-200 focus:border-stone-400"
                maxLength={12}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="create-password">Kata sandi (minimal 12 karakter)</Label>
              <div className="relative flex items-center">
                <Input
                  id="create-password"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  value={newPassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••••••"
                  className={cn(
                    'text-xs sm:text-sm border rounded-lg p-2 pr-10',
                    passwordError ? 'border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500' : 'border-stone-200 focus:border-stone-400'
                  )}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                  className="absolute inset-y-0 right-2 my-auto p-1 text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-600 transition-colors"
                  aria-label={showPassword ? 'Sembunyikan kata sandi' : 'Tampilkan kata sandi'}
                >
                  {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
              {passwordError && <p className="text-[11px] text-red-600">{passwordError}</p>}
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">
              Akun baru akan dibuat dengan peran <strong>Pasien (USER)</strong> dan terhubung otomatis ke Anda sebagai terapis penanggung jawab.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </form>
    </GlobalSlideOver>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/dashboard/internal-calendar-event-form.tsx">
'use client';

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Select } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { DatePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker';
import { createInternalCalendarEvent } from '@/server/actions/internal-calendar-events';

export function InternalCalendarEventForm() {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [scheduledDate, setScheduledDate] = useState('');
  const router = useRouter();

  function submit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await createInternalCalendarEvent({
          title: String(data.get('title') ?? ''),
          description: String(data.get('description') ?? ''),
          eventType: String(data.get('eventType') ?? 'INTERNAL_EVENT') as
            'CLINIC_CLOSURE' | 'TRAINING' | 'INTERNAL_EVENT' | 'IMPORTANT_NOTICE',
          scheduledDate: String(data.get('scheduledDate') ?? ''),
          startTime: String(data.get('startTime') ?? ''),
          endTime: String(data.get('endTime') ?? ''),
          patientVisible: data.get('patientVisible') === 'on',
        });
        router.push('/dashboard');
        router.refresh();
      } catch {
        setError('Event tidak dapat disimpan. Periksa seluruh isian.');
      }
    });
  }
  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
      {error ? (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}
      <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="title">Judul event</Label>
          <Input id="title" name="title" required disabled={pending} />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="eventType">Tipe</Label>
          <Select id="eventType" name="eventType" defaultValue="INTERNAL_EVENT" disabled={pending}>
            <option value="CLINIC_CLOSURE">Libur Klinik</option>
            <option value="TRAINING">Pelatihan</option>
            <option value="INTERNAL_EVENT">Kegiatan Internal</option>
            <option value="IMPORTANT_NOTICE">Pengumuman Penting</option>
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="scheduledDate">Tanggal</Label>
          <input type="hidden" name="scheduledDate" value={scheduledDate} required />
          <DatePicker
            id="scheduledDate"
            value={scheduledDate}
            onChange={setScheduledDate}
            disabled={pending}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="startTime">Mulai</Label>
            <Select id="startTime" name="startTime" disabled={pending}>
              <option value="">Pilih jam</option>
              {Array.from({ length: 24 }).map((_, h) => 
                [0, 30].map(m => {
                  const value = `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
                  return <option key={`start-${value}`} value={value}>{value}</option>;
                })
              )}
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="endTime">Selesai</Label>
            <Select id="endTime" name="endTime" disabled={pending}>
              <option value="">Pilih jam</option>
              {Array.from({ length: 24 }).map((_, h) => 
                [0, 30].map(m => {
                  const value = `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
                  return <option key={`end-${value}`} value={value}>{value}</option>;
                })
              )}
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="description">Deskripsi</Label>
        <textarea
          id="description"
          name="description"
          disabled={pending}
          className="flex min-h-28 w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm leading-relaxed focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent focus-visible:border-accent"
        />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-accent/30 bg-accent/5 p-4 text-sm">
        <input id="patientVisible" type="checkbox" name="patientVisible" className="mt-1 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 accent-[var(--accent)] cursor-pointer" disabled={pending} />
        <span className="select-none">Tampilkan event ini kepada pasien di kalender mereka.</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button type="submit" disabled={pending} className="bg-accent text-accent-foreground hover:bg-accent/90">
          {pending ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Simpan Event'}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
