<file path="components/patient/patient-profile-tabs.tsx">
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { Controller, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  CalendarDays,
  Camera,
  ChevronRight,
  HeartHandshake,
  Lock,
  Mail,
  MapPin,
  Phone,
  Save,
  ShieldCheck,
  UserRound,
  type LucideIcon,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { ChangePasswordForm } from '@/components/dashboard/change-password-form';
import { DatePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Select } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useWilayahIndonesia } from '@/lib/use-wilayah-indonesia';
import type { PatientProfileInput } from '@/lib/validators/patient-profile';
import { updateCurrentPatientProfile } from '@/server/actions/patient-profile';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

type Props = {
  initialValues: Partial<PatientProfileInput>;
  email: string;
  initialAvatarUrl?: string | null;
  userName?: string;
  emailVerified?: boolean;
};

type SectionId = 'identitas' | 'alamat' | 'darurat' | 'keamanan';

const SECTIONS: {
  id: SectionId;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
}[] = [
  { id: 'identitas', label: 'Identitas Diri', description: 'Nama, kontak, dan pekerjaan', icon: UserRound },
  { id: 'alamat', label: 'Alamat Domisili', description: 'Wilayah dan alamat lengkap', icon: MapPin },
  { id: 'darurat', label: 'Kontak Darurat', description: 'Kontak yang dapat dihubungi', icon: HeartHandshake },
  { id: 'keamanan', label: 'Keamanan', description: 'Kata sandi dan akses akun', icon: Lock },
];

const fieldClass =
  'h-11 rounded-xl border-stone-200 bg-white text-sm shadow-none focus-visible:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-300)] focus-visible:ring-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]';
const labelClass = 'text-xs font-semibold text-stone-600';

function calculateAge(dateOfBirth?: string) {
  if (!dateOfBirth) return '-';
  const birth = new Date(`${dateOfBirth}T00:00:00`);
  if (Number.isNaN(birth.getTime())) return '-';
  const today = new Date();
  let age = today.getFullYear() - birth.getFullYear();
  const month = today.getMonth() - birth.getMonth();
  if (month < 0 || (month === 0 && today.getDate() < birth.getDate())) age -= 1;
  return `${age} tahun`;
}

function Field({
  label,
  hint,
  error,
  children,
  className,
}: {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <label className={cn('flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2', className)}>
      <span className={labelClass}>{label}</span>
      {children}
      {error ? <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-[var(--hafta-red-600)]">{error}</span> : null}
      {!error && hint ? <span className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-stone-400">{hint}</span> : null}
    </label>
  );
}

export function PatientProfileTabs({
  initialValues,
  email,
  initialAvatarUrl,
  userName,
  emailVerified = false,
}: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [avatarPreview, setAvatarPreview] = useState<string | null>(initialAvatarUrl ?? null);
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState<SectionId>('identitas');
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const {
    provinces,
    regencies,
    selectedProvinceId,
    setSelectedProvinceId,
    loadingProvinces,
    loadingRegencies,
  } = useWilayahIndonesia();

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setValue,
    reset,
    control,
    formState: { errors, isDirty },
  } = useForm<PatientProfileInput>({
    defaultValues: {
      ...initialValues,
      avatarKey: (initialValues as { avatarKey?: string })?.avatarKey ?? initialAvatarUrl ?? '',
    },
  });

  const values = useWatch({ control }) as PatientProfileInput;
  const fullName = values.fullName || initialValues.fullName || userName || 'Pasien';
  const dateOfBirth = values.dateOfBirth ?? '';
  const completionFields = [
    values.fullName,
    values.phone,
    values.gender,
    values.dateOfBirth,
    values.occupation,
    values.addressProvince,
    values.addressCity,
    values.addressLine,
    values.emergencyContactName,
    values.emergencyContactRelationship,
    values.emergencyContactPhone,
  ];
  const completion = Math.round(
    (completionFields.filter((value) => Boolean(String(value ?? '').trim())).length /
      completionFields.length) *
      100,
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!provinces.length || selectedProvinceId) return;
    const match = provinces.find((province) => province.name === initialValues.addressProvince);
    if (match) setSelectedProvinceId(match.id);
  }, [initialValues.addressProvince, provinces, selectedProvinceId, setSelectedProvinceId]);

  function compressImage(file: File, maxWidth = 256, quality = 0.7): Promise<string> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const image = new window.Image();
      image.onload = () => {
        const scale = Math.min(1, maxWidth / Math.max(image.width, image.height));
        const width = Math.round(image.width * scale);
        const height = Math.round(image.height * scale);
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
        const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!context) return reject(new Error('Canvas tidak tersedia'));
        context.drawImage(image, 0, 0, width, height);
        resolve(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality));
      };
      image.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Gagal memuat gambar'));
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => {
        image.src = String(reader.result);
      };
      reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Gagal membaca file'));
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  }

  async function onAvatarChange(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      toast.error('Format foto harus JPG, PNG, atau WebP.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const dataUrl = await compressImage(file);
      setAvatarPreview(dataUrl);
      setValue('avatarKey', dataUrl, { shouldDirty: true });
      toast.success('Foto siap disimpan. Klik Simpan Perubahan.');
    } catch {
      toast.error('Gagal memproses foto.');
    }
  }

  function onSubmit(data: PatientProfileInput) {
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await updateCurrentPatientProfile(data);
        toast.success('Profil berhasil diperbarui.');
        const nextAvatar = data.avatarKey || avatarPreview || null;
        reset(data);
        setAvatarPreview(nextAvatar);
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hafta:avatar', { detail: { avatarUrl: nextAvatar } }));
        router.refresh();
      } catch (error) {
        const message =
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'Data profil tidak dapat disimpan. Periksa isian lalu coba lagi.';
        toast.error(message);
      }
    });
  }

  function resetForm() {
    reset({
      ...initialValues,
      avatarKey: (initialValues as { avatarKey?: string })?.avatarKey ?? initialAvatarUrl ?? '',
    });
    setAvatarPreview(initialAvatarUrl ?? null);
    const initialProvince = provinces.find((province) => province.name === initialValues.addressProvince);
    setSelectedProvinceId(initialProvince?.id ?? '');
    toast.success('Perubahan dibatalkan.');
  }

  const activeSectionMeta = SECTIONS.find((section) => section.id === activeSection) ?? SECTIONS[0];
  const ActiveSectionIcon = activeSectionMeta.icon;

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-12">
      <aside className="min-w-0 space-y-4 lg:col-span-4 lg:sticky lg:top-[88px] lg:self-start">
        <section className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
            <div className="relative h-24 w-24 shrink-0">
              <div className="flex h-24 w-24 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full border-4 border-white bg-[#FAFAF8] text-2xl font-bold text-[#181700] ring-1 ring-stone-200">
                {avatarPreview ? (
                  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                  <img src={avatarPreview} alt="Foto profil" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                ) : (
                  fullName[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? 'P'
                )}
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
                className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 flex h-9 w-9 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#181700] text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] ring-4 ring-white transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:text-[#181700]"
                aria-label="Ubah foto profil"
              >
                <Camera className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
              <input
                ref={fileRef}
                type="file"
                accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
                className="hidden"
                onChange={onAvatarChange}
              />
              <input type="hidden" {...register('avatarKey')} />
            </div>

            <div className="min-w-0 pt-1">
              <h2 className="truncate text-lg font-bold text-[#181700]">{fullName}</h2>
              <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate text-xs text-stone-500">
                <Mail className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">{email}</span>
              </p>
              <span
                className={cn(
                  'mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold',
                  emailVerified
                    ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-grn-50)] text-[var(--hafta-grn-700)]'
                    : 'bg-[var(--hafta-org-50)] text-[var(--hafta-org-700)]',
                )}
              >
                <ShieldCheck className="h-3 w-3" />
                {emailVerified ? 'Akun terverifikasi' : 'Email belum diverifikasi'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <dl className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FAFAF8] p-4">
            <div>
              <dt className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-stone-400">No. RM</dt>
              <dd className="mt-1 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#181700]">
                {initialValues.medicalRecordNumber || 'Belum tersedia'}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-stone-400">Usia</dt>
              <dd className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#181700]">{calculateAge(dateOfBirth)}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>

          <div className="mt-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-600">Kelengkapan profil</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#181700]">{completion}%</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-stone-100">
              <div
                className="h-full rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: `${completion}%` }}
              />
            </div>
            <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-stone-400">
              Data lengkap membantu fisioterapis menyiapkan asesmen yang tepat.
            </p>
          </div>

          <nav className="mt-5 hidden gap-1.5 lg:flex lg:flex-col" aria-label="Bagian profil">
            {SECTIONS.map(({ id, label, description, icon: Icon }) => {
              const isActive = activeSection === id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveSection(id)}
                  className={cn(
                    'flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors',
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-[#181700] text-white'
                      : 'text-stone-600 hover:bg-[#FAFAF8] hover:text-[#181700]',
                  )}
                >
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      'flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full',
                      isActive
                        ? 'bg-white/10 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]'
                        : 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-500',
                    )}
                  >
                    <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </span>
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="block text-xs font-bold">{label}</span>
                    <span
                      className={cn(
                        'mt-0.5 block truncate text-[10px]',
                        isActive ? 'text-stone-400' : 'text-stone-400',
                      )}
                    >
                      {description}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                  <ChevronRight
                    className={cn('h-4 w-4 shrink-0', isActive ? 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]' : 'text-stone-300')}
                  />
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </nav>
        </section>
      </aside>

      <section className="flex min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white lg:col-span-8">
        <div className="border-b border-stone-200 p-5 sm:p-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 rounded-2xl bg-stone-100 p-1.5 lg:hidden" role="tablist" aria-label="Bagian profil">
            {SECTIONS.map(({ id, label, icon: Icon }) => {
              const isActive = activeSection === id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={id}
                  type="button"
                  role="tab"
                  aria-selected={isActive}
                  onClick={() => setActiveSection(id)}
                  className={cn(
                    'flex min-w-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors',
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-[#181700] text-white'
                      : 'bg-white text-stone-500 hover:text-[#181700]',
                  )}
                >
                  <Icon className={cn('h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0', isActive && 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]')} />
                  <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-3 lg:mt-0">
            <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[#181700]">
              <ActiveSectionIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
            </span>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">{activeSectionMeta.label}</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-stone-500">
                {activeSectionMeta.description}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {activeSection === 'keamanan' ? (
          <div className="p-5 sm:p-8">
            <ChangePasswordForm />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form className="flex flex-1 flex-col" onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
            <div className="flex-1 p-5 sm:p-8">
              {activeSection === 'identitas' ? (
                <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <Field label="Nama lengkap" error={errors.fullName?.message}>
                    <Input
                      disabled={pending}
                      className={fieldClass}
                      {...register('fullName', { required: 'Nama lengkap wajib diisi.' })}
                    />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Nama panggilan">
                    <Input disabled={pending} className={fieldClass} {...register('preferredName')} />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Email akun" hint="Email tidak dapat diubah di halaman ini.">
                    <Input value={email} disabled className={cn(fieldClass, 'bg-stone-50 text-stone-500')} />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Nomor rekam medis" hint="Dibuat otomatis oleh sistem.">
                    <Input
                      value={initialValues.medicalRecordNumber ?? ''}
                      disabled
                      placeholder="Belum tersedia"
                      className={cn(fieldClass, 'bg-stone-50 font-mono text-stone-500')}
                    />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Jenis kelamin">
                    <Select
                      disabled={pending}
                      className="w-full"
                      selectClassName={cn(fieldClass, 'pr-10')}
                      {...register('gender')}
                    >
                      <option value="MALE">Laki-laki</option>
                      <option value="FEMALE">Perempuan</option>
                      <option value="OTHER">Lainnya</option>
                    </Select>
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Tanggal lahir">
                    <Controller
                      control={control}
                      name="dateOfBirth"
                      render={({ field }) => (
                        <DatePicker
                          value={field.value ?? ''}
                          onChange={field.onChange}
                          disabled={pending}
                          className={fieldClass}
                        />
                      )}
                    />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Usia" hint="Dihitung otomatis dari tanggal lahir.">
                    <Input value={calculateAge(dateOfBirth)} disabled className={cn(fieldClass, 'bg-stone-50 text-stone-500')} />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Pekerjaan">
                    <Input disabled={pending} className={fieldClass} {...register('occupation')} />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Nomor telepon" className="sm:col-span-2">
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Phone className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-stone-400" />
                      <Input
                        type="tel"
                        inputMode="numeric"
                        maxLength={13}
                        disabled={pending}
                        className={cn(fieldClass, 'pl-9')}
                        {...register('phone')}
                        onChange={(event) => {
                          const digits = event.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 13);
                          setValue('phone', digits, { shouldDirty: true });
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </Field>
                </div>
              ) : null}

              {activeSection === 'alamat' ? (
                <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <Field label="Provinsi">
                    <Controller
                      control={control}
                      name="addressProvince"
                      render={({ field }) => {
                        const selectedProvince =
                          provinces.find((province) => province.name === field.value)?.id ??
                          selectedProvinceId;
                        return (
                          <Select
                            value={selectedProvince}
                            disabled={pending || loadingProvinces}
                            className="w-full"
                            selectClassName={cn(fieldClass, 'pr-10')}
                            onChange={(event) => {
                              const provinceId = event.target.value;
                              const province = provinces.find((item) => item.id === provinceId);
                              setSelectedProvinceId(provinceId);
                              field.onChange(province?.name ?? '');
                              setValue('addressCity', '', { shouldDirty: true });
                            }}
                          >
                            <option value="">
                              {loadingProvinces ? 'Memuat provinsi...' : 'Pilih provinsi'}
                            </option>
                            {provinces.map((province) => (
                              <option key={province.id} value={province.id}>
                                {province.name}
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </Select>
                        );
                      }}
                    />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Kabupaten / Kota">
                    <Controller
                      control={control}
                      name="addressCity"
                      render={({ field }) => (
                        <Select
                          value={field.value ?? ''}
                          disabled={pending || !regencies.length || loadingRegencies}
                          className="w-full"
                          selectClassName={cn(fieldClass, 'pr-10')}
                          onChange={(event) => field.onChange(event.target.value)}
                        >
                          <option value="">
                            {loadingRegencies ? 'Memuat kabupaten/kota...' : 'Pilih kabupaten / kota'}
                          </option>
                          {regencies.map((regency) => (
                            <option key={regency.id} value={regency.name}>
                              {regency.name}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </Select>
                      )}
                    />
                  </Field>
                  <Field
                    label="Alamat lengkap"
                    hint="Sertakan nama jalan, nomor, RT/RW, kelurahan, dan kecamatan."
                    className="sm:col-span-2"
                  >
                    <textarea
                      disabled={pending}
                      className="flex min-h-28 w-full resize-none rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-stone-400 focus-visible:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-300)] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-stone-50 disabled:text-stone-500"
                      placeholder="Jl. Nama Jalan No. RT/RW, Kelurahan, Kecamatan"
                      {...register('addressLine')}
                    />
                  </Field>
                </div>
              ) : null}

              {activeSection === 'darurat' ? (
                <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <Field label="Nama kontak">
                    <Input
                      disabled={pending}
                      className={fieldClass}
                      placeholder="Nama lengkap"
                      {...register('emergencyContactName')}
                    />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Hubungan">
                    <Input
                      disabled={pending}
                      className={fieldClass}
                      placeholder="Orang tua / Pasangan / Saudara"
                      {...register('emergencyContactRelationship')}
                    />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Nomor telepon kontak" className="sm:col-span-2">
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Phone className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-stone-400" />
                      <Input
                        type="tel"
                        disabled={pending}
                        className={cn(fieldClass, 'pl-9')}
                        placeholder="08xxxxxxxxxx"
                        {...register('emergencyContactPhone')}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </Field>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <footer className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 border-t border-stone-100 bg-[#FAFAF8] px-5 py-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-8">
              <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-400">
                {isDirty ? 'Ada perubahan yang belum disimpan.' : 'Data profil Anda tersimpan dengan aman.'}
              </p>
              <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2 sm:w-auto sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  disabled={pending || !isDirty}
                  onClick={resetForm}
                  className="h-10 w-full whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border-stone-200 px-5 text-xs font-semibold sm:w-auto"
                >
                  Reset
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={pending || !isDirty}
                  className="h-10 w-full gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full bg-[#181700] px-5 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:text-[#181700] sm:w-auto"
                >
                  {pending ? <CalendarDays className="h-4 w-4 animate-pulse" /> : <Save className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  {pending ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Simpan Perubahan'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </footer>
          </form>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/patient/patient-therapy-calendar.tsx">
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  CalendarDays,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Clock3,
  Loader2,
  UserRound,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { GlobalSlideOver } from '@/components/ui/global-slide-over';
import { ConfirmDialog } from '@/components/ui/confirm-dialog';
import { useToast } from '@/components/ui/toast';
import {
  cancelPatientAppointmentRequest,
  requestPatientAppointment,
} from '@/server/actions/appointment-requests';
import type {
  AvailabilityDate,
  PatientAppointmentRequestView,
  PatientPortalAppointment,
} from '@/server/queries/patient-portal';
import type { IndonesianHoliday } from '@/server/queries/indonesian-holidays';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const WEEKDAYS = ['Min', 'Sen', 'Sel', 'Rab', 'Kam', 'Jum', 'Sab'];
const MONTHS = [
  'Januari', 'Februari', 'Maret', 'April', 'Mei', 'Juni',
  'Juli', 'Agustus', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Desember',
];
const TYPE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  INITIAL_ASSESSMENT: 'Assessment Awal',
  THERAPY_SESSION: 'Sesi Terapi',
  FOLLOW_UP: 'Tindak Lanjut',
  EVALUATION: 'Evaluasi',
};
const STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  SCHEDULED: 'Terjadwal',
  CONFIRMED: 'Terkonfirmasi',
  COMPLETED: 'Selesai',
  CANCELLED: 'Dibatalkan',
  RESCHEDULED: 'Dijadwalkan ulang',
  NO_SHOW: 'Tidak hadir',
  PENDING: 'Menunggu konfirmasi',
  APPROVED: 'Disetujui',
  DECLINED: 'Belum disetujui',
};

function dateKey(value: Date | string) {
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value.slice(0, 10);
  return `${value.getFullYear()}-${String(value.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(value.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function parseDateKey(key: string) {
  const [year, month, day] = key.split('-').map(Number);
  return new Date(year, (month ?? 1) - 1, day ?? 1);
}

function formatLongDate(key: string) {
  return parseDateKey(key).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
    weekday: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

function formatShortDate(key: string) {
  return parseDateKey(key).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
    weekday: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
  });
}

export function PatientTherapyCalendar({
  appointments,
  availability,
  requests,
  holidays,
  defaultDate,
}: {
  appointments: PatientPortalAppointment[];
  availability: AvailabilityDate[];
  requests: PatientAppointmentRequestView[];
  holidays: IndonesianHoliday[];
  defaultDate?: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const initialDate = defaultDate ? parseDateKey(defaultDate) : new Date();
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(() => new Date(initialDate.getFullYear(), initialDate.getMonth(), 1));
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState<string | null>(defaultDate ?? null);
  const [selectedTime, setSelectedTime] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedTherapistId, setSelectedTherapistId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [detailAppointment, setDetailAppointment] = useState<PatientPortalAppointment | null>(null);
  const [showRescheduleConfirm, setShowRescheduleConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reschedulePickerId, setReschedulePickerId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pickerDate, setPickerDate] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pickerTime, setPickerTime] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pickerTherapistId, setPickerTherapistId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const todayKey = dateKey(new Date());

  const availabilityMap = useMemo(
    () => new Map(availability.map((item) => [item.date, item])),
    [availability],
  );
  const holidayMap = useMemo(() => new Map(holidays.map((holiday) => [holiday.date, holiday])), [holidays]);
  const appointmentsByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, PatientPortalAppointment[]>();
    for (const appointment of appointments) {
      const key = dateKey(appointment.scheduledDate);
      map.set(key, [...(map.get(key) ?? []), appointment]);
    }
    return map;
  }, [appointments]);
  const requestsByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, PatientAppointmentRequestView[]>();
    for (const request of requests) {
      const key = dateKey(request.requestedDate);
      map.set(key, [...(map.get(key) ?? []), request]);
    }
    return map;
  }, [requests]);

  const days = useMemo(() => {
    const firstDay = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth(), 1);
    const lastDay = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth() + 1, 0);
    const prefix = firstDay.getDay();
    return Array.from({ length: prefix + lastDay.getDate() }, (_, index) =>
      index < prefix ? null : new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth(), index - prefix + 1),
    );
  }, [month]);

  const selectedAvailability = selectedDate ? availabilityMap.get(selectedDate) : undefined;
  const selectedAppointments = selectedDate ? appointmentsByDate.get(selectedDate) ?? [] : [];
  const selectedRequests = selectedDate
    ? (requestsByDate.get(selectedDate) ?? []).filter((request) => request.status === 'PENDING')
    : [];
  const availableTimes = useMemo(
    () => Array.from(new Set((selectedAvailability?.slots ?? []).map((slot) => slot.startTime))).sort(),
    [selectedAvailability],
  );
  const effectiveTime = selectedTime && availableTimes.includes(selectedTime) ? selectedTime : availableTimes[0] ?? null;
  const therapistsForTime = (selectedAvailability?.slots ?? []).filter(
    (slot) => slot.startTime === effectiveTime,
  );
  const effectiveTherapist =
    therapistsForTime.find((slot) => slot.therapistId === selectedTherapistId) ?? therapistsForTime[0] ?? null;

  const pickerAvailability = pickerDate ? availabilityMap.get(pickerDate) : undefined;
  const pickerTimes = useMemo(
    () => Array.from(new Set((pickerAvailability?.slots ?? []).map((slot) => slot.startTime))).sort(),
    [pickerAvailability],
  );
  const pickerTherapists = (pickerAvailability?.slots ?? []).filter(
    (slot) => slot.startTime === pickerTime,
  );
  const effectivePickerTherapist =
    pickerTherapists.find((slot) => slot.therapistId === pickerTherapistId) ??
    pickerTherapists[0] ??
    null;
  const pickerAppointment = reschedulePickerId
    ? appointments.find((appointment) => appointment.id === reschedulePickerId) ?? null
    : null;

  const smartAlternatives = useMemo(() => {
    const base = selectedDate ?? todayKey;
    return availability
      .filter((item) => item.date > base)
      .slice(0, 3)
      .map((item) => ({ date: item.date, slot: item.slots[0] }));
  }, [availability, selectedDate, todayKey]);

  function changeMonth(offset: number) {
    setMonth((current) => new Date(current.getFullYear(), current.getMonth() + offset, 1));
    setSelectedDate(null);
    setSelectedTime(null);
    setSelectedTherapistId(null);
  }

  function selectDate(key: string) {
    setSelectedDate(key);
    setSelectedTime(null);
    setSelectedTherapistId(null);
    const day = parseDateKey(key);
    setMonth(new Date(day.getFullYear(), day.getMonth(), 1));
  }

  function confirmReschedule(appointmentId: string) {
    const firstAvailable = availability.find((item) => item.slots.length > 0) ?? null;
    const firstSlot = firstAvailable?.slots[0] ?? null;
    setShowRescheduleConfirm(null);
    setReschedulePickerId(appointmentId);
    setPickerDate(firstAvailable?.date ?? null);
    setPickerTime(firstSlot?.startTime ?? null);
    setPickerTherapistId(firstSlot?.therapistId ?? null);
  }

  function selectPickerDate(key: string) {
    const firstSlot = availabilityMap.get(key)?.slots[0] ?? null;
    setPickerDate(key);
    setPickerTime(firstSlot?.startTime ?? null);
    setPickerTherapistId(firstSlot?.therapistId ?? null);
  }

  function selectPickerTime(time: string) {
    const slot = (pickerAvailability?.slots ?? []).find((item) => item.startTime === time);
    setPickerTime(time);
    setPickerTherapistId(slot?.therapistId ?? null);
  }

  function closeReschedulePicker() {
    setReschedulePickerId(null);
    setPickerDate(null);
    setPickerTime(null);
    setPickerTherapistId(null);
  }

  function submitRescheduleFromPicker() {
    if (!reschedulePickerId || !pickerDate || !pickerTime || !effectivePickerTherapist) return;

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await requestPatientAppointment({
          requestedDate: pickerDate,
          startTime: pickerTime,
          therapistId: effectivePickerTherapist.therapistId,
          durationMinutes: 60,
          rescheduleAppointmentId: reschedulePickerId,
        });
        showToast('success', 'Pengajuan ubah jadwal terkirim. Tim Hafta akan mengonfirmasi.');
        closeReschedulePicker();
        router.refresh();
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('error', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Pengajuan ubah jadwal tidak dapat dikirim.');
      }
    });
  }

  function cancelPendingRequest(requestId: string) {
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await cancelPatientAppointmentRequest(requestId);
        showToast('success', 'Pengajuan jadwal dibatalkan.');
        router.refresh();
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('error', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Pengajuan tidak dapat dibatalkan.');
      }
    });
  }

  function selectAlternative(key: string, time: string, therapistId: string) {
    selectDate(key);
    setSelectedTime(time);
    setSelectedTherapistId(therapistId);
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('patient-slot-panel')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }, 50);
  }

  function submitRequest() {
    if (!selectedDate || !effectiveTherapist || !effectiveTime) return;

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await requestPatientAppointment({
          requestedDate: selectedDate,
          startTime: effectiveTime,
          therapistId: effectiveTherapist.therapistId,
          durationMinutes: 60,
        });
        showToast('success', 'Pengajuan jadwal terkirim. Tim Hafta akan mengonfirmasi.');
        setDetailAppointment(null);
        router.refresh();
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('error', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Pengajuan jadwal tidak dapat dikirim.');
      }
    });
  }

  const panelContent = (() => {
    if (!selectedDate) {
      return (
        <div className="flex min-h-48 flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 text-center">
          <CalendarDays className="h-8 w-8 text-stone-300" />
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[#181700]">Pilih tanggal</p>
          <p className="mt-1 max-w-xs text-xs leading-relaxed text-stone-500">
            Tanggal dengan lingkaran kuning memiliki slot fisioterapis yang masih tersedia.
          </p>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (selectedAppointments.length > 0) {
      return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">Jadwal sesi Anda</p>
            <h3 className="mt-1 text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">{formatLongDate(selectedDate)}</h3>
          </div>
          {selectedAppointments.map((appointment) => (
            <article key={appointment.id} className="rounded-2xl bg-[#181700] p-4 text-white">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold">{TYPE_LABELS[appointment.type] ?? appointment.type}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-stone-300">
                    {appointment.startTime} · {appointment.durationMinutes} menit
                  </p>
                </div>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-white/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]">
                  {STATUS_LABELS[appointment.status] ?? appointment.status}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-white/10 pt-3 text-xs text-stone-300">
                <UserRound className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]" />
                {appointment.therapistName ?? 'Fisioterapis Hafta'}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setDetailAppointment(appointment)}
                  className="h-9 cursor-pointer rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/5 px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-white/10"
                >
                  Lihat Detail
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowRescheduleConfirm(appointment.id);
                  }}
                  className="h-9 cursor-pointer rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] px-3 text-xs font-bold text-[#181700] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)]"
                >
                  Ubah Jadwal
                </button>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      );
    }


    if (selectedAvailability && selectedAvailability.slots.length > 0) {
      return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">Cari jadwal baru</p>
            <h3 className="mt-1 text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">{formatLongDate(selectedDate)}</h3>
          </div>

          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#181700]">Jam tersedia</p>
            <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {availableTimes.map((time) => {
                const slots = selectedAvailability.slots.filter((slot) => slot.startTime === time);
                return (
                  <button
                    key={time}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSelectedTime(time);
                      setSelectedTherapistId(slots[0]?.therapistId ?? null);
                    }}
                    className={cn(
                      'h-10 cursor-pointer rounded-full border px-3.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors',
                      effectiveTime === time
                        ? 'border-[#181700] bg-[#181700] text-white'
                        : 'border-stone-200 bg-white text-[#181700] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/50',
                    )}
                  >
                    {time}–{slots[0]?.endTime}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#181700]">Fisioterapis</p>
            <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
              {therapistsForTime.map((slot) => (
                <button
                  key={`${slot.startTime}-${slot.therapistId}`}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedTherapistId(slot.therapistId)}
                  className={cn(
                    'flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors',
                    effectiveTherapist?.therapistId === slot.therapistId
                      ? 'border-[var(--hafta-ylw-300)] bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/45'
                      : 'border-stone-200 bg-white hover:bg-stone-50',
                  )}
                >
                  <span className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white text-[#181700] ring-1 ring-stone-200">
                    <UserRound className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </span>
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="block truncate text-xs font-bold text-[#181700]">{slot.therapistName}</span>
                    <span className="block text-[11px] text-stone-500">{slot.startTime}–{slot.endTime}</span>
                  </span>
                  {effectiveTherapist?.therapistId === slot.therapistId ? (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--hafta-grn-600)]" />
                  ) : null}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {selectedRequests.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/45 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">
              <p>Anda sudah memiliki pengajuan menunggu konfirmasi pada tanggal ini.</p>
              {selectedRequests.map((request) => (
                <button
                  key={request.id}
                  type="button"
                  disabled={pending}
                  onClick={() => cancelPendingRequest(request.id)}
                  className="font-semibold underline underline-offset-4 disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  Batalkan pengajuan {request.startTime}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={submitRequest}
            disabled={pending || !effectiveTherapist || selectedRequests.length > 0}
            className="inline-flex h-10 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] px-4 text-xs font-bold text-[#181700] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {pending ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />}
            {pending ? 'Mengirim pengajuan...' : 'Pilih & Ajukan Jadwal Ini'}
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">Tanggal dipilih</p>
          <h3 className="mt-1 text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">{formatLongDate(selectedDate)}</h3>
        </div>
        <p className="rounded-2xl bg-stone-50 px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-stone-600">
          Maaf, slot pada tanggal ini sudah penuh atau klinik sedang libur. Berikut jadwal kosong terdekat yang tersedia untuk Anda.
        </p>
        {selectedRequests.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/45 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-[#181700]">
            <p>Ada pengajuan jadwal yang masih menunggu konfirmasi pada tanggal ini.</p>
            {selectedRequests.map((request) => (
              <button
                key={request.id}
                type="button"
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={() => cancelPendingRequest(request.id)}
                className="block font-semibold underline underline-offset-4 disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                Batalkan pengajuan {request.startTime}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {smartAlternatives.length > 0 ? (
            smartAlternatives.map((alternative) => (
              <button
                key={`${alternative.date}-${alternative.slot.startTime}`}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => selectAlternative(alternative.date, alternative.slot.startTime, alternative.slot.therapistId)}
                className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-300)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/30"
              >
                <span>
                  <span className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#181700]">{formatShortDate(alternative.date)}</span>
                  <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-stone-500">{alternative.slot.therapistName}</span>
                </span>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#181700]">
                  {alternative.slot.startTime}
                </span>
              </button>
            ))
          ) : (
            <p className="text-xs text-stone-400">Belum ada slot lain dalam periode ini.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  })();

  return (
    <section className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">Kalender & Slot Terapi</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-stone-500">
            Pilih tanggal untuk melihat sesi Anda atau mengajukan jadwal baru.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 rounded-full border border-stone-200 bg-white p-1 sm:justify-start">
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Bulan sebelumnya"
            onClick={() => changeMonth(-1)}
            className="flex h-8 w-8 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[#181700] transition-colors hover:bg-stone-100"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
          <p className="min-w-32 text-center text-xs font-bold text-[#181700] sm:text-sm">
            {MONTHS[month.getMonth()]} {month.getFullYear()}
          </p>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Bulan berikutnya"
            onClick={() => changeMonth(1)}
            className="flex h-8 w-8 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[#181700] transition-colors hover:bg-stone-100"
          >
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {availability.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/45 px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">
          Belum ada slot tersedia. Fisioterapis Anda mungkin belum terhubung atau jadwal kerjanya belum diatur. Silakan hubungi tim Hafta untuk penjadwalan.
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_21rem]">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 text-center text-[10px] font-semibold text-stone-400">
            {WEEKDAYS.map((label) => (
              <span key={label} className="py-1.5">{label}</span>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
            {days.map((day, index) => {
              if (!day) return <span key={`empty-${index}`} className="min-h-11" />;

              const key = dateKey(day);
               const isPast = key < todayKey;
              const holiday = holidayMap.get(key);
              const isSunday = day.getDay() === 0;
              const own = (appointmentsByDate.get(key) ?? []).filter((appointment) =>
                ['SCHEDULED', 'CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED'].includes(appointment.status),
              );
              const slots = availabilityMap.get(key)?.slots ?? [];
              const pendingRequests = (requestsByDate.get(key) ?? []).filter((request) => request.status === 'PENDING');
              const isSelected = selectedDate === key;
              const unavailable = isPast || isSunday || Boolean(holiday);
              const isHoliday = Boolean(holiday);


              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  key={key}
                  title={holiday?.name ?? (isSunday ? 'Minggu' : undefined)}
                  onClick={() => selectDate(key)}
                  className="group flex min-h-11 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-center"
                >
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      'relative mx-auto flex h-10 w-10 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[13px] transition-all sm:h-11 sm:w-11',
                      own.length > 0
                        ? 'bg-[#181700] font-bold text-white'
                        : pendingRequests.length > 0
                          ? 'border border-[var(--hafta-ylw-300)] bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] font-bold text-[#181700]'
                          : slots.length > 0 && !unavailable
                            ? 'border border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/70 font-semibold text-[#181700] group-hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]'
                            : unavailable
                              ? isSunday || holiday
                                ? 'font-medium text-[var(--hafta-red-400)]'
                                : 'font-medium text-stone-300'
                              : 'font-medium text-stone-500 group-hover:bg-stone-100',
                      isSelected && 'ring-2 ring-[#181700] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-white',
                    )}
                  >
                    {day.getDate()}
                    {own.length > 0 ? (
                      <span className="mt-0.5 h-1 w-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]" />
                    ) : slots.length > 0 && !unavailable ? (
                      <span className="mt-0.5 h-1 w-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-grn-500)]" />
                    ) : (
                      <span className="mt-0.5 h-1 w-1" />
                    )}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 border-t border-stone-100 pt-3 text-[10px] text-stone-500">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#181700]" /> Sesi Anda
            </span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full border border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]" /> Slot tersedia
            </span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-grn-500)]" /> Ada slot kosong
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <aside id="patient-slot-panel" className="rounded-3xl bg-[#F7F7F5] p-4 sm:p-5">
          {panelContent}
        </aside>
      </div>

      <GlobalSlideOver
        isOpen={detailAppointment !== null}
        onClose={() => setDetailAppointment(null)}
        size="md"
        icon={<Clock3 className="h-5 w-5" />}
        title="Detail Sesi"
        subtitle={detailAppointment ? formatLongDate(dateKey(detailAppointment.scheduledDate)) : undefined}
        footer={
          detailAppointment ? (
            <div className="shrink-0 bg-[#FEFEF6] px-5 sm:px-6 py-4 flex flex-col gap-2.5 w-full">
                <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowRescheduleConfirm(detailAppointment.id);
                  setDetailAppointment(null);
                }}
                className="w-full h-11 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xs cursor-pointer transition-all px-5"
              >
                Ubah Jadwal
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : null
        }
      >
        {detailAppointment ? (
          <dl className="space-y-4 text-sm">
            {[
              ['Jam', `${detailAppointment.startTime} · ${detailAppointment.durationMinutes} menit`],
              ['Fisioterapis', detailAppointment.therapistName ?? '-'],
              ['Jenis sesi', TYPE_LABELS[detailAppointment.type] ?? detailAppointment.type],
              ['Status', STATUS_LABELS[detailAppointment.status] ?? detailAppointment.status],
            ].map(([label, value]) => (
              <div key={label} className="border-b border-stone-100 pb-3">
                <dt className="text-xs text-stone-500">{label}</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 font-semibold text-[#181700]">{value}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        ) : null}
      </GlobalSlideOver>

      <ConfirmDialog
        isOpen={showRescheduleConfirm !== null}
        title="Ubah Jadwal Terapi"
        description="Apakah Anda yakin ingin mengajukan perubahan jadwal untuk sesi ini?"
        confirmLabel="Ya, Ubah Jadwal"
        cancelLabel="Batal"
        onConfirm={() => confirmReschedule(showRescheduleConfirm as string)}
        onCancel={() => setShowRescheduleConfirm(null)}
      />

      <ConfirmDialog
        isOpen={reschedulePickerId !== null}
        title="Pilih Jadwal Pengganti"
        description="Pilih tanggal, jam, dan fisioterapis baru. Jadwal lama tetap berlaku sampai pengajuan ini dikonfirmasi tim Hafta."
        confirmLabel="Ajukan Jadwal Ini"
        cancelLabel="Batal"
        pending={pending}
        confirmDisabled={!pickerDate || !effectivePickerTherapist}
        size="lg"
        icon={<CalendarDays className="h-5 w-5" />}
        onConfirm={submitRescheduleFromPicker}
        onCancel={closeReschedulePicker}
      >
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-5">
          {pickerAppointment ? (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-[#F7F7F5] p-3">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-400">
                Jadwal saat ini
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#181700]">
                {TYPE_LABELS[pickerAppointment.type] ?? pickerAppointment.type} ·{' '}
                {formatShortDate(dateKey(pickerAppointment.scheduledDate))} ·{' '}
                {pickerAppointment.startTime}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-stone-500">
                <UserRound className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                {pickerAppointment.therapistName ?? 'Fisioterapis Hafta'}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {availability.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/45 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">
              Belum ada slot jadwal pengganti yang tersedia. Silakan hubungi tim Hafta untuk
              penjadwalan ulang.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#181700]">Tanggal tersedia</p>
                <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
                  {availability.map((item) => (
                    <button
                      key={item.date}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => selectPickerDate(item.date)}
                      className={cn(
                        'h-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-full border px-3 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors',
                        pickerDate === item.date
                          ? 'border-[#181700] bg-[#181700] text-white'
                          : 'border-stone-200 bg-white text-[#181700] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/50',
                      )}
                    >
                      {formatShortDate(item.date)}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {pickerAvailability && pickerAvailability.slots.length > 0 ? (
                <>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#181700]">Jam tersedia</p>
                    <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {pickerTimes.map((time) => {
                        const slot = pickerAvailability.slots.find((item) => item.startTime === time);
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={time}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => selectPickerTime(time)}
                            className={cn(
                              'h-9 cursor-pointer rounded-full border px-3 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors',
                              pickerTime === time
                                ? 'border-[#181700] bg-[#181700] text-white'
                                : 'border-stone-200 bg-white text-[#181700] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/50',
                            )}
                          >
                            {time}–{slot?.endTime}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#181700]">Fisioterapis</p>
                    <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
                      {pickerTherapists.map((slot) => (
                        <button
                          key={`${slot.startTime}-${slot.therapistId}`}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setPickerTherapistId(slot.therapistId)}
                          className={cn(
                            'flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors',
                            effectivePickerTherapist?.therapistId === slot.therapistId
                              ? 'border-[var(--hafta-ylw-300)] bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/45'
                              : 'border-stone-200 bg-white hover:bg-stone-50',
                          )}
                        >
                          <span className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white text-[#181700] ring-1 ring-stone-200">
                            <UserRound className="h-4 w-4" />
                          </span>
                          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <span className="block truncate text-xs font-bold text-[#181700]">
                              {slot.therapistName}
                            </span>
                            <span className="block text-[11px] text-stone-500">
                              {slot.startTime}–{slot.endTime}
                            </span>
                          </span>
                          {effectivePickerTherapist?.therapistId === slot.therapistId ? (
                            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--hafta-grn-600)]" />
                          ) : null}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">
                  Tidak ada jam tersedia pada tanggal ini. Pilih tanggal lain.
                </p>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </ConfirmDialog>

    </section>
  );
}
</file>

    fontFamily: 'Helvetica-Bold',
    color: '#0f172a',
    textAlign: 'center',
  },

function calculateAge(dob: Date | string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!dob) return '-';
  const birthDate = new Date(dob);
  if (isNaN(birthDate.getTime())) return '-';
  const today = new Date();
  let age = today.getFullYear() - birthDate.getFullYear();
  const m = today.getMonth() - birthDate.getMonth();
  if (m < 0 || (m === 0 && today.getDate() < birthDate.getDate())) {
    age--;
  }
  return `${age} tahun`;
}

function formatGender(gender: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (gender === 'MALE') return 'Laki-laki';
  if (gender === 'FEMALE') return 'Perempuan';
  return gender || '-';
}

<file path="components/ui/date-picker.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from '@/components/ui/popover';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getHoliday, type HolidayType } from '@/lib/holidays-indonesia';

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'Januari', 'Februari', 'Maret', 'April', 'Mei', 'Juni',
  'Juli', 'Agustus', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Desember',
];

const DAY_LABELS = ['Min', 'Sen', 'Sel', 'Rab', 'Kam', 'Jum', 'Sab'];

const HOLIDAY_DOT_COLOR: Record<HolidayType, string> = {
  nasional: 'bg-red-500',
  agama: 'bg-purple-500',
  libur: 'bg-blue-500',
};

const HOLIDAY_LABEL: Record<HolidayType, string> = {
  nasional: 'Hari Libur Nasional',
  agama: 'Hari Raya / Hari Besar Agama',
  libur: 'Hari Libur / Cuti Bersama',
};

function toDateString(d: Date): string {
  const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
}

function parseDate(value: string | undefined | null): Date | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  const d = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
}

function formatDisplay(date: Date | null): string {
  if (!date) return '';
  return `${date.getDate()} ${MONTH_NAMES[date.getMonth()]} ${date.getFullYear()}`;
}

function getDaysInMonth(year: number, month: number) {
  return new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
}

function getFirstDayOfMonth(year: number, month: number) {
  return new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
}

type DatePickerProps = {
  value?: string;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  id?: string;
  name?: string;
  className?: string;
};

const DatePicker = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, DatePickerProps>(
  ({ value, onChange, disabled, required, placeholder = 'Pilih tanggal', id, name, className }, ref) => {
    const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
    const selectedDate = parseDate(value);
    const [viewDate, setViewDate] = React.useState<Date>(selectedDate ?? new Date());

    const viewYear = viewDate.getFullYear();
    const viewMonth = viewDate.getMonth();
    const daysInMonth = getDaysInMonth(viewYear, viewMonth);
    const firstDay = getFirstDayOfMonth(viewYear, viewMonth);

    function selectDay(day: number) {
      const selected = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, day);
      onChange?.(toDateString(selected));
      setOpen(false);
    }

    function prevMonth() {
      setViewDate(new Date(viewYear, viewMonth - 1, 1));
    }

    function nextMonth() {
      setViewDate(new Date(viewYear, viewMonth + 1, 1));
    }

    function goToToday() {
      const today = new Date();
      setViewDate(today);
      onChange?.(toDateString(today));
      setOpen(false);
    }

    return (
      <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <PopoverTrigger asChild>
          <div className="relative">
            <input
              ref={ref}
              type="hidden"
              id={id}
              name={name}
              value={value ?? ''}
              required={required}
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={disabled}
              onClick={() => !disabled && setOpen(true)}
              className={cn(
                'flex h-10 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm transition-colors outline-none cursor-pointer',
                'hover:border-accent focus-visible:border-[#181700] focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-[#f7f000]/35',
                'disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50',
                !value && 'text-muted-foreground',
                className,
              )}
            >
              <Calendar className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
              <span className="flex-1 truncate">{value ? formatDisplay(selectedDate) : placeholder}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </PopoverTrigger>
        <PopoverContent className="w-auto p-0" align="start">
          <div className="p-3">
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={prevMonth}
                className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground cursor-pointer"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <select
                  value={viewMonth}
                  onChange={(e) => setViewDate(new Date(viewYear, Number(e.target.value), 1))}
                  className="rounded-md border-0 bg-transparent text-sm font-semibold text-foreground outline-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {MONTH_NAMES.map((name, i) => (
                    <option key={i} value={i}>{name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <select
                  value={viewYear}
                  onChange={(e) => setViewDate(new Date(Number(e.target.value), viewMonth, 1))}
                  className="rounded-md border-0 bg-transparent text-sm font-semibold text-foreground outline-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, i) => viewYear - 10 + i).map((y) => (
                    <option key={y} value={y}>{y}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={nextMonth}
                className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground cursor-pointer"
              >
                <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Day labels */}
            <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
              {DAY_LABELS.map((d) => (
                <div key={d} className="py-1 text-center text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                  {d}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Calendar grid */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
              {Array.from({ length: firstDay }).map((_, i) => (
                <div key={`empty-${i}`} />
              ))}
              {Array.from({ length: daysInMonth }).map((_, i) => {
                const day = i + 1;
                const dateStr = toDateString(new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, day));
                const isSelected = value === dateStr;
                const isToday = toDateString(new Date()) === dateStr;
                const holiday = getHoliday(viewMonth + 1, day);
                const dayOfWeek = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, day).getDay();
                const isSunday = dayOfWeek === 0;

                return (
                  <div key={day} className="relative flex flex-col items-center">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => selectDay(day)}
                      title={holiday ? `${holiday.name} (${HOLIDAY_LABEL[holiday.type]})` : undefined}
                      className={cn(
                        'flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-sm transition-colors',
                        'hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground',
                        isSelected && 'bg-accent text-accent-foreground font-bold',
                        !isSelected && isToday && 'font-bold text-[#e27409] border border-[#e27409] underline underline-offset-2 flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-sm transition-colors',
                        holiday && !isSelected && 'text-red-600 font-semibold',
                        !holiday && isSunday && !isSelected && 'text-red-500 font-semibold',
                      )}
                    >
                      {day}
                    </button>
                    {holiday && (
                      <span
                        className={cn('absolute bottom-0.5 h-1 w-1 rounded-full', HOLIDAY_DOT_COLOR[holiday.type])}
                        title={holiday.name}
                      />
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Legend */}
            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-t border-border pt-2">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500" /> Nasional
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-purple-500" /> Agama
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500" /> Cuti Bersama
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Footer */}
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-border pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={goToToday}
                className="rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-[#e27409] hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground"
              >
                Hari Ini
              </button>
              {value && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { onChange?.(''); setOpen(false); }}
                  className="rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground"
                >
                  Hapus
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>
    );
  },
);

DatePicker.displayName = 'DatePicker';

export { DatePicker };
</file>

import { createAuthClient } from 'better-auth/react';

const appUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL;

export const authClient = createAuthClient({
  // When NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL is unset, omit baseURL so better-auth uses the
  // browser's own origin. Hardcoding a localhost fallback breaks any deployed
  // app by posting auth requests to the wrong origin (CORS).
  ...(appUrl ? { baseURL: appUrl } : {}),
});

export const { signIn, signUp, signOut, useSession } = authClient;

import { type Permission, PERMISSIONS } from './constants';
import { type Role, ROLE_PERMISSIONS } from './roles';

export interface AuthUser {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  role: Role;
}

export interface AuthSession {
  user: AuthUser;
}

export interface AuthorizationContext {
  session: AuthSession;
  permission: Permission;
  resource?: {
    userId?: string;
    patientId?: string;
    therapistId?: string;
    status?: string;
    patientVisible?: boolean;
  };
}

export class ForbiddenError extends Error {
  constructor(message = 'Akses ditolak') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ForbiddenError';
  }
}

export class UnauthenticatedError extends Error {
  constructor(message = 'Silakan login terlebih dahulu') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'UnauthenticatedError';
  }
}

export function hasPermission(role: Role, permission: Permission): boolean {
  if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') return true;
  const rolePermissions = ROLE_PERMISSIONS[role];
  return rolePermissions?.includes(permission) ?? false;
}

export function authorize(context: AuthorizationContext): void {
  const { session, permission, resource } = context;

  if (!session?.user) {
    throw new UnauthenticatedError();
  }

  const { role } = session.user;

  // Check if role has the permission
  if (!hasPermission(role, permission)) {
    throw new ForbiddenError();
  }

  // Resource scope checks
  if (resource) {
    // USER can only access own resources
    if (role === 'USER') {
      if (resource.userId && resource.userId !== session.user.id) {
        throw new ForbiddenError();
      }
    }

    // Check patient visibility for clinical records
    const visibilityPermissions = [
      PERMISSIONS.ASSESSMENT_READ,
      PERMISSIONS.TREATMENT_PLAN_READ,
      PERMISSIONS.SESSION_READ,
    ];
    if (visibilityPermissions.includes(permission as (typeof visibilityPermissions)[number])) {
      if (role === 'USER' && resource.patientVisible === false) {
        throw new ForbiddenError();
      }
    }
  }
}

export function canAccessPatient(
  session: AuthSession,
  patientUserId: string,
  options?: { assigned?: boolean; hasExplicitClinicalScope?: boolean },
): boolean {
  const { role, id: userId } = session.user;

  if (role === 'USER') {
    return userId === patientUserId;
  }

  if (['ADMIN', 'THERAPIST', 'STAFF'].includes(role)) {
    return options?.assigned === true;
  }

  if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
    return options?.hasExplicitClinicalScope === true;
  }

  return false;
}

import { getAuth } from '@/lib/auth';
import { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

async function handleAuth(request: NextRequest) {
  const auth = getAuth();
  return 'handler' in auth
    ? auth.handler(request as unknown as Request)
    : (auth as unknown as (req: Request) => Promise<Response>)(request as unknown as Request);
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  return handleAuth(request);
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  return handleAuth(request);
}

function calculateAge(dob: Date | string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!dob) return '-';
  const birthDate = new Date(dob);
  if (isNaN(birthDate.getTime())) return '-';
  const today = new Date();
  let age = today.getFullYear() - birthDate.getFullYear();
  const m = today.getMonth() - birthDate.getMonth();
  if (m < 0 || (m === 0 && today.getDate() < birthDate.getDate())) {
    age--;
  }
  return `${age} tahun`;
}

function formatGender(gender: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (gender === 'MALE') return 'Laki-laki';
  if (gender === 'FEMALE') return 'Perempuan';
  return gender || '-';
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Eye, EyeOff, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

interface PasswordFieldProps {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  label: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  autoComplete?: string;
  className?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

export function PasswordField({
  id,
  name,
  label,
  placeholder = 'Masukkan kata sandi',
  required = true,
  autoComplete = 'current-password',
  className,
  disabled,
  error,
}: PasswordFieldProps) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className={cn('space-y-1.5', className)}>
      <Label htmlFor={id} className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-700">
        {label}
      </Label>
      <div className="relative">
        <input
          id={id}
          name={name}
          type={visible ? 'text' : 'password'}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          required={required}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
          aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
          className={cn(
            'h-12 w-full rounded-xl border bg-white px-4 pr-11 text-sm text-[#181700] placeholder:text-stone-400 transition-all duration-200 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50',
            error
              ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50/30 text-red-950 focus:border-red-600 focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-red-500/20'
              : 'border-stone-300 hover:border-stone-400 focus:border-[#181700] focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#f7f000]/30'
          )}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          tabIndex={-1}
          onClick={() => setVisible((v) => !v)}
          aria-label={visible ? 'Sembunyikan kata sandi' : 'Tampilkan kata sandi'}
          className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 flex h-7 w-7 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-stone-400 transition-colors hover:bg-stone-100 hover:text-stone-700 cursor-pointer"
        >
          {visible ? <EyeOff className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Eye className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <p id={`${id}-error`} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-red-600 animate-in fade-in-50 duration-200">
          <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
