import { PatientProfileTabs } from '@/components/patient/patient-profile-tabs';
import { DashboardPageHeader } from '@/components/dashboard/dashboard-page-header';
import { requireSession } from '@/lib/auth/require-session';
import { PERMISSIONS, requirePermission } from '@/lib/permissions';
import { getCurrentPatientProfile } from '@/server/queries/patient-profile';
import { UserRound } from 'lucide-react';

function formatDateForInput(value: Date | null | undefined) {
  return value ? value.toISOString().slice(0, 10) : '';
}

export default async function ProfilePage() {
  const { session, role } = await requireSession({ redirectToLogin: true });
  await requirePermission(PERMISSIONS.PATIENT_UPDATE_DEMOGRAPHICS);
  const header = (
    <DashboardPageHeader
      title="Data Saya"
      description={
        role === 'USER'
          ? 'Kelola identitas, alamat, kontak darurat, dan keamanan akun.'
          : 'Halaman ini hanya tersedia untuk pasien.'
      }
      breadcrumbs={[{ label: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard' }, { label: 'Data Saya' }]}
      icon={<UserRound />}
    />
  );
  if (role !== 'USER') return <div className="space-y-6">{header}</div>;
  const profile = await getCurrentPatientProfile(session.user.id);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {header}
      <PatientProfileTabs
        email={session.user.email}
        userName={session.user.name ?? ''}
        emailVerified={Boolean(session.user.emailVerified)}
        initialAvatarUrl={profile?.avatarKey ?? null}
        initialValues={{
          fullName: profile?.fullName ?? session.user.name ?? '',
          preferredName: profile?.preferredName ?? '',
          phone: profile?.phone ?? '',
          gender: (profile?.gender as 'MALE' | 'FEMALE' | 'OTHER' | undefined) ?? 'MALE',
          medicalRecordNumber: profile?.medicalRecordNumber ?? '',
          dateOfBirth: formatDateForInput(profile?.dateOfBirth),
          occupation: profile?.occupation ?? '',
          addressLine: profile?.addressLine ?? '',
          addressProvince: profile?.addressProvince ?? '',
          addressCity: profile?.addressCity ?? '',
          emergencyContactName: profile?.emergencyContactName ?? '',
          emergencyContactRelationship: profile?.emergencyContactRelationship ?? '',
          emergencyContactPhone: profile?.emergencyContactPhone ?? '',
          avatarKey: profile?.avatarKey ?? '',
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="app/dashboard/users/page.tsx">
import Link from 'next/link';
import { DashboardPageHeader } from '@/components/dashboard/dashboard-page-header';
import { UserRoleSelector } from '@/components/dashboard/user-role-selector';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import {
  Pagination,
  PaginationContent,
  PaginationItem,
  PaginationLink,
  PaginationNext,
  PaginationPrevious,
} from '@/components/ui/pagination';
import { UserPlus, Users, ShieldAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button, buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { requireSession } from '@/lib/auth/require-session';
import { hasPermission, PERMISSIONS, requirePermission, type Role } from '@/lib/permissions';
import { getRoleColor, getRoleLabel } from '@/lib/role-utils';
import { getUsersList } from '@/server/queries/users';
import { getTherapistScheduleOverview } from '@/server/queries/therapist-schedules';
import { DeleteUserButton } from '@/components/dashboard/delete-user-button';
import { TherapistSchedulePanel } from '@/components/dashboard/therapist-schedule-panel';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default async function UsersPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ page?: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission(PERMISSIONS.USER_LIST);
  const { session, role } = await requireSession({ redirectToLogin: true });
  const { page } = await searchParams;
  const result = await getUsersList(Number(page) || 1);
  const users = result.items;
  const canManageRole = role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.ROLE_ASSIGN);
  const canDeleteUser = role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.USER_SUSPEND);
  const canCreateUser = hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.USER_CREATE);
  const canManageSchedules =
    role !== 'USER' &&
    (hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.APPOINTMENT_UPDATE) ||
      hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE));
  const scheduleOverview = canManageSchedules ? await getTherapistScheduleOverview() : [];
  const schedulesByTherapist = new Map(
    scheduleOverview.map((therapist) => [therapist.therapistId, therapist])
  );

  const hrefFor = (pageNumber: number) =>
    `/dashboard/users?${new URLSearchParams({ page: String(pageNumber) }).toString()}`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <DashboardPageHeader
        title="Manajemen Pengguna"
        description="Kelola akun pengguna dan role."
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard' }, { label: 'Pengguna' }]}
        icon={<Users className="h-7 w-7 text-white" />}
        action={
          canCreateUser ? (
            <Link
              href="/dashboard/users/add"
              className={cn(
                buttonVariants({ size: 'lg' }),
                'shadow-md w-full sm:w-auto justify-center px-6'
              )}
            >
              <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Tambah Pengguna
            </Link>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Daftar Pengguna</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {users.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8">
              <Users className="mx-auto h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground/50" />
              <p className="mt-4 text-muted-foreground">Belum ada pengguna terdaftar</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground/70 mt-1">Pengguna akan muncul di sini setelah registrasi</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Nama</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Email</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Role</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Telepon</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Terdaftar</TableHead>
                    {canManageSchedules && <TableHead className="text-right">Jadwal</TableHead>}
                    {canDeleteUser && <TableHead className="text-right">Aksi</TableHead>}
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {users.map((user) => {
                    const role = (user.accountType ?? 'USER') as Role;
                    return (
                      <TableRow key={user.id}>
                        <TableCell className="font-medium">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            {user.accountType === 'USER' && (
                              <ShieldAlert className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
                            )}
                            <span>{user.displayName ?? user.name ?? 'Tidak diketahui'}</span>
                          </div>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">{user.email}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {canManageRole ? (
                            <UserRoleSelector
                              userId={user.id}
                              currentRole={role}
                              disabled={user.id === session.user.id}
                            />
                          ) : (
                            <span
                              className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${getRoleColor(role)}`}
                            >
                              {getRoleLabel(role)}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">{user.phone ?? '-'}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right text-muted-foreground">
                          {user.createdAt.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
                            day: 'numeric',
                            month: 'short',
                            year: 'numeric',
                          })}
                        </TableCell>
                        {canManageSchedules && (
                          <TableCell className="text-right">
                            {(() => {
                              const schedule = schedulesByTherapist.get(user.id);
                              return schedule ? (
                                <TherapistSchedulePanel therapists={[schedule]} label="Atur Jadwal" />
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>
                              );
                            })()}
                          </TableCell>
                        )}
                        {canDeleteUser && (
                          <TableCell className="text-right">
                            <DeleteUserButton
                              userId={user.id}
                              userName={user.displayName ?? user.name ?? 'pengguna'}
                              disabled={user.id === session.user.id}
                            />
                          </TableCell>
                        )}
                      </TableRow>
                    );
                  })}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/auth/auth-shell.tsx">
'use client';

import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from 'framer-motion';
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';

const slides = [
  {
    image: '/images/backgrounds/bg-hf-10.png',
    title: 'Hafta Fisioterapi',
    description:
      'Klinik fisioterapi profesional untuk pemulihan optimal, terukur, dan nyaman di Sidoarjo.',
  },
  {
    image: '/images/backgrounds/bg-hf-11.png',
    title: 'Patient Portal Digital Terintegrasi',
    description:
      'Pantau riwayat kunjungan, catatan evaluasi terapis, dan program latihan mandiri langsung dari ponsel Anda.',
  },
  {
    image: '/images/backgrounds/bg-hf-2.png',
    title: 'Kenyamanan Terapi 1-on-1 Privat',
    description:
      'Sesi tatap muka yang tenang, higienis, dan terfokus penuh untuk hasil pemulihan fisik yang optimal.',
  },
  {
    image: '/images/backgrounds/bg-hf-4.png',
    title: 'Mitra Kesehatan Sendi & Otot Sidoarjo',
    description:
      'Didukung pendekatan berbasis bukti ilmiah untuk membantu Anda kembali aktif berkarya dan berolahraga.',
  },
];

interface AuthShellProps {
  children: ReactNode;
}

export function AuthShell({ children }: AuthShellProps) {
  const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState(0);
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduceMotion) return;

    const interval = window.setInterval(() => {
      setActiveSlide((current) => (current + 1) % slides.length);
    }, 6000);

    return () => window.clearInterval(interval);
  }, [reduceMotion]);

  const currentSlide = slides[activeSlide];

  return (
    <div className="relative min-h-screen bg-[#FEFEF6] sm:bg-white">
      {/* ── PANEL KIRI: IMAGE SLIDER (DESKTOP ONLY) ── */}
      <aside className="fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-0 hidden w-1/2 overflow-hidden bg-[#181700] lg:block">
        <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="wait">
          <motion.div
            key={currentSlide.image}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 1.04 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 1.01 }}
            transition={{ duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 0.9, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
            className="absolute inset-0"
          >
            <Image
              src={currentSlide.image}
              alt={currentSlide.title}
              fill
              sizes="50vw"
              className="pointer-events-none object-cover object-[center_20%]"
              quality={100}
              priority
            />
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>

        {/* Warm Charcoal Gradient (#181700) — Foto Jernih Alami Tanpa Kabut Hijau */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#181700]/95 via-[#181700]/45 to-[#181700]/15" />

        {/* Konten Di Atas Slider */}
        <div className="relative z-10 flex h-full flex-col justify-between p-10 xl:p-14">
          {/* Logo Hafta di Atas */}
          <Link href="/" className="inline-block transition-opacity hover:opacity-90">
            <Image
              src="/images/logos/logos-text.png"
              alt="Hafta Fisioterapi"
              width={160}
              height={106}
              className="h-14 w-auto brightness-0 invert"
              priority
            />
          </Link>

          {/* Bagian Bawah: Teks Slider Humanize & Indikator */}
          <div className="max-w-md">
            <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
              <motion.div
                key={currentSlide.title}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
                transition={{ duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 0.4 }}
              >
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold leading-tight text-white xl:text-3xl">
                  {currentSlide.title}
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-stone-200">
                  {currentSlide.description}
                </p>
              </motion.div>
            </AnimatePresence>

            {/* Indikator Slide Aktif (Kuning Hafta #f7f000) vs Inaktif */}
            <div className="mt-6 flex items-center gap-2" aria-label="Navigasi slide">
              {slides.map((slide, index) => (
                <button
                  key={slide.image}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveSlide(index)}
                  aria-label={`Pindah ke slide ${index + 1}`}
                  className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer ${
                    index === activeSlide
                      ? 'w-8 bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] shadow-xs'
                      : 'w-2.5 bg-white/35 hover:bg-white/60'
                  }`}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* ── PANEL KANAN: FORM KONTEN ── */}
      <div className="relative z-10 flex min-h-screen flex-col justify-center px-5 py-8 sm:px-8 lg:ml-[50%] lg:w-1/2 lg:px-12 xl:px-16">
        <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[420px]">
          {/* Baris Paling Atas: Navigasi Balik ke Beranda */}
          <Link
            href="/"
            className="mb-6 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-stone-500 transition-colors hover:text-[#181700] sm:mb-8"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>Kembali ke Beranda</span>
          </Link>

          {/* Form Wrapper: Card putih bersih di mobile, seamless di desktop */}
          <div className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200/80 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-8 lg:border-0 lg:bg-transparent lg:p-0 lg:shadow-none">
            {children}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/auth/register-form.tsx">
'use client';

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { Loader2, MailCheck, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { PasswordField } from '@/components/auth/password-field';
import { AuthAlert } from '@/components/auth/auth-alert';
import { signUp } from '@/lib/auth/client';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type RegisterFieldErrors = {
  name?: string;
  email?: string;
  password?: string;
  confirmPassword?: string;
  terms?: string;
};

const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

export function RegisterForm() {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [generalError, setGeneralError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<RegisterFieldErrors>({});
  const [registered, setRegistered] = useState(false);

  const clearFieldError = (field: keyof RegisterFieldErrors) => {
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next[field];
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setGeneralError(null);

    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    const name = String(formData.get('name') ?? '').trim();
    const email = String(formData.get('email') ?? '').trim();
    const password = String(formData.get('password') ?? '');
    const confirmPassword = String(formData.get('confirmPassword') ?? '');
    const termsAccepted = formData.get('terms') === 'on';

    const errors: RegisterFieldErrors = {};

    // 1. Validasi Nama
    if (!name) {
      errors.name = 'Nama lengkap wajib diisi.';
    } else if (name.length < 2) {
      errors.name = 'Nama lengkap minimal 2 karakter.';
    }

    // 2. Validasi Email
    if (!email) {
      errors.email = 'Alamat email wajib diisi.';
    } else if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(email)) {
      errors.email = 'Format alamat email tidak valid (contoh: nama@email.com).';
    }

    // 3. Validasi Password
    if (!password) {
      errors.password = 'Kata sandi wajib diisi.';
    } else if (password.length < 8) {
      errors.password = 'Kata sandi minimal 8 karakter.';
    }

    // 4. Validasi Konfirmasi Password
    if (!confirmPassword) {
      errors.confirmPassword = 'Ulangi kata sandi Anda.';
    } else if (password && password !== confirmPassword) {
      errors.confirmPassword = 'Konfirmasi kata sandi tidak cocok.';
    }

    // 5. Validasi Syarat & Ketentuan
    if (!termsAccepted) {
      errors.terms = 'Anda harus menyetujui Syarat & Ketentuan dan Kebijakan Privasi.';
    }

    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
      setFieldErrors(errors);
      return;
    }

    setFieldErrors({});

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const result = await signUp.email({
          name,
          email,
          password,
          callbackURL: '/login',
        });

        if (result?.error) {
          const errData = result.error as { message?: string; code?: string };

          if (errData?.code === 'USER_ALREADY_EXISTS') {
            setFieldErrors({
              email: 'Alamat email ini sudah terdaftar. Silakan masuk atau gunakan email lain.',
            });
            return;
          }

          setFieldErrors({
            email: 'Terjadi kendala saat pendaftaran. Silakan periksa kembali data Anda.',
          });
          return;
        }

        setRegistered(true);
      } catch {
        setGeneralError('Terjadi kesalahan pada server. Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.');
      }
    });
  }

  if (registered) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-5 text-center">
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700] shadow-xs">
          <MailCheck className="size-8" aria-hidden="true" />
        </div>
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#181700]">
          Pendaftaran Berhasil
        </h2>
        <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-stone-600 sm:text-sm">
          Kami telah mengirimkan tautan verifikasi ke email Anda. Silakan periksa inbox (atau folder spam) untuk
          mengaktifkan akun Patient Portal Anda.
        </p>
        <div className="pt-2">
          <Link
            href="/login"
            className="inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-sm font-bold text-[#181700] shadow-xs transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)]"
          >
            Masuk ke Halaman Login
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {/* ── LOGO HANYA DI MOBILE/TABLET (DI DESKTOP SUDAH ADA DI PANEL KIRI) ── */}
      <div className="mb-6 lg:hidden">
        <Link href="/" className="inline-block">
          <Image
            src="/images/logos/logos-text.png"
            alt="Hafta Fisioterapi"
            width={140}
            height={93}
            priority
            className="h-12 w-auto"
          />
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* ── HEADER FORM RATA KIRI (BERSIH & HUMANIZE) ── */}
      <div className="mb-7">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#181700] sm:text-3xl">
          Buat Akun Pasien Baru
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-stone-600">
          Lengkapi data singkat di bawah ini untuk memudahkan proses asesmen awal dan pemantauan terapi Anda di klinik.
        </p>
      </div>

      {generalError && (
        <div className="mb-5">
          <AuthAlert type="error" message={generalError} />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── FORM INPUT ── */}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        {/* Nama Lengkap */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="name" className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-700">
            Nama Lengkap
          </Label>
          <input
            id="name"
            name="name"
            type="text"
            placeholder="Masukkan nama lengkap"
            required
            autoComplete="name"
            disabled={isPending}
            onChange={() => clearFieldError('name')}
            aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors.name)}
            aria-describedby={fieldErrors.name ? 'name-error' : undefined}
            className={cn(
              'h-12 w-full rounded-xl border bg-white px-4 text-sm text-[#181700] placeholder:text-stone-400 transition-all duration-200 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50',
              fieldErrors.name
                ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50/30 text-red-950 focus:border-red-600 focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-red-500/20'
                : 'border-stone-300 hover:border-stone-400 focus:border-[#181700] focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#f7f000]/30'
            )}
          />
          {fieldErrors.name && (
            <p id="name-error" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-red-600 animate-in fade-in-50 duration-200">
              <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>{fieldErrors.name}</span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Email */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="email" className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-700">
            Alamat Email
          </Label>
          <input
            id="email"
            name="email"
            type="email"
            placeholder="nama@email.com"
            required
            autoComplete="email"
            disabled={isPending}
            onChange={() => clearFieldError('email')}
            aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors.email)}
            aria-describedby={fieldErrors.email ? 'email-error' : undefined}
            className={cn(
              'h-12 w-full rounded-xl border bg-white px-4 text-sm text-[#181700] placeholder:text-stone-400 transition-all duration-200 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50',
              fieldErrors.email
                ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50/30 text-red-950 focus:border-red-600 focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-red-500/20'
                : 'border-stone-300 hover:border-stone-400 focus:border-[#181700] focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#f7f000]/30'
            )}
          />
          {fieldErrors.email && (
            <p id="email-error" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-red-600 animate-in fade-in-50 duration-200">
              <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>{fieldErrors.email}</span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Password & Confirm Password (Grid 2 Kolom di Layar Lebar) */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <PasswordField
            id="password"
            name="password"
            label="Kata Sandi"
            placeholder="Min. 8 karakter"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            disabled={isPending}
            error={fieldErrors.password}
          />

          <PasswordField
            id="confirmPassword"
            name="confirmPassword"
            label="Konfirmasi Sandi"
            placeholder="Ulangi sandi"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            disabled={isPending}
            error={fieldErrors.confirmPassword}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Persetujuan Syarat & Ketentuan */}
        <div className="pt-1">
          <label htmlFor="terms" className="flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs text-stone-600 cursor-pointer select-none">
            <input
              id="terms"
              type="checkbox"
              name="terms"
              disabled={isPending}
              onChange={() => clearFieldError('terms')}
              aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors.terms)}
              aria-describedby={fieldErrors.terms ? 'terms-error' : undefined}
              className={cn(
                'mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 rounded border cursor-pointer',
                fieldErrors.terms
                  ? 'border-red-500 accent-red-600 ring-2 ring-red-500/30'
                  : 'border-stone-300 accent-[#181700]'
              )}
            />
            <span className="leading-relaxed">
              Saya menyetujui{' '}
              <a href="/terms" className="font-semibold text-stone-900 underline hover:text-[#181700]">
                Syarat &amp; Ketentuan
              </a>{' '}
              dan{' '}
              <a href="/privacy" className="font-semibold text-stone-900 underline hover:text-[#181700]">
                Kebijakan Privasi
              </a>
              .
            </span>
          </label>
          {fieldErrors.terms && (
            <p id="terms-error" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-red-600 animate-in fade-in-50 duration-200">
              <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>{fieldErrors.terms}</span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Tombol Buat Akun */}
        <div className="pt-2">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isPending}
            className="inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-sm font-bold text-[#181700] shadow-xs transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] hover:shadow-md active:scale-[0.99] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-60 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isPending ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span>Mendaftarkan...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              'Buat Akun Pasien'
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Link Masuk Berkontras Jelas */}
        <p className="pt-2 text-center text-xs text-stone-600 sm:text-sm">
          Sudah memiliki akun?{' '}
          <Link
            href="/login"
            className="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-bold text-[#181700] underline decoration-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] decoration-2 underline-offset-4 transition-all hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]/40"
          >
            Masuk ke akun
          </Link>
        </p>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/dashboard/patients/patient-detail-drawer.tsx">
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Activity,
  CalendarPlus,
  CheckCircle2,
  ClipboardList,
  Eye,
  FileText,
  Loader2,
  MoreVertical,
  Pencil,
  UserRound,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { GlobalSlideOver } from '@/components/ui/global-slide-over';
import { MedicalRecordFormDrawer } from '@/components/dashboard/progress/medical-record-form-drawer';
import { NewAppointmentButton } from '@/components/dashboard/appointments/new-appointment-button';
import { TherapyScheduleForm } from '@/components/patient/therapy-schedule-form';
import { CompleteProgramButton } from '@/components/dashboard/patients/complete-program-button';
import { fetchPatientDetailAction } from '@/server/actions/patient-detail';
import type { TherapyProgressView } from '@/server/queries/therapy-progress';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type DetailData = Extract<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof fetchPatientDetailAction>>, { ok: true }>['data'];
type TabKey = 'profile' | 'intake' | 'assessment' | 'session';

const TABS: { key: TabKey; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'profile', label: 'Profil & Program' },
  { key: 'intake', label: 'Intake Awal' },
  { key: 'assessment', label: 'Assessment' },
  { key: 'session', label: 'Sesi' },
];

const ACTION_BUTTON =
  'h-10 sm:h-11 px-5 rounded-full text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0';
const ACTION_PRIMARY =
  'font-bold bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] shadow-2xs';
const ACTION_SECONDARY =
  'font-semibold bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] border border-stone-200/90';

function formatDate(value: Date | string | null, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) {
  if (!value) return '-';
  return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', options ?? { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
}

function genderLabel(value: string | null) {
  if (value === 'MALE') return 'Laki-laki';
  if (value === 'FEMALE') return 'Perempuan';
  if (value === 'OTHER') return 'Lainnya';
  return '-';
}

function statusLabel(value: string) {
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    SCHEDULED: 'Terjadwal',
    CONFIRMED: 'Terkonfirmasi',
    COMPLETED: 'Selesai',
    CANCELLED: 'Dibatalkan',
    RESCHEDULED: 'Dijadwalkan ulang',
    NO_SHOW: 'Tidak hadir',
  };
  return labels[value] ?? value;
}

function sessionTypeLabel(value: string) {
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    INITIAL_ASSESSMENT: 'Assessment Awal',
    THERAPY_SESSION: 'Sesi Terapi',
    FOLLOW_UP: 'Sesi Lanjutan',
    EVALUATION: 'Evaluasi Klinis',
    DISCHARGE: 'Pemeriksaan Akhir',
    CONSULTATION: 'Konsultasi',
  };
  return labels[value] ?? value;
}

function sessionStatusClass(value: string) {
  if (value === 'COMPLETED') return 'bg-[var(--hafta-grn-50)] text-[var(--hafta-grn-700)] border-[var(--hafta-grn-200)]';
  if (value === 'CANCELLED' || value === 'NO_SHOW') return 'bg-[var(--hafta-red-50)] text-[var(--hafta-red-700)] border-[var(--hafta-red-200)]';
  return 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)] border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)]';
}

function InfoRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200/80 bg-stone-50/40 p-3">
      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 break-words text-sm font-medium text-[#181700]">{value || '-'}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function MetricBars({ records, field, label }: { records: TherapyProgressView[]; field: 'painScore' | 'rangeOfMotionScore' | 'strengthScore' | 'functionScore'; label: string }) {
  const latest = records[records.length - 1];
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">{label}</p>
        <span className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">{latest ? `${latest[field]}/10` : '-'}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 flex h-12 items-end gap-1">
        {records.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="h-1 w-full rounded-full bg-stone-100" />
        ) : (
          records.slice(-10).map((record) => (
            <div
              key={record.id}
              className={cn(
                'flex-1 rounded-t-sm',
                field === 'painScore' ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-org-400)]' : 'bg-[var(--hafta-grn-500)]',
              )}
              style={{ height: `${Math.max(8, record[field] * 10)}%` }}
              title={`${formatDate(record.recordedAt)}: ${record[field]}/10`}
            />
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function PatientDetailDrawer({ isOpen, onClose, patientId }: { isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; patientId: string }) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabKey>('profile');
  const [rawData, setRawData] = useState<DetailData | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<{ patientId: string; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [editingRecord, setEditingRecord] = useState<TherapyProgressView | null>(null);
  const [creatingRecord, setCreatingRecord] = useState(false);
  const [reloadToken, setReloadToken] = useState(0);
  const [showProgramMenu, setShowProgramMenu] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    let active = true;

    fetchPatientDetailAction(patientId).then((result) => {
      if (!active) return;
      if (result.ok) {
        setRawData(result.data);
        setError(null);
      } else {
        setError({ patientId, message: result.error });
      }
    });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [isOpen, patientId, reloadToken]);

  const data = rawData?.patient.id === patientId ? rawData : null;
  const currentError = error?.patientId === patientId ? error.message : null;
  const patient = data?.patient;
  const progress = data?.progress ?? [];
  const chronologicalProgress = [...progress].sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(a.recordedAt).getTime() - new Date(b.recordedAt).getTime(),
  );
  const completedSessions = data?.sessions.filter((session) => session.status === 'COMPLETED').length ?? 0;
  const remainingSessions =
    data?.sessions.filter((session) => session.status === 'SCHEDULED' || session.status === 'CONFIRMED')
      .length ?? 0;
  const patientOptions = patient ? [{ id: patient.id, label: patient.fullName }] : [];

  function closeDrawer() {
    setActiveTab('profile');
    onClose();
  }

  return (
    <>
      <GlobalSlideOver
        isOpen={isOpen}
        onClose={closeDrawer}
        size="lg"
        icon={<UserRound className="h-5 w-5" />}
        title={patient?.fullName ?? 'Detail Pasien'}
        subtitle={
          patient
            ? `${patient.caseStatus} • ${data?.therapistName ?? 'Belum ada terapis'} • RM ${
                patient.medicalRecordNumber ?? 'Belum ditetapkan'
              }`
            : 'Memuat data pasien...'
        }
        headerTabs={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar" role="tablist" aria-label="Detail pasien">
            {TABS.map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.key}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={activeTab === tab.key}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.key)}
                className={cn(
                  'shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors',
                  activeTab === tab.key
                    ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700]'
                    : 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-200',
                )}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        }
        footer={
          data && patient ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full">
              {data.capabilities.canEditRecord ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCreatingRecord(true)}
                  className={cn(ACTION_BUTTON, ACTION_PRIMARY)}
                >
                  <FileText className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  Catat Assessment Baru
                </button>
              ) : <div />}

              <div className="relative">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label="Menu opsi program"
                  onClick={() => setShowProgramMenu((prev) => !prev)}
                  className="flex h-10 w-10 sm:h-11 sm:w-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-stone-200/90 bg-white text-[#181700] transition-colors hover:bg-stone-100 shadow-2xs"
                >
                  <MoreVertical className="h-4 w-4" />
                </button>

                {showProgramMenu && (
                  <>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-label="Tutup menu"
                      className="fixed inset-0 z-10 cursor-default"
                      onClick={() => setShowProgramMenu(false)}
                    />
                    <div className="absolute bottom-full right-0 z-20 mb-2 w-56 origin-bottom-right rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-2 shadow-xl">
                      {data.capabilities.canCreateAppointment ? (
                        <span onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                          <NewAppointmentButton
                            defaultPatientId={patient.id}
                            className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-stone-700 transition-colors hover:bg-stone-50 gap-2 bg-transparent border-0 shadow-none justify-start h-auto"
                          >
                            <CalendarPlus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-stone-500" />
                            <span>Jadwalkan Sesi Baru</span>
                          </NewAppointmentButton>
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                      {data.capabilities.canCompleteProgram &&
                      (patient.caseStatus === 'ACTIVE' || patient.caseStatus === 'ON_HOLD') ? (
                        <span onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                          <CompleteProgramButton
                            patientId={patient.id}
                            patientName={patient.fullName}
                            onCompleted={() => setReloadToken((token) => token + 1)}
                            className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-stone-700 transition-colors hover:bg-stone-50 gap-2 bg-transparent border-0 shadow-none justify-start h-auto"
                          />
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null
        }
      >
        {!data && !currentError ? (
          <div className="flex min-h-[420px] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 text-stone-500">
            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin" />
            <p className="text-sm">Memuat detail pasien...</p>
          </div>
        ) : currentError || !data || !patient ? (
          <div className="flex min-h-[420px] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-center">
            <UserRound className="h-9 w-9 text-stone-300" />
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#181700]">Data pasien tidak dapat dimuat</p>
            <p className="max-w-sm text-xs text-stone-500">{currentError ?? 'Silakan coba lagi.'}</p>
          </div>
        ) : activeTab === 'profile' ? (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <InfoRow label="Nomor Rekam Medis" value={patient.medicalRecordNumber ?? '-'} />
              <InfoRow label="Status Kasus" value={patient.caseStatus} />
              <InfoRow label="Jenis Kelamin" value={genderLabel(patient.gender)} />
              <InfoRow label="Tanggal Lahir" value={formatDate(patient.dateOfBirth)} />
              <InfoRow label="Pekerjaan" value={patient.occupation ?? '-'} />
              <InfoRow label="Telepon" value={data.phone ?? '-'} />
              <InfoRow label="Email" value={data.email ?? '-'} />
              <InfoRow label="Terapis" value={data.therapistName ?? '-'} />
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <InfoRow label="Alamat" value={patient.addressLine ?? '-'} />
              </div>
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <InfoRow
                  label="Kontak Darurat"
                  value={[patient.emergencyContactName, patient.emergencyContactRelationship, patient.emergencyContactPhone]
                    .filter(Boolean)
                    .join(' • ') || '-'}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5">
              <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                <ClipboardList className="h-4 w-4 text-stone-500" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Program Terapi</h3>
              </div>
              {data.capabilities.canEditSchedule ? (
                <TherapyScheduleForm
                  patientId={patient.id}
                  initialValues={{
                    nextTherapyAt: patient.nextTherapyAt,
                    therapyFrequencyText: patient.therapyFrequencyText,
                    therapyGoal: patient.therapyGoal,
                    therapistNote: patient.therapistNote,
                  }}
                />
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-3 text-sm text-stone-600">
                  <p>Tujuan: {patient.therapyGoal || '-'}</p>
                  <p>Frekuensi: {patient.therapyFrequencyText || '-'}</p>
                  <p>Kunjungan berikutnya: {formatDate(patient.nextTherapyAt)}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {patient.caseStatus === 'COMPLETED' ? (
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--hafta-grn-200)] bg-[var(--hafta-grn-50)]/60 p-4 sm:p-5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--hafta-grn-700)]" />
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Program Terapi Selesai</h3>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-stone-600">
                  {patient.caseCompletionSummary || 'Program terapi telah ditutup.'}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-stone-500">
                  Diselesaikan {formatDate(patient.caseCompletedAt)}
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ) : activeTab === 'intake' ? (
          data.intake ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-stone-50/50 p-4">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">Status intake</p>
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">{data.intake.status}</p>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">Dikirim {formatDate(data.intake.submittedAt)}</p>
              </div>
              {[
                ['Keluhan utama', data.intake.chiefComplaint],
                ['Area terdampak', data.intake.affectedArea],
                ['Awal keluhan', data.intake.onsetDescription],
                ['Pemicu', data.intake.triggeringEvent],
                ['Faktor memperberat', data.intake.aggravatingFactors],
                ['Faktor meringankan', data.intake.relievingFactors],
                ['Keterbatasan harian', data.intake.dailyLimitations],
                ['Riwayat cedera', data.intake.previousInjuryHistory],
                ['Riwayat operasi', data.intake.surgeryHistory],
                ['Riwayat medis', data.intake.relevantMedicalHistory],
                ['Obat saat ini', data.intake.currentMedication],
                ['Alergi', data.intake.allergies],
                ['Tujuan pasien', data.intake.patientGoal],
                ['Catatan review', data.intake.reviewMessage],
              ].map(([label, value]) => (
                <div key={label} className="rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-4">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">{label}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">{value || '-'}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex min-h-[360px] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-center">
              <ClipboardList className="h-9 w-9 text-stone-300" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#181700]">Belum ada intake awal</p>
              <p className="max-w-sm text-xs text-stone-500">Form intake akan tampil di sini setelah pasien mengirimkannya.</p>
            </div>
          )
        ) : activeTab === 'assessment' ? (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">{progress.length} catatan assessment</p>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <MetricBars records={chronologicalProgress} field="painScore" label="Nyeri (VAS)" />
              <MetricBars records={chronologicalProgress} field="rangeOfMotionScore" label="ROM" />
              <MetricBars records={chronologicalProgress} field="strengthScore" label="Kekuatan" />
              <MetricBars records={chronologicalProgress} field="functionScore" label="Fungsi" />
            </div>

            {progress.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex min-h-48 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-center">
                <Activity className="h-8 w-8 text-stone-300" />
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#181700]">Belum ada assessment</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">Catat assessment pertama untuk memulai pemantauan.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {progress.map((record) => (
                  <article key={record.id} className="rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-4">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">{formatDate(record.recordedAt)}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">Oleh {record.therapistName ?? '-'}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span
                          className={cn(
                            'rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold',
                            record.status === 'FINALIZED'
                              ? 'border-[var(--hafta-grn-200)] bg-[var(--hafta-grn-50)] text-[var(--hafta-grn-700)]'
                              : 'border-[var(--hafta-org-200)] bg-[var(--hafta-org-50)] text-[var(--hafta-org-700)]',
                          )}
                        >
                          {record.status === 'FINALIZED' ? 'Final' : 'Draft'}
                        </span>
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-stone-200 bg-stone-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-stone-600">
                          <Eye className="h-3 w-3" />
                          {record.patientVisible ? 'Pasien' : 'Internal'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-2 line-clamp-2 text-xs text-stone-600">{record.diagnosis || 'Belum ada diagnosis'}</p>
                    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="flex gap-3 font-mono text-[11px] text-stone-500">
                        <span>Nyeri {record.painScore}</span>
                        <span>ROM {record.rangeOfMotionScore}</span>
                        <span>Kuat {record.strengthScore}</span>
                        <span>Fungsi {record.functionScore}</span>
                      </div>
                      {data.capabilities.canEditRecord && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setEditingRecord(record)}
                          className={cn(ACTION_BUTTON, ACTION_SECONDARY)}
                        >
                          <Pencil className="h-3 w-3" />
                          Edit
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </article>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 sm:gap-3">
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-3 sm:p-4">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-stone-500 sm:text-xs">Total sesi</p>
                <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-xl font-bold text-[#181700] sm:text-2xl">{data.sessions.length}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-3 sm:p-4">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-stone-500 sm:text-xs">Sesi selesai</p>
                <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-xl font-bold text-[var(--hafta-grn-700)] sm:text-2xl">{completedSessions}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/60 p-3 sm:p-4">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-stone-500 sm:text-xs">Sisa sesi</p>
                <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-xl font-bold text-[#181700] sm:text-2xl">{remainingSessions}</p>
              </div>
            </div>


            {data.sessions.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex min-h-48 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-center">
                <CalendarPlus className="h-8 w-8 text-stone-300" />
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#181700]">Belum ada sesi</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">Jadwalkan sesi terapi pertama untuk pasien ini.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {data.sessions
                  .slice()
                  .sort(
                    (a, b) =>
                      new Date(a.scheduledDate).getTime() - new Date(b.scheduledDate).getTime(),
                  )
                  .map((session, index) => (
                    <article key={session.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-4">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Kunjungan Ke-{index + 1}</p>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-stone-500">
                          {formatDate(session.scheduledDate)} • {session.startTime} • {session.durationMinutes} menit • {session.therapistName ?? '-'}
                        </p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-stone-600">{sessionTypeLabel(session.type)}</p>
                      </div>
                      <span className={cn('rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold', sessionStatusClass(session.status))}>
                        {statusLabel(session.status)}
                      </span>
                    </article>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </GlobalSlideOver>

      <MedicalRecordFormDrawer
        isOpen={creatingRecord}
        onClose={() => setCreatingRecord(false)}
        patientOptions={patientOptions}
        defaultPatientId={patientId}
        onSaved={() => setReloadToken((token) => token + 1)}
      />
      <MedicalRecordFormDrawer
        isOpen={Boolean(editingRecord)}
        onClose={() => setEditingRecord(null)}
        record={editingRecord}
        patientOptions={patientOptions}
        onSaved={() => setReloadToken((token) => token + 1)}
      />
    </>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/dashboard/appointment-create-form.tsx">
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Select } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { DatePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker';
import { useToast } from '@/components/ui/toast';
import { createAppointment } from '@/server/actions/appointments';

type SelectOption = { id: string; label: string };

const PERIOD_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  pagi: 'Pagi',
  siang: 'Siang',
  sore: 'Sore',
  malam: 'Malam',
};

const TIME_OPTIONS: { period: string; value: string; label: string }[] = [];

for (let hour = 8; hour <= 21; hour++) {
  for (const minute of [0, 30]) {
    const value = `${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    let period: string;
    if (hour < 12) period = 'pagi';
    else if (hour < 15) period = 'siang';
    else if (hour < 19) period = 'sore';
    else period = 'malam';
    TIME_OPTIONS.push({ period, value, label: `${value} ${PERIOD_LABEL[period]}` });
  }
}

export function AppointmentCreateForm({
  patientOptions,
  therapistOptions,
  defaultPatientId,
  defaultDate,
  defaultTime,
  onSuccess,
  onCancel,
  formId,
  onPendingChange,
}: {
  patientOptions: SelectOption[];
  therapistOptions: SelectOption[];
  defaultPatientId?: string;
  defaultDate?: string;
  defaultTime?: string;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
  formId?: string;
  onPendingChange?: (pending: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [scheduledDate, setScheduledDate] = useState(defaultDate ?? '');
  const router = useRouter();
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    onPendingChange?.(pending);
  }, [onPendingChange, pending]);

  function onSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget);

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await createAppointment({
          patientId: String(formData.get('patientId') ?? ''),
          therapistId: String(formData.get('therapistId') ?? ''),
          scheduledDate: String(formData.get('scheduledDate') ?? ''),
          startTime: String(formData.get('startTime') ?? ''),
          durationMinutes: Number(formData.get('durationMinutes') ?? 60),
          type: String(formData.get('type') ?? 'THERAPY_SESSION') as
            'INITIAL_ASSESSMENT' | 'THERAPY_SESSION' | 'FOLLOW_UP' | 'EVALUATION',
          administrativeNote: String(formData.get('administrativeNote') ?? ''),
        });
        showToast('success', 'Appointment berhasil dibuat.');
        router.refresh();
        if (onSuccess) {
          onSuccess();
        } else {
          router.push('/dashboard/appointments');
        }
      } catch {
        showToast('error', 'Appointment tidak dapat dibuat. Periksa data, scope pasien, dan jadwal terapis.');
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <form id={formId} onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-5">
      <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="patientId">Pasien</Label>
          <Select
            id="patientId"
            name="patientId"
            required
            defaultValue={defaultPatientId ?? ''}
            disabled={pending || patientOptions.length === 0}
          >
            <option value="">Pilih pasien</option>
            {patientOptions.map((patient) => (
              <option key={patient.id} value={patient.id}>
                {patient.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="therapistId">Terapis</Label>
          <Select id="therapistId" name="therapistId" required disabled={pending || therapistOptions.length === 0}>
            <option value="">Pilih terapis</option>
            {therapistOptions.map((therapist) => (
              <option key={therapist.id} value={therapist.id}>
                {therapist.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="scheduledDate">Tanggal</Label>
          <input type="hidden" name="scheduledDate" value={scheduledDate} required />
          <DatePicker
            id="scheduledDate"
            value={scheduledDate}
            onChange={setScheduledDate}
            disabled={pending}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="startTime">Waktu Mulai</Label>
          <Select id="startTime" name="startTime" required disabled={pending} defaultValue={defaultTime ?? ''}>
            <option value="">Pilih jam</option>
            {(['pagi', 'siang', 'sore', 'malam'] as const).map((period) => (
              <optgroup key={period} label={PERIOD_LABEL[period]}>
                {TIME_OPTIONS.filter((t) => t.period === period).map((t) => (
                  <option key={t.value} value={t.value}>
                    {t.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </optgroup>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="durationMinutes">Durasi</Label>
          <Select id="durationMinutes" name="durationMinutes" defaultValue="60" disabled={pending}>
            <option value="">Pilih durasi</option>
            {[15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120].map((min) => (
              <option key={min} value={min}>
                {min} menit
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="type">Jenis</Label>
          <Select id="type" name="type" disabled={pending}>
            <option value="INITIAL_ASSESSMENT">Assessment Awal</option>
            <option value="THERAPY_SESSION">Sesi Terapi</option>
            <option value="FOLLOW_UP">Tindak Lanjut</option>
            <option value="EVALUATION">Evaluasi</option>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="administrativeNote">Catatan Administratif</Label>
        <textarea
          id="administrativeNote"
          name="administrativeNote"
          disabled={pending}
          className="flex min-h-28 w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm leading-relaxed focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent"
        />
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/dashboard/dashboard-charts.tsx">
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  CalendarCheck2,
  Activity,
  ClipboardList,
  CheckCircle2,
  TrendingUp,
  TrendingDown,
  ChevronRight,
  ChevronDown,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { DashboardStats } from '@/server/queries/dashboard-stats';

// Warna per patient status — patuh 100% pada CSS Variables :root Hafta
const PATIENT_STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  INTAKE: 'var(--hafta-ble-500, #3365e7)',      // Pasien Baru / Portal
  ACTIVE: 'var(--hafta-ylw-200, #e3db00)',      // Dalam Terapi / Utama
  COMPLETED: 'var(--hafta-grn-500, #21891a)',   // Selesai
  REFERRED: '#8b5cf6',
  ON_HOLD: 'var(--hafta-org-400, #e7660f)',     // Menunggu / Ditunda
  ARCHIVED: '#9CA3AF',
};

// Warna per appointment status — patuh 100% pada CSS Variables :root Hafta
const APPT_STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  SCHEDULED: 'var(--hafta-ylw-200, #e3db00)',   // Terjadwal
  IN_PROGRESS: 'var(--hafta-grn-500, #21891a)', // Hadir
  CANCELLED: 'var(--hafta-red-500, #cb2b2b)',   // Dibatalkan
  NO_SHOW: '#94a3b8',
  COMPLETED: '#181700',                         // Selesai
  RESCHEDULED: 'var(--hafta-org-400, #e7660f)',
};

import {
  Area,
  AreaChart,
  Bar,
  BarChart,
  CartesianGrid,
  Cell,
  Pie,
  PieChart,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from 'recharts';

function labelPatient(value: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    INTAKE: 'Baru',
    ACTIVE: 'Dalam Terapi',
    ON_HOLD: 'Ditunda',
    COMPLETED: 'Selesai',
    REFERRED: 'Rujukan',
    ARCHIVED: 'Arsip',
  };
  return map[value] ?? value;
}

function labelAppt(value: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    SCHEDULED: 'Terjadwal',
    IN_PROGRESS: 'Hadir',
    CANCELLED: 'Batal',
    NO_SHOW: 'Absen',
    COMPLETED: 'Selesai',
    RESCHEDULED: 'Jadwal Ulang',
  };
  return map[value] ?? value;
}

function SparklineChart({ data, color = 'var(--hafta-ylw-200)' }: { data: { day: string; count: number }[]; color?: string }) {
  if (data.length === 0) return null;
  const id = `spark-${color.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`;
  return (
    <div className="h-9 w-full">
      <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
        <AreaChart data={data} margin={{ top: 2, right: 0, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}>
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id={id} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="5%" stopColor={color} stopOpacity={0.25} />
              <stop offset="95%" stopColor={color} stopOpacity={0} />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          <Area type="monotone" dataKey="count" stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.5} fill={`url(#${id})`} dot={false} />
        </AreaChart>
      </ResponsiveContainer>
    </div>
  );
}

export function DashboardCharts({ initialStats, role }: { initialStats: DashboardStats; role?: string }) {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<DashboardStats>(initialStats);
  const [, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    async function refresh() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/dashboard/stats', { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('failed');
        const data = (await res.json()) as DashboardStats;
        if (active) { setStats(data); setError(null); }
      } catch {
        if (active) setError('Gagal memuat data.');
      }
    }
    refresh();
    const id = window.setInterval(refresh, 10_000);
    return () => { active = false; window.clearInterval(id); };
  }, []);

  const patientChart = stats.patientsByStatus.map((r) => ({
    name: labelPatient(r.status),
    value: r.count,
    color: PATIENT_STATUS_COLORS[r.status] ?? '#9CA3AF',
  }));

  const appointmentChart = stats.appointmentsByStatus.map((r) => ({
    name: labelAppt(r.status),
    value: r.count,
    color: APPT_STATUS_COLORS[r.status] ?? '#9CA3AF',
  }));

  const trend = stats.appointmentsTrend;
  const isGlobal = role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' || role === 'ADMIN';
  const patientTotal = Math.max(patientChart.reduce((s, c) => s + c.value, 0), 1);

  // 4 KPI cards dengan warna yang 100% konsisten ke tema Hafta
  const kpiCards = [
    {
      label: isGlobal ? 'Total Janji Temu' : 'Jadwal Saya',
      value: stats.kpis.totalAppointments,
      icon: CalendarCheck2,
      iconBg: 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]',
      iconColor: 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-950)]',
      trend: '+12%',
      trendUp: true,
      trendLabel: 'vs minggu lalu',
      sparkData: trend,
      sparkColor: '#e3db00',
      href: '/dashboard/appointments',
    },
    {
      label: isGlobal ? 'Pasien Aktif' : 'Pasien Terhubung',
      value: stats.kpis.activePatients,
      icon: Activity,
      iconBg: 'bg-[var(--hafta-grn-50)]',
      iconColor: 'text-[var(--hafta-grn-600)]',
      trend: '+5%',
      trendUp: true,
      trendLabel: 'dalam terapi',
      sparkData: trend.slice(-7),
      sparkColor: '#21891a',
      href: '/dashboard/patients',
    },
    {
      label: 'Intake Menunggu',
      value: stats.kpis.submittedIntakes,
      icon: ClipboardList,
      iconBg: 'bg-[var(--hafta-org-50)]',
      iconColor: 'text-[var(--hafta-org-600)]',
      trend: 'Perlu Asesmen',
      trendUp: false,
      trendLabel: 'status terkirim',
      sparkData: [] as { day: string; count: number }[],
      sparkColor: '#e7660f',
      href: '/dashboard/intake',
    },
    {
      label: isGlobal ? 'Kasus Selesai (Klinik)' : 'Kasus Saya Selesai',
      value: stats.kpis.completedCases,
      icon: CheckCircle2,
      iconBg: 'bg-[var(--hafta-ble-50)]',
      iconColor: 'text-[var(--hafta-ble-600)]',
      trend: 'Optimal',
      trendUp: true,
      trendLabel: 'bulan ini',
      sparkData: [] as { day: string; count: number }[],
      sparkColor: '#3365e7',
      href: '/dashboard/progress',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* ── 4 KPI CARDS INTERAKTIF DENGAN HOVER FEEDBACK HALUS ── */}
      <div className="grid gap-3.5 grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {kpiCards.map((kpi) => (
          <Link
            key={kpi.label}
            href={kpi.href}
            className="group relative flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer"
          >
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                <div className={`flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl shadow-2xs ${kpi.iconBg} ${kpi.iconColor}`}>
                  <kpi.icon className="h-5 w-5" />
                </div>
                <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-stone-300 transition-colors group-hover:text-[#181700]" />
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3.5">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-500 leading-tight">
                  {kpi.label}
                </p>
                <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-2">
                  <p className="font-mono text-2xl sm:text-[28px] font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#181700] leading-none">
                    {kpi.value}
                  </p>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-stone-600">
                    {kpi.trendUp ? <TrendingUp className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-600" /> : <TrendingDown className="h-3 w-3 text-stone-400" />}
                    {kpi.trend}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-stone-400">{kpi.trendLabel}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Sparkline mini */}
            {kpi.sparkData.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-stone-100">

      {/* ── 3 CHARTS DALAM 1 BARIS (Tren 2-kolom, Donut 1-kolom, Bar 1-kolom) ── */}

              <div>

                <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">

                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <span className="rounded-lg border border-stone-200 bg-stone-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-stone-600">
              14 Hari Terakhir
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 min-h-[180px]">
            {trend.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full min-h-[180px] text-xs text-stone-400">
                Belum ada data janji temu.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">

                  <defs>

                      <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#e3db00" stopOpacity={0.3} />

                  </defs>
                  <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#F1F5F9" vertical={false} />
                  <XAxis dataKey="day" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: '#94a3b8' }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} interval={1} />

                  <Tooltip
                    contentStyle={{ borderRadius: '12px', backgroundColor: '#fff', border: '1px solid #E5E7EB', boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)', fontSize: '12px' }}
                    itemStyle={{ color: '#181700', fontWeight: 600 }}
                  />
                  <Area
                    type="monotone"
                    dataKey="count"
                    stroke="#181700"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    dot={{ r: 3, fill: '#e3db00', strokeWidth: 1, stroke: '#181700' }}
                    activeDot={{ r: 5, strokeWidth: 2, stroke: '#fff', fill: '#181700' }}
                    fill="url(#trendFill)"
                    name="Janji Temu"
                  />
                </AreaChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Chart 2: Status Pasien (Donut) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-1 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 mb-4">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--hafta-ble-50)] text-[var(--hafta-ble-600)] shadow-2xs">
              <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.25}>
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M11 3.055A9.001 9.001 0 1020.945 13H11V3.055z" />
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M20.488 9H15V3.512A9.025 9.025 0 0120.488 9z" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#181700] sm:text-sm">Status Pasien</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">Komposisi klinik</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 min-h-[190px]">
            <div className="relative h-[110px] w-[110px] shrink-0">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <PieChart>
                  <Pie
                    data={patientChart.length > 0 ? patientChart : [{ name: 'Kosong', value: 1, color: '#E5E7EB' }]}
                    dataKey="value"
                    nameKey="name"
                    innerRadius={34}
                    outerRadius={52}
                    paddingAngle={patientChart.length > 1 ? 3 : 0}
                    strokeWidth={0}
                    startAngle={90}
                    endAngle={-270}
                  >
                    {(patientChart.length > 0 ? patientChart : [{ name: 'Kosong', value: 1, color: '#E5E7EB' }]).map((entry) => (
                      <Cell key={entry.name} fill={entry.color} />
                    ))}
                  </Pie>
                </PieChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                <span className="font-mono text-lg font-bold text-[#181700] leading-none">
                  {patientChart.reduce((s, c) => s + c.value, 0)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[9px] text-stone-400 mt-0.5">Pasien</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="w-full space-y-1">
              {patientChart.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.name} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: item.color }} />
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-stone-600 flex-1 truncate">{item.name}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-[#181700] shrink-0">
                    {item.value} <span className="font-normal text-stone-400">({Math.round((item.value / patientTotal) * 100)}%)</span>
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Chart 3: Status Janji Temu (Bar) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-1 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 mb-4">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--hafta-grn-50)] text-[var(--hafta-grn-600)] shadow-2xs">
              <CalendarCheck2 className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#181700] sm:text-sm">Status Sesi</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">Distribusi jadwal</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 min-h-[190px]">
            {appointmentChart.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full min-h-[190px] text-xs text-stone-400">
                Belum ada data sesi.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <BarChart data={appointmentChart} margin={{ top: 5, right: 4, left: -22, bottom: 0 }}>
                  <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#F1F5F9" vertical={false} />
                  <XAxis dataKey="name" tick={{ fontSize: 8, fill: '#94a3b8' }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} interval={0} />
