<file path="components/dashboard/appointment-edit-form.tsx">
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Select } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { DatePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker';
import { useToast } from '@/components/ui/toast';
import { updateAppointment } from '@/server/actions/appointments';
import type { AppointmentDetail } from '@/server/queries/appointments';

type SelectOption = { id: string; label: string };

const PERIOD_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  pagi: 'Pagi',
  siang: 'Siang',
  sore: 'Sore',
  malam: 'Malam',
};

const TIME_OPTIONS: { period: string; value: string; label: string }[] = [];

for (let hour = 8; hour <= 21; hour++) {
  for (const minute of [0, 30]) {
    const value = `${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    let period: string;
    if (hour < 12) period = 'pagi';
    else if (hour < 15) period = 'siang';
    else if (hour < 19) period = 'sore';
    else period = 'malam';
    TIME_OPTIONS.push({ period, value, label: `${value} ${PERIOD_LABEL[period]}` });
  }
}

export function AppointmentEditForm({
  appointment,
  therapistOptions,
  formId,
  onSuccess,
  onCancel,
  onPendingChange,
}: {
  appointment: AppointmentDetail;
  therapistOptions: SelectOption[];
  formId?: string;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
  onPendingChange?: (pending: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [scheduledDate, setScheduledDate] = useState(
    appointment.scheduledDate ? appointment.scheduledDate.split('T')[0].split(' ')[0] : '',
  );
  const router = useRouter();
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const startTimeValue = (appointment.startTime ?? '').slice(0, 5);

  useEffect(() => {
    onPendingChange?.(pending);
  }, [onPendingChange, pending]);

  function onSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget);

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await updateAppointment({
          appointmentId: appointment.id,
          patientId: String(formData.get('patientId') ?? ''),
          therapistId: String(formData.get('therapistId') ?? ''),
          scheduledDate: String(formData.get('scheduledDate') ?? ''),
          startTime: String(formData.get('startTime') ?? ''),
          durationMinutes: Number(formData.get('durationMinutes') ?? 60),
          type: String(formData.get('type') ?? 'THERAPY_SESSION') as
            'INITIAL_ASSESSMENT' | 'THERAPY_SESSION' | 'FOLLOW_UP' | 'EVALUATION',
          administrativeNote: String(formData.get('administrativeNote') ?? ''),
        });
        showToast('success', 'Appointment berhasil diperbarui.');
        router.refresh();
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
        else router.push('/dashboard/appointments');
      } catch {
        showToast('error', 'Appointment tidak dapat diperbarui. Periksa data, scope pasien, dan jadwal terapis.');
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <form id={formId} onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-5">
      <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label>Pasien</Label>
          <input type="hidden" name="patientId" value={appointment.patientId} />
          <div className="flex h-10 w-full items-center rounded-xl border border-stone-300 bg-stone-100 px-3 text-sm text-stone-500">
            {appointment.patientName}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="therapistId">Terapis</Label>
          <Select
            id="therapistId"
            name="therapistId"
            required
            defaultValue={appointment.therapistId}
            disabled={pending || therapistOptions.length === 0}
          >
            <option value="">Pilih terapis</option>
            {therapistOptions.map((therapist) => (
              <option key={therapist.id} value={therapist.id}>
                {therapist.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="scheduledDate">Tanggal</Label>
          <input type="hidden" name="scheduledDate" value={scheduledDate} required />
          <DatePicker
            id="scheduledDate"
            value={scheduledDate}
            onChange={setScheduledDate}
            disabled={pending}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="startTime">Waktu Mulai</Label>
          <Select
            id="startTime"
            name="startTime"
            required
            defaultValue={startTimeValue}
            disabled={pending}
          >
            <option value="">Pilih jam</option>
            {(['pagi', 'siang', 'sore', 'malam'] as const).map((period) => (
              <optgroup key={period} label={PERIOD_LABEL[period]}>
                {TIME_OPTIONS.filter((t) => t.period === period).map((t) => (
                  <option key={t.value} value={t.value}>
                    {t.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </optgroup>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="durationMinutes">Durasi</Label>
          <Select
            id="durationMinutes"
            name="durationMinutes"
            defaultValue={String(appointment.durationMinutes)}
            required
            disabled={pending}
          >
            <option value="">Pilih durasi</option>
            {[15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120].map((min) => (
              <option key={min} value={min}>
                {min} menit
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="type">Jenis</Label>
          <Select
            id="type"
            name="type"
            defaultValue={appointment.type}
            disabled={pending}
          >
            <option value="INITIAL_ASSESSMENT">Assessment Awal</option>
            <option value="THERAPY_SESSION">Sesi Terapi</option>
            <option value="FOLLOW_UP">Tindak Lanjut</option>
            <option value="EVALUATION">Evaluasi</option>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="administrativeNote">Catatan Administratif</Label>
        <textarea
          id="administrativeNote"
          name="administrativeNote"
          disabled={pending}
          defaultValue={appointment.administrativeNote ?? ''}
          className="flex min-h-28 w-full resize-none rounded-xl border border-stone-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#181700] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#181700] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#f7f000]/30"
        />
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

<file path="components/dashboard/notification-bell.tsx">
'use client';

import { useState, useTransition, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  Bell,
  ChevronRight,
  FileText,
  ClipboardCheck,
  Mail,
  MessageSquareQuote,
  AlertCircle,
  CalendarDays,
  Users,
  Lock,
  ShieldCheck,
  Activity,
  LucideIcon,
  CheckCheck,
} from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { GlobalSlideOver } from '@/components/ui/global-slide-over';
import { markAllNotificationsAsRead, markNotificationAsRead } from '@/server/actions/notifications';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export type NotificationView = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  message: string | null;
  actionUrl: string | null;
  isRead: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
};

function timeAgo(date: Date): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
  const mins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
  const hours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
  const days = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);

  if (mins < 1) return 'Baru saja';
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m lalu`;
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}j lalu`;
  if (days < 7) return `${days}h lalu`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
}

function getNotificationIcon(title: string, message?: string | null): LucideIcon {
  const t = `${title} ${message ?? ''}`.toLowerCase();
  if (t.includes('janji') || t.includes('appointment') || t.includes('jadwal') || t.includes('sesi')) return CalendarDays;
  if (t.includes('intake') || t.includes('form awal') || t.includes('asesmen') || t.includes('evaluasi') || t.includes('rekam')) return ClipboardCheck;
  if (t.includes('pasien') || t.includes('patient') || t.includes('pengguna') || t.includes('user')) return Users;
  if (t.includes('katasandi') || t.includes('kata sandi') || t.includes('password') || t.includes('keamanan') || t.includes('sesi')) return Lock;
  if (t.includes('profil') || t.includes('diperbarui') || t.includes('verifikasi') || t.includes('akun')) return ShieldCheck;
  if (t.includes('progress') || t.includes('terapi') || t.includes('penanganan') || t.includes('layanan')) return Activity;
  if (t.includes('file') || t.includes('laporan') || t.includes('report') || t.includes('dokumen')) return FileText;
  if (t.includes('pesan') || t.includes('email') || t.includes('surat') || t.includes('notifikasi')) return Mail;
  if (t.includes('komentar') || t.includes('comment') || t.includes('catatan') || t.includes('pesan perbaikan')) return MessageSquareQuote;
  return AlertCircle;
}

export function NotificationBell({
  unreadCount = 0,
  initialNotifications = [],
}: {
  unreadCount?: number;
  initialNotifications?: NotificationView[];
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'all' | 'unread'>('all');
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<NotificationView[]>(initialNotifications);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(unreadCount);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const refreshNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/notifications', { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const data = await res.json();
      setNotifications(
        data.notifications.map((n: any) => ({
          ...n,
          createdAt: new Date(n.createdAt),
        }))
      );
      setCount(data.unreadCount);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setInterval(refreshNotifications, 15000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [refreshNotifications]);

  const isNotificationPage = pathname === '/dashboard/notifications';
  const isDrawerOpen = open && !isNotificationPage;

  function markAll() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await markAllNotificationsAsRead();
        setCount(0);
        setNotifications((current) => current.map((n) => ({ ...n, isRead: true })));
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    });
  }

  function markRead(id: string) {
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await markNotificationAsRead(id);
        setNotifications((current) => current.map((n) => (n.id === id ? { ...n, isRead: true } : n)));
        setCount((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    });
  }

  const filtered = tab === 'unread' ? notifications.filter((n) => !n.isRead) : notifications;

  return (
    <>
      {/* Topbar Bell Icon Button */}
      <Button
        size="icon"
        onClick={() => {
          if (pathname !== '/dashboard/notifications') setOpen(true);
        }}
        className="group relative h-10 w-10 rounded-full bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] hover:bg-stone-200/80 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        aria-label="Buka notifikasi"
      >
        <Bell size={18} strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden="true" className="text-[#181700]" />
        {count > 0 && (
          <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-4.5 min-w-[18px] items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-red-500)] px-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold leading-none text-white shadow-xs">
            {count > 99 ? '99+' : count}
          </span>
        )}
      </Button>

      {/* ── UNIFIED GLOBAL STATIC OVERLAY DRAWER ── */}
      <GlobalSlideOver
        isOpen={isDrawerOpen}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        size="sm"
        icon={<Bell className="h-5 w-5" />}
        title="Notifikasi"
        subtitle={`${count} pesan belum dibaca`}
        headerTabs={
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTab('all')}
                className={cn(
                  'rounded-full px-3.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer',
                  tab === 'all'
                    ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700] shadow-2xs'
                    : 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-200/70'
                )}
              >
                Semua
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTab('unread')}
                className={cn(
                  'rounded-full px-3.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer',
                  tab === 'unread'
                    ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700] shadow-2xs'
                    : 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-200/70'
                )}
              >
                Belum Dibaca
              </button>
            </div>

            {count > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={markAll}
                disabled={pending}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-stone-600 hover:text-[#181700] transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <CheckCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Tandai Semua</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        }
        footer={
          <Link
            href="/dashboard/notifications"
            onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
            className="text-xs font-bold text-[#181700] hover:underline"
          >
            Buka Halaman Notifikasi Lengkap &rarr;
          </Link>
        }
      >
        {/* Notification Items List */}
        <div className="divide-y divide-stone-100 -mx-1">
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex min-h-[220px] flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-4 py-8">
              <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[#181700]">
                <Bell className="h-6 w-6" />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-3 text-xs font-bold text-[#181700]">Tidak ada notifikasi</p>
              <p className="mt-1 max-w-xs text-[11px] text-stone-400">
                Semua notifikasi pembaruan jadwal dan klinis Anda akan muncul di sini.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            filtered.map((item) => {
              const Icon = getNotificationIcon(item.title, item.message);
              return (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  onClick={() => !item.isRead && markRead(item.id)}
                  className={cn(
                    'group relative flex items-start gap-3.5 p-3.5 rounded-2xl transition-colors cursor-pointer',
                    item.isRead ? 'hover:bg-stone-50' : 'bg-[#FEFEF6] hover:bg-stone-50/90'
                  )}
                >
                  {/* Icon */}
                  <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-stone-100 text-stone-700 mt-0.5">
                    <Icon className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
                  </div>

                  {/* Text Content */}
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <p className={cn('text-xs font-bold truncate', item.isRead ? 'text-stone-700' : 'text-[#181700]')}>
                        {item.title}
                      </p>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-stone-400 shrink-0">
                        {timeAgo(item.createdAt)}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {item.message && (
                      <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-stone-600">
                        {item.message}
                      </p>
                    )}

                    {item.actionUrl && (
                      <div className="mt-2.5">
                        <Link
                          href={item.actionUrl}
                          onClick={() => {
                            if (!item.isRead) markRead(item.id);
                            setOpen(false);
                          }}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-[#181700] hover:underline"
                        >
                          <span>Lihat Rincian</span>
                          <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3" />
                        </Link>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Unread Dot Indicator */}
                  {!item.isRead && (
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-400)] mt-1.5" />
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </GlobalSlideOver>
    </>
  );
}

<file path="components/patient/patient-profile-form.tsx">
'use client';

import { useRef, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useForm, Controller } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Camera, ChevronDown, User } from 'lucide-react';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Select } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { DatePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker';
import { updateCurrentPatientProfile } from '@/server/actions/patient-profile';
import type { PatientProfileInput } from '@/lib/validators/patient-profile';
import { useWilayahIndonesia } from '@/lib/use-wilayah-indonesia';

export function PatientProfileForm({
  initialValues,
  email,
  initialAvatarUrl,
}: {
  initialValues: Partial<PatientProfileInput>;
  email: string;
  initialAvatarUrl?: string | null;
}) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [avatarPreview, setAvatarPreview] = useState<string | null>(initialAvatarUrl ?? null);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const {
    provinces,
    regencies,
    setSelectedProvinceId,
    loadingProvinces,
    loadingRegencies,
  } = useWilayahIndonesia();

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setValue,
    control,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitSuccessful },
    setError,
  } = useForm<PatientProfileInput>({ defaultValues: initialValues });

  function onAvatarChange(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setError('root', { message: 'Ukuran foto maksimal 2MB.' });
      return;
    }
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      setError('root', { message: 'Format foto harus JPG, PNG, atau WebP.' });
      return;
    }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      const dataUrl = String(reader.result ?? '');
      setAvatarPreview(dataUrl);
      setValue('avatarKey', dataUrl, { shouldDirty: true });
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  return (
    <form
      className="space-y-8"
      onSubmit={handleSubmit((data) =>
        startTransition(async () => {
          try {
            await updateCurrentPatientProfile(data);
          } catch {
            setError('root', { message: 'Data profil tidak dapat disimpan. Periksa isian lalu coba lagi.' });
          }
        }),
      )}
    >
      {isSubmitSuccessful ? (
        <Alert variant="success">
          <AlertDescription>Data profil berhasil disimpan.</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}
      {errors.root ? (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{errors.root.message}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}
      <section className="space-y-5">

<file path="lib/auth/index.ts">
import { betterAuth } from 'better-auth';
import { drizzleAdapter } from 'better-auth/adapters/drizzle';
import { getDb } from '@/db';
import { accounts, sessions, users, verifications } from '@/db/schema';

function createAuth() {
  return betterAuth({
    database: drizzleAdapter(getDb(), {
      provider: 'pg',
      schema: {
        user: users,
        session: sessions,
        account: accounts,
        verification: verifications,
      },
    }),
    emailAndPassword: {
      enabled: true,
      requireEmailVerification: false,
    },
    username: {
      enabled: true,
    },
    advanced: {
      database: {
        generateId: false,
      },
    },
    session: {
      expiresIn: 60 * 60 * 24 * 7,
      updateAge: 60 * 60 * 24,
    },
    trustedOrigins: [process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'],
  });
}

type AuthInstance = ReturnType<typeof createAuth>;

let _auth: AuthInstance | null = null;

// Lazily initialize so `next build` never evaluates a database connection.
export function getAuth(): AuthInstance {
  if (!_auth) {
    _auth = createAuth();
  }
  return _auth;
}

export type Session = AuthInstance['$Infer']['Session'];
</file>

export default async function AppointmentsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ page?: string; status?: string; q?: string }>;
}) {
  const { role } = await requireSession({ redirectToLogin: true });
  await requirePermission(PERMISSIONS.APPOINTMENT_LIST);

  if (role === 'USER') {
    const [appointments, requests, availability, holidays] = await Promise.all([
      getPatientPortalAppointments(),
      getPatientAppointmentRequests(),
      getPatientBookingAvailability(),
      getIndonesianHolidays(new Date().getFullYear()).catch(() => []),
    ]);

    return (
      <div className="space-y-6 pb-24 lg:pb-6">
        <DashboardPageHeader
          title="Jadwal Terapi"
          description="Lihat sesi terapi Anda, temukan slot fisioterapis yang tersedia, lalu ajukan jadwal baru. Pengajuan akan dikonfirmasi oleh tim Hafta."
          breadcrumbs={[{ label: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard' }, { label: 'Jadwal' }]}
        />
        <PatientTherapyCalendar
          appointments={appointments}
          availability={availability}
          requests={requests}
          holidays={holidays}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const params = await searchParams;
  const page = Number(params.page) || 1;
  const activeStatus = params.status || 'ALL';
  const query = params.q?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';

  const canCreate = hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.APPOINTMENT_CREATE);
  const canReview = hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.APPOINTMENT_UPDATE);
  const canManageSchedule =
    hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.APPOINTMENT_UPDATE) ||
    hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE);
  const [result, formOptions, pendingRequests, scheduleOverview] = await Promise.all([
    getScopedAppointments(page, 6),
    canCreate
      ? getAppointmentFormOptions().catch(() => ({ patientOptions: [], therapistOptions: [] }))
      : Promise.resolve({ patientOptions: [], therapistOptions: [] }),
    canReview ? getPendingAppointmentRequests().catch(() => []) : Promise.resolve([]),
    canManageSchedule ? getTherapistScheduleOverview().catch(() => []) : Promise.resolve([]),
  ]);

  // Filter lokal status & query
  const filteredItems = result.items.filter((item) => {
    if (activeStatus !== 'ALL' && item.status !== activeStatus) return false;
    if (query) {
      const matchName = item.patientName.toLowerCase().includes(query);
      const matchType = item.type.toLowerCase().includes(query);
      const matchTherapist = item.therapistName?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ?? false;
      if (!matchName && !matchType && !matchTherapist) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  const countByStatus = {
    ALL: result.items.length,
    SCHEDULED: result.items.filter((i) => i.status === 'SCHEDULED').length,
    COMPLETED: result.items.filter((i) => i.status === 'COMPLETED').length,
    CANCELLED: result.items.filter((i) => i.status === 'CANCELLED').length,
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-24 lg:pb-6">
      <DashboardPageHeader
        title="Jadwal Terapi"
        description="Kelola jadwal janji temu dan pantau ketersediaan sesi terapi."
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard' },
          { label: 'Jadwal' },
        ]}
        icon={<CalendarDays className="h-6 w-6 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]" />}
        action={
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 w-full sm:w-auto sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
            {/* Mobile Row 1: View Switcher full width */}
            <ViewSwitcher />

            {/* Row 2 (mobile): Appointment button + Jadwal Kerja Saya grid */}
            {/* Row 1 (desktop): Jadwal Kerja Saya + Switcher + Buat Appointment side by side */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 w-full sm:flex sm:w-auto sm:items-center sm:justify-end">
              {canCreate ? (
                <NewAppointmentButton
                  patientOptions={formOptions.patientOptions}
                  therapistOptions={formOptions.therapistOptions}
                  className="h-11 px-3 sm:px-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] border border-transparent text-[#181700] text-xs sm:text-[13px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                >
                  <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> Buat Appointment
                </NewAppointmentButton>
              ) : null}
              {scheduleOverview.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="w-full sm:w-auto">
                  <TherapistSchedulePanel
                    therapists={scheduleOverview}
                    label={role === 'THERAPIST' ? 'Jadwal Kerja Saya' : 'Jadwal Kerja Terapis'}
                  />
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        }
      />

      {canReview ? <AppointmentRequestQueue requests={pendingRequests} /> : null}

      {/* ── FILTER & CONTROL TOOLBAR ── */}
      <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        {/* Status Filter Tabs */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 w-full sm:flex sm:flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          <Link
            href="/dashboard/appointments?status=ALL"
            className={cn(
              'rounded-xl px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap',
              activeStatus === 'ALL'
                ? 'bg-[#181700] text-white shadow-2xs'
                : 'border border-stone-200 bg-white text-stone-600 hover:border-stone-300'
            )}
          >
            Semua ({countByStatus.ALL})
          </Link>
          <Link
            href="/dashboard/appointments?status=SCHEDULED"
            className={cn(
              'rounded-xl px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap',
              activeStatus === 'SCHEDULED'
                ? 'bg-[#181700] text-white shadow-2xs'
                : 'border border-stone-200 bg-white text-stone-600 hover:border-stone-300'
            )}
          >
            Terjadwal ({countByStatus.SCHEDULED})
          </Link>
          <Link
            href="/dashboard/appointments?status=COMPLETED"
            className={cn(
              'rounded-xl px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap',
              activeStatus === 'COMPLETED'
                ? 'bg-[#181700] text-white shadow-2xs'
                : 'border border-stone-200 bg-white text-stone-600 hover:border-stone-300'
            )}
          >
            Selesai ({countByStatus.COMPLETED})
          </Link>
          <Link
            href="/dashboard/appointments?status=CANCELLED"
            className={cn(
              'rounded-xl px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap',
              activeStatus === 'CANCELLED'
                ? 'bg-[#181700] text-white shadow-2xs'
                : 'border border-stone-200 bg-white text-stone-600 hover:border-stone-300'
            )}
          >
            Dibatalkan ({countByStatus.CANCELLED})
          </Link>
        </div>

        {/* Info Ringkas */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">
            Menampilkan {filteredItems.length} jadwal sesi
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── APPOINTMENT GRID LAYOUT (MODERN STRUCTURED CARDS) ── */}
      {filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="rounded-2xl border-dashed border-stone-200 bg-white">
          <CardContent className="flex min-h-[260px] flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center">
            <span className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[#181700]">
              <CalendarDays className="h-6 w-6" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="mt-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Tidak ada jadwal yang sesuai</h2>

              Ubah filter status atau buat appointment baru melalui tombol di atas.
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4 sm:gap-5 w-full">

  );

<file path="components/dashboard/medical-record-actions.tsx">
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { MoreVertical, FileDown, Loader2, Printer } from 'lucide-react';
import { useToast } from '@/components/ui/toast';
import { pdf } from '@react-pdf/renderer';
import { MedicalRecordDocument, type MedicalRecordPdfData } from '@/components/pdf/medical-record-document';

function safeFilePart(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, '-').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

export function useMedicalRecordPdf(record: MedicalRecordPdfData) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [printing, setPrinting] = useState(false);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null);

  const openPrintPage = async () => {
    setPrinting(true);
    try {
      const blob = await pdf(<MedicalRecordDocument record={record} />).toBlob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

      if (iframeRef.current) {
        iframeRef.current.src = url;
        iframeRef.current.onload = () => {
          iframeRef.current?.contentWindow?.print();
          setPrinting(false);
        };
      } else {
        window.location.href = url;
        setPrinting(false);
      }
    } catch {
      showToast('error', 'Gagal memproses file PDF untuk dicetak.');
      setPrinting(false);
    }
  };

  const downloadPdf = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const blob = await pdf(<MedicalRecordDocument record={record} />).toBlob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

      const date = new Date(record.recordedAt);
      const datePart = date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });
      const filename = `Hafta Fisioterapi - ${safeFilePart(record.patientName)} - ${record.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()} - ${datePart}.pdf`;

      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch {
      showToast('error', 'Gagal memproses file PDF.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return { openPrintPage, downloadPdf, loading, printing };
}

export function MedicalRecordActions({ record, className }: { record: MedicalRecordPdfData; className?: string }) {
  const { openPrintPage, downloadPdf, loading, printing } = useMedicalRecordPdf(record);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Tutup dropdown saat klik di luar panel (rule #4)
  const handleClickOutside = useCallback(
    (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    },
    [],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [handleClickOutside]);

  return (
    // Rule #2: wrapper relative inline-flex dalam pohon DOM yang sama dengan tombol pemicu
    <div ref={menuRef} className={`relative sm:inline-flex shrink-0 ${className ?? ''}`}>
      {/* Rule #2: tombol pemicu (tidak ada Portal/fixed/getBoundingClientRect) */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((v) => !v)}
        disabled={loading || printing}
        className="h-10 px-3 rounded-full bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] border border-stone-200/90 text-xs sm:text-[13px] font-semibold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:border-[#181700] focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-[#f7f000]/35 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
      >
        <MoreVertical className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
        {/* <span className="hidden sm:inline">Aksi Lebih Banyak</span> */}
      </button>

      {/* Rule #2: panel absolute menempel di atas tombol, dalam DOM yang sama */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-full right-0 z-10 mb-2 w-48 origin-bottom-right rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-2 shadow-xl">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsOpen(false);
              void openPrintPage();
            }}
            disabled={printing}
            className="hover:bg-stone-50 cursor-pointer rounded-full font-medium flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs sm:text-sm text-stone-700 transition-colors"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {printing ? (
                <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin shrink-0 text-stone-500" />
              ) : (
                <Printer className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-stone-500" />
              )}
              <span className="font-medium text-xs">{printing ? 'Mencetak...' : 'Cetak Dokumen'}</span>
            </div>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsOpen(false);
              void downloadPdf();
            }}
            disabled={loading}
            className="hover:bg-stone-50 cursor-pointer rounded-full font-medium flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs sm:text-sm text-stone-700 transition-colors"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {loading ? (
                <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin shrink-0 text-stone-500" />
              ) : (
                <FileDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-stone-500" />
              )}
              <span className="font-medium text-xs">{loading ? 'Memproses...' : 'Unduh PDF'}</span>
            </div>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/patient/patient-medical-record-view.tsx">
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Activity,
  CalendarDays,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
  ClipboardList,
  FileText,
  HeartPulse,
  Stethoscope,
  Target,
  TrendingUp,
  UserRound,
  type LucideIcon,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { MedicalRecordActions } from '@/components/dashboard/medical-record-actions';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { PatientMedicalRecordSummary, TherapyProgressView } from '@/server/queries/therapy-progress';

type TabKey = 'medis' | 'riwayat' | 'diagnosis' | 'tindakan' | 'dokumen';

const TABS: { key: TabKey; label: string; icon: LucideIcon }[] = [
  { key: 'medis', label: 'Rekam Medis', icon: Activity },
  { key: 'riwayat', label: 'Riwayat Kunjungan', icon: CalendarDays },
  { key: 'diagnosis', label: 'Diagnosis', icon: Stethoscope },
  { key: 'tindakan', label: 'Tindakan', icon: ClipboardList },
  { key: 'dokumen', label: 'Dokumen & Cetak', icon: FileText },
];

const CLINICAL_SECTIONS: { label: string; field: keyof TherapyProgressView }[] = [
  { label: 'Anamnesis', field: 'anamnesis' },
  { label: 'Pemeriksaan fisik & penunjang', field: 'physicalExamination' },
  { label: 'Diagnosis fisioterapi', field: 'diagnosis' },
  { label: 'Tindakan yang diberikan', field: 'treatment' },
  { label: 'Rencana tindak lanjut & edukasi', field: 'followUpPlan' },
  { label: 'Ringkasan sesi', field: 'summary' },
];

function calculateAge(dateOfBirth: Date | null) {
  if (!dateOfBirth) return null;
  const today = new Date();
  let age = today.getFullYear() - dateOfBirth.getFullYear();
  const month = today.getMonth() - dateOfBirth.getMonth();
  if (month < 0 || (month === 0 && today.getDate() < dateOfBirth.getDate())) age -= 1;
  return age;
}

function formatDate(value: Date) {
  return value.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
    weekday: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

function formatShortDate(value: Date) {
  return value.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

type MetricTone = 'optimal' | 'good' | 'attention';

function getMetricPresentation(key: string, score: number): {
  percentage: number;
  label: string;
  tone: MetricTone;
} {
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, Number(score)));
  if (key === 'pain') {
    if (clamped <= 3) return { percentage: (10 - clamped) * 10, label: 'Ringan', tone: 'optimal' };
    if (clamped <= 6) return { percentage: (10 - clamped) * 10, label: 'Sedang', tone: 'good' };
    return { percentage: (10 - clamped) * 10, label: 'Perlu perhatian', tone: 'attention' };
  }
  if (clamped >= 8) return { percentage: clamped * 10, label: 'Optimal', tone: 'optimal' };
  if (clamped >= 6) return { percentage: clamped * 10, label: 'Baik', tone: 'good' };
  return { percentage: clamped * 10, label: 'Perlu perhatian', tone: 'attention' };
}

function DateBadge({ date }: { date: Date }) {
  return (
    <span className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[#181700]">
      <span className="text-sm font-extrabold leading-none">{date.getDate()}</span>
      <span className="mt-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase">
        {date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { month: 'short' })}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

function EmptyState({ icon: Icon, title, description }: { icon: LucideIcon; title: string; description: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-5 py-14 text-center">
      <span className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[#181700]">
        <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
      </span>
      <h3 className="mt-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">{title}</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 max-w-sm text-xs leading-relaxed text-stone-500">{description}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export function PatientMedicalRecordView({
  patient,
  records,
}: {
  patient: PatientMedicalRecordSummary | null;
  records: TherapyProgressView[];
}) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabKey>('medis');
  const [selectedRecordId, setSelectedRecordId] = useState(records[0]?.id ?? '');
  const [showAllVisits, setShowAllVisits] = useState(false);

  const latestRecord = records[0] ?? null;
  const selectedRecord = useMemo(
    () => records.find((record) => record.id === selectedRecordId) ?? latestRecord,
    [latestRecord, records, selectedRecordId],
  );
  const firstRecord = records[records.length - 1] ?? null;
  const visibleVisits = showAllVisits ? records : records.slice(0, 5);
  const chronologicalRecords = useMemo(
    () =>
      [...records].sort(
        (a, b) => new Date(a.recordedAt).getTime() - new Date(b.recordedAt).getTime(),
      ),
    [records],
  );
  const visitNumberById = useMemo(
    () => new Map(chronologicalRecords.map((record, index) => [record.id, index + 1])),
    [chronologicalRecords],
  );
  const age = calculateAge(patient?.dateOfBirth ?? null);
  const averageProgress = records.length
    ? Math.round(
        (records.reduce(
          (total, record) => total + record.rangeOfMotionScore + record.strengthScore + record.functionScore,
          0,
        ) /
          (records.length * 30)) *
          100,
      )
    : 0;

  function openRecord(recordId: string) {
    setSelectedRecordId(recordId);
    setActiveTab('medis');
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <section className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="flex h-16 w-16 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-xl font-bold text-[#181700] ring-1 ring-stone-200">
              {patient?.avatarKey ? (
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                <img src={patient.avatarKey} alt="Foto profil" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
              ) : (
                patient?.fullName?.[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? 'P'
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 className="truncate text-lg font-bold text-[#181700]">{patient?.fullName ?? 'Pasien'}</h2>
              <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-xs text-stone-500">
                <span className="rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] px-2.5 py-0.5 font-semibold text-[#181700]">
                  {patient?.caseStatus ? `Kasus: ${patient.caseStatus}` : 'Pasien aktif'}
                </span>
                <span>No. RM {patient?.medicalRecordNumber ?? patient?.id?.slice(0, 10).toUpperCase() ?? '-'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-8 gap-y-3 border-t border-stone-100 pt-4 text-sm sm:ml-auto sm:border-l sm:border-t-0 sm:pl-8 sm:pt-0">
            <div>
              <dt className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">Usia</dt>
              <dd className="mt-0.5 font-bold text-[#181700]">{age !== null ? `${age} tahun` : '-'}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">Total kunjungan</dt>
              <dd className="mt-0.5 font-bold text-[#181700]">{records.length} sesi</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">Terapis</dt>
              <dd className="mt-0.5 max-w-40 truncate font-bold text-[#181700]">
                {patient?.therapistName ?? latestRecord?.therapistName ?? '-'}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">Jadwal berikutnya</dt>
              <dd className="mt-0.5 font-bold text-[#181700]">
                {patient?.nextTherapyAt ? formatShortDate(patient.nextTherapyAt) : '-'}
              </dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
        </div>
      </section>

      <nav
        className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-stone-100/90 p-1.5 sm:border-0 sm:bg-transparent sm:p-0"
        aria-label="Bagian rekam medis"
      >
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:flex-wrap">
          {TABS.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => {
            const isActive = activeTab === key;
            return (
              <button
                key={key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(key)}
                aria-pressed={isActive}
                className={cn(
                  'flex min-w-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors sm:h-10 sm:rounded-full sm:px-3.5 sm:text-xs',
                  key === 'dokumen' && 'col-span-2 sm:col-span-1',
                  isActive
                    ? 'border-[#181700] bg-[#181700] text-white'
                    : 'border-stone-200 bg-white text-stone-500 hover:border-stone-300 hover:text-[#181700]',
                )}
              >
                <Icon
                  className={cn(
                    'h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0',
                    isActive ? 'text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]' : 'text-stone-400',
                  )}
                />
                <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </nav>

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem]">
        <main className="min-w-0">
          {records.length === 0 ? (
            <section className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white">
              <EmptyState
                icon={Activity}
                title="Belum ada rekam medis"
                description="Catatan evaluasi akan tampil setelah fisioterapis menyelesaikan sesi dan membagikannya untuk Anda."
              />
            </section>
          ) : activeTab === 'medis' && selectedRecord ? (
            <section className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6">
              <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-stone-200 pb-5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
                  <DateBadge date={selectedRecord.recordedAt} />
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">Evaluasi Sesi Terapi</h3>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-stone-500">
                      {formatDate(selectedRecord.recordedAt)} · {selectedRecord.therapistName ?? 'Fisioterapis Hafta'}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex shrink-0">
                  <MedicalRecordActions record={selectedRecord} />
                </div>
              </header>

              <div className="py-5">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500">Parameter fisik</h4>
                <dl className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  {[
                    { key: 'pain', label: 'Nyeri', score: selectedRecord.painScore, icon: HeartPulse },
                    {
                      key: 'rom',
                      label: 'Rentang gerak (ROM)',
                      score: selectedRecord.rangeOfMotionScore,
                      icon: Activity,
                    },
                    { key: 'strength', label: 'Kekuatan otot', score: selectedRecord.strengthScore, icon: TrendingUp },
                    { key: 'function', label: 'Fungsi fisik', score: selectedRecord.functionScore, icon: UserRound },
                  ].map(({ key, label, score, icon: Icon }) => {
                    const presentation = getMetricPresentation(key, Number(score));
                    const toneStyles: Record<MetricTone, { badge: string; bar: string }> = {
                      optimal: {
                        badge: 'bg-[var(--hafta-grn-50)] text-[var(--hafta-grn-700)]',
                        bar: 'bg-[var(--hafta-grn-500)]',

                      good: {

                        bar: 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)]',

                      attention: {
                        badge: 'bg-[var(--hafta-red-50)] text-[var(--hafta-red-700)]',
                        bar: 'bg-[var(--hafta-red-500)]',
                      },
                    };
                    return (
                      <div key={key} className="min-w-0 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-[#FAFAF8] p-4">

                            <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
                          </span>
                          <span
                            className={cn(
                              'rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[9px] font-bold leading-none',
                              toneStyles[presentation.tone].badge,
                            )}
                          >
                            {presentation.label}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <dt className="mt-3 text-[11px] font-medium leading-tight text-stone-500">{label}</dt>
                        <dd className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-0.5 text-[#181700]">
                          <span className="font-mono text-2xl font-extrabold leading-none">{score}</span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-stone-400">/10</span>
                        </dd>
                        <div className="mt-3 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-stone-200/80">
                          <div
                            className={cn('h-full rounded-full', toneStyles[presentation.tone].bar)}
                            style={{ width: `${presentation.percentage}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </dl>
              </div>

              <div className="border-t border-stone-200 pt-5">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500">Catatan klinis</h4>
                <dl className="mt-2 divide-y divide-stone-100">
                  {CLINICAL_SECTIONS.map(({ label, field }) => {
                    const value = selectedRecord[field];
                    return (
                      <div key={field} className="grid gap-1 py-3.5 sm:grid-cols-[14rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-5">
                        <dt className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">{label}</dt>
                        <dd className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">
                          {typeof value === 'string' && value ? value : <span className="text-stone-400">Tidak dicatat</span>}
                        </dd>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </dl>
              </div>

              {records.length > 1 ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('riwayat')}
                  className="mt-4 inline-flex h-10 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-stone-200 bg-white text-xs font-semibold text-[#181700] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/50"

                  {records.length} sesi

              </div>
              <div className="divide-y divide-stone-100">
                {visibleVisits.map((record) => (
                  <button
                    key={record.id}
                    type="button"

                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Kunjungan Ke-{visitNumberById.get(record.id) ?? 0}</span>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-xs text-stone-500">

                      <span className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-[11px] text-stone-500">
                        <span>Nyeri {record.painScore}/10</span>
                        <span>Fungsi {record.functionScore}/10</span>
                      </span>

                    <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-stone-300 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />

              {records.length > 5 ? (
                <button
                  type="button"

                  className="mt-3 inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#181700] underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
                >
                  {showAllVisits ? 'Tampilkan lebih sedikit' : `Lihat seluruh ${records.length} kunjungan`}
                  <ChevronDown className={cn('h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-transform', showAllVisits && 'rotate-180')} />
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </section>
          ) : activeTab === 'diagnosis' ? (
            <section className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">Diagnosis & Anamnesis</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-stone-500">Ringkasan diagnosis dari setiap evaluasi fisioterapis.</p>
              <div className="mt-2 divide-y divide-stone-100">
                {records.map((record) => (
                  <article key={record.id} className="py-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <DateBadge date={record.recordedAt} />
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Evaluasi Kunjungan Ke-{visitNumberById.get(record.id) ?? 0}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">{record.therapistName ?? 'Fisioterapis Hafta'}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <dl className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                      <div>
                        <dt className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-stone-500">Diagnosis fisioterapi</dt>
                        <dd className="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">{record.diagnosis || 'Tidak dicatat'}</dd>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <dt className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-stone-500">Anamnesis</dt>
                        <dd className="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">{record.anamnesis || 'Tidak dicatat'}</dd>
                      </div>

                ))}

          ) : activeTab === 'tindakan' ? (

              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">Tindakan Terapi</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-stone-500">Pemeriksaan dan tindakan yang dilakukan pada setiap sesi.</p>
              <div className="mt-2 divide-y divide-stone-100">
                {records.map((record) => (
                  <article key={record.id} className="py-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <DateBadge date={record.recordedAt} />
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Kunjungan Ke-{visitNumberById.get(record.id) ?? 0}</p>

                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <dl className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                      <div>
                        <dt className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-stone-500">Pemeriksaan fisik & penunjang</dt>
                        <dd className="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">{record.physicalExamination || 'Tidak dicatat'}</dd>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <dt className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-stone-500">Tindakan yang diberikan</dt>
                        <dd className="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">{record.treatment || 'Tidak dicatat'}</dd>
                      </div>
                    </dl>
                  </article>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          ) : (
            <section className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">Dokumen & Cetak</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-stone-500">Unduh atau cetak ringkasan rekam medis yang telah dibagikan.</p>
              <div className="mt-2 divide-y divide-stone-100">
                {records.map((record) => (
                  <div key={record.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 py-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3">
                      <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[#181700]">
                        <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </span>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Rekam Medis Kunjungan Ke-{visitNumberById.get(record.id) ?? 0}</p>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-stone-500">
                          {record.therapistName ?? 'Fisioterapis Hafta'} · dokumen resmi
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <MedicalRecordActions record={record} />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          )}
        </main>

        <aside className="space-y-4 xl:sticky xl:top-[88px] xl:self-start">
          <section className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Ringkasan Terapi</h2>
            <dl className="mt-3 divide-y divide-stone-100 text-sm">
              <SummaryRow label="Status kasus" value={patient?.caseStatus ?? 'Aktif'} />
              <SummaryRow label="Mulai terapi" value={firstRecord ? formatShortDate(firstRecord.recordedAt) : '-'} />
              <SummaryRow label="Kunjungan" value={`${records.length} sesi`} />
              <SummaryRow label="Progres rata-rata" value={`${averageProgress}%`} />
            </dl>
            <div className="mt-4 border-t border-stone-100 pt-4">
              <h3 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500">
                <Target className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#181700]" />
                Target terapi
              </h3>
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">
                {patient?.therapyGoal ?? latestRecord?.followUpPlan ?? 'Belum ditentukan.'}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 border-t border-stone-100 pt-4">
              <h3 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500">
                <Stethoscope className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#181700]" />
                Diagnosis terkini
              </h3>
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">
                {latestRecord?.diagnosis ?? patient?.therapyDiagnosisLabel ?? 'Belum tersedia.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </section>

          {patient?.therapistNote ? (
            <section className="rounded-3xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/55 p-5">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Catatan fisioterapis</h2>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#181700]">{patient.therapistNote}</p>
              <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-stone-500">
                {patient.therapistNoteAuthor ?? patient.therapistName ?? 'Fisioterapis Hafta'}
                {patient.therapistNoteAt ? ` · ${formatShortDate(patient.therapistNoteAt)}` : ''}
              </p>
            </section>
          ) : null}

          <section className="rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">Tim Terapi</h2>
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[#181700]">
                <UserRound className="h-4 w-4" />
              </span>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#181700]">
                  {patient?.therapistName ?? latestRecord?.therapistName ?? 'Fisioterapis Hafta'}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">Fisioterapis pendamping</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            {patient?.therapyFrequencyText ? (
              <p className="mt-3 border-t border-stone-100 pt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-stone-500">
                Frekuensi terapi: {patient.therapyFrequencyText}
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </section>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SummaryRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-2.5">
      <dt className="text-xs text-stone-500">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-right text-xs font-bold text-[#181700]">{value}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="app/dashboard/layout.tsx">
import { DashboardShellRouter } from '@/components/dashboard/dashboard-shell-router';
import { requireSession } from '@/lib/auth/require-session';
import { getRecentNotifications, getUnreadNotificationsCount } from "@/server/queries/notifications";
import { getCurrentPatientProfile } from "@/server/queries/patient-profile";
import { getPendingIntakeCount } from "@/server/queries/intake-review";
import { getDb } from "@/db";
import { profiles } from "@/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { canAccessDashboardPath } from "@/lib/permissions/dashboard-routes";

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function DashboardLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { role, session } = await requireSession({ redirectToLogin: true });
  const pathname = (await headers()).get('x-pathname');
  if (!pathname || !canAccessDashboardPath(role, pathname)) notFound();

  const unreadCount = await getUnreadNotificationsCount();
  const recentNotifications = await getRecentNotifications();
  let avatarUrl: string | null = null;
  let intakePendingCount = 0;
  try {
    if (role === 'USER') {
      const p = await getCurrentPatientProfile(session.user.id);
      avatarUrl = p?.avatarKey ?? null;
    } else {
      const db = getDb();
      const [row] = await db.select({ avatarKey: profiles.avatarKey }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.userId, session.user.id)).limit(1);
      avatarUrl = row?.avatarKey ?? null;
      intakePendingCount = await getPendingIntakeCount();
    }
  } catch {
    avatarUrl = null;
  }

  return (
    <DashboardShellRouter role={role} userName={session.user.name ?? ''} userEmail={session.user.email ?? ''} avatarUrl={avatarUrl} unreadCount={unreadCount} recentNotifications={recentNotifications} intakePendingCount={intakePendingCount}>
      {children}
    </DashboardShellRouter>
  );
}
</file>
