<file path="components/auth/login-form.tsx">
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Loader2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { PasswordField } from '@/components/auth/password-field';
import { AuthAlert } from '@/components/auth/auth-alert';
import { signIn } from '@/lib/auth/client';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type FieldErrors = {
  email?: string;
  password?: string;
};

const REMEMBER_EMAIL_KEY = 'hafta_remembered_email';
const REMEMBER_ME_KEY = 'hafta_remember_me';
const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

type LoginFormProps = {
  reason?: string | null;
};

export function LoginForm({ reason }: LoginFormProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [generalError, setGeneralError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<FieldErrors>({});
  const [remember, setRemember] = useState(
    () => typeof window !== 'undefined' && Boolean(window.localStorage.getItem(REMEMBER_EMAIL_KEY)),
  );
  const [rememberDevice, setRememberDevice] = useState(false);

  const reasonBanner =
    reason === 'idle'
      ? 'Sesi Anda telah dikunci otomatis karena tidak ada aktivitas untuk melindungi kerahasiaan data medis. Silakan masuk kembali.'
      : reason === 'closed'
        ? 'Sesi sebelumnya telah berakhir saat browser ditutup. Silakan masuk kembali untuk melanjutkan.'
        : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(REMEMBER_EMAIL_KEY);
    const input = document.getElementById('email') as HTMLInputElement | null;
    if (saved && input) input.value = saved;
  }, []);

  const persistEmail = (email: string) => {
    if (remember) {
      window.localStorage.setItem(REMEMBER_EMAIL_KEY, email);
    } else {
      window.localStorage.removeItem(REMEMBER_EMAIL_KEY);
    }
  };

  const persistRememberDevice = () => {
    if (rememberDevice) {
      window.localStorage.setItem(REMEMBER_ME_KEY, '1');
    } else {
      window.localStorage.removeItem(REMEMBER_ME_KEY);
    }
  };

  const clearFieldError = (field: keyof FieldErrors) => {
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next[field];
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setGeneralError(null);

    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    const email = String(formData.get('email') ?? '').trim();
    const password = String(formData.get('password') ?? '');

    const errors: FieldErrors = {};

    if (!email) {
      errors.email = 'Alamat email wajib diisi.';
    } else if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(email)) {
      errors.email = 'Format alamat email tidak valid (contoh: nama@email.com).';
    }

    if (!password) {
      errors.password = 'Kata sandi wajib diisi.';
    }

    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
      setFieldErrors(errors);
      return;
    }

    setFieldErrors({});

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const result = await signIn.email({
          email,
          password,
          callbackURL: '/dashboard',
        });

        if (result?.error) {
          const errData = result.error as { message?: string; code?: string };

          if (errData?.code === 'EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED') {
            setGeneralError(
              'Email Anda belum diverifikasi. Silakan periksa inbox atau spam untuk tautan verifikasi.'
            );
            return;
          }

          // Kredensial tidak cocok: tandai field email dan password sebagai error spesifik
          setFieldErrors({
            email: 'Periksa kembali email Anda.',
            password: 'Kata sandi tidak sesuai dengan email yang dimasukkan.',
          });
          return;
        }

        router.push('/dashboard');
        router.refresh();
        persistEmail(email);
        persistRememberDevice();
      } catch {
        setFieldErrors({
          email: 'Terjadi kendala pada server.',
          password: 'Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.',
        });
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {/* ── LOGO HANYA DI MOBILE/TABLET (DI DESKTOP SUDAH ADA DI PANEL KIRI) ── */}
      <div className="mb-6 lg:hidden">
        <Link href="/" className="inline-block">
          <Image
            src="/images/logos/logos-text.png"
            alt="Hafta Fisioterapi"
            width={140}
            height={93}
            priority
            className="h-12 w-auto"
          />
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* ── HEADER FORM RATA KIRI (BERSIH & HUMANIZE) ── */}
      <div className="mb-7">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#181700] sm:text-3xl">
          Masuk ke Akun Anda
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-stone-600">
          Pantau jadwal sesi, catatan perkembangan terapi, dan program latihan mandiri Anda.
        </p>
      </div>

      {generalError && (
        <div className="mb-5">
          <AuthAlert type="error" message={generalError} />
        </div>
      )}

      {reasonBanner && (
        <div className="mb-6">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/80 border border-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] px-4 py-3 text-xs text-[#181700] flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-[#181700]" />
            <span>{reasonBanner}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── FORM INPUT ── */}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        {/* Email */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="email" className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-700">
            Email
          </Label>
          <input
            id="email"
            name="email"
            type="email"
            placeholder="nama@email.com"
            required
            autoComplete="email"
            disabled={isPending}
            onChange={() => clearFieldError('email')}
            aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors.email)}
            aria-describedby={fieldErrors.email ? 'email-error' : undefined}
            className={cn(
              'h-12 w-full rounded-xl border bg-white px-4 text-sm text-[#181700] placeholder:text-stone-400 transition-all duration-200 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50',
              fieldErrors.email
                ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50/30 text-red-950 focus:border-red-600 focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-red-500/20'
                : 'border-stone-300 hover:border-stone-400 focus:border-[#181700] focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#f7f000]/30'
            )}
          />
          {fieldErrors.email && (
            <p id="email-error" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-red-600 animate-in fade-in-50 duration-200">
              <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>{fieldErrors.email}</span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Password */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <PasswordField
            id="password"
            name="password"
            label="Kata Sandi"
            placeholder="Masukkan kata sandi"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            disabled={isPending}
            error={fieldErrors.password}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Baris Checkbox Simpan & Ingat Perangkat */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 pt-1 text-xs">
          <label htmlFor="rememberLogin" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-stone-600 cursor-pointer select-none">
            <input
              id="rememberLogin"
              type="checkbox"
              checked={remember}
              onChange={(e) => setRemember(e.target.checked)}
              className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 rounded border-stone-300 accent-[#181700] cursor-pointer"
            />
            <span>Simpan data login</span>
          </label>

          <label htmlFor="rememberDevice" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-stone-600 cursor-pointer select-none">
            <input
              id="rememberDevice"
              type="checkbox"
              checked={rememberDevice}
              onChange={(e) => setRememberDevice(e.target.checked)}
              className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 rounded-md border-stone-300 text-[#181700] focus:ring-[#f7f000]/30 cursor-pointer"
            />
            <span>Ingat perangkat ini selama 7 hari</span>
          </label>

          <a
            href="https://wa.me/6281232932872?text=Halo%20Admin%20Hafta%20Fisioterapi,%20saya%20butuh%20bantuan%20reset%20kata%20sandi%20akun%20pasien."
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="font-semibold text-stone-600 hover:text-[#181700] transition-colors"
          >
            Lupa kata sandi?
          </a>
        </div>

        {/* Tombol Masuk Utama */}
        <div className="pt-2">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isPending}
            className="inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-sm font-bold text-[#181700] shadow-xs transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] hover:shadow-md active:scale-[0.99] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-60 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isPending ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span>Memproses...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              'Masuk'
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Link Buat Akun Berkontras Jelas */}
        <p className="pt-2 text-center text-xs text-stone-600 sm:text-sm">
          Belum punya akun?{' '}
          <Link
            href="/register"
            className="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-bold text-[#181700] underline decoration-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] decoration-2 underline-offset-4 transition-all hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]/40"
          >
            Buat akun
          </Link>
        </p>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="components/patient/patient-intake-form.tsx">
'use client';

import { useState, useTransition, useEffect, useId } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { ConfirmDialog } from '@/components/ui/confirm-dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { savePatientIntake, startNewPatientIntake } from '@/server/actions/patient-intakes';
import type { IntakeDraftInput } from '@/lib/validators/patient-intake';
import { AlertCircle, Info, ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type IntakeStatus = 'DRAFT' | 'NEEDS_REVISION' | 'SUBMITTED' | 'UNDER_REVIEW' | 'ACCEPTED' | 'ARCHIVED';
type FieldName = keyof IntakeDraftInput;

type IntakeFormProps = {
  initialValues: Partial<IntakeDraftInput> | null;
  status: IntakeStatus | null;
  onSaved?: (mode: 'draft' | 'submit') => void;
  showStartNewAction?: boolean;
  onFooterChange?: (node: React.ReactNode) => void;
  formId?: string;
};

const steps = [
  { title: 'Keluhan', description: 'Informasi utama' },
  { title: 'Aktivitas', description: 'Dampak dan target' },
  { title: 'Riwayat', description: 'Informasi relevan' },
  { title: 'Review', description: 'Konfirmasi kirim' },
];

const statusLabel: Record<IntakeStatus, string> = {
  DRAFT: 'Draft',
  NEEDS_REVISION: 'Perlu Perbaikan',
  SUBMITTED: 'Terkirim',
  UNDER_REVIEW: 'Sedang Ditinjau',
  ACCEPTED: 'Diterima',
  ARCHIVED: 'Diarsipkan',
};

function TextField({
  name,
  label,
  hint,
  placeholder,
  required = true,
  multiline = false,
  rows = 3,
  disabled,
  register,
  error,
  className,
}: {
  name: FieldName;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  multiline?: boolean;
  rows?: number;
  disabled: boolean;
  register: ReturnType<typeof useForm<IntakeDraftInput>>['register'];
  error?: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const field = register(
    name,
    required
      ? {
          required: `${label} wajib diisi.`,
          minLength: { value: name === 'affectedArea' ? 2 : 10, message: `${label} belum cukup lengkap.` },
        }
      : undefined,
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <Label htmlFor={name} className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">
        {label}
        {required ? <span className="text-[var(--hafta-red-600)]"> *</span> : ''}
      </Label>
      {hint ? <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 leading-normal">{hint}</p> : null}
      {multiline ? (
        <textarea
          id={name}
          rows={rows}
          disabled={disabled}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          className={cn(
            "flex w-full resize-y overflow-y-auto min-h-[5.5rem] max-h-[24rem] rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-[#FEFEF6] px-4 py-3 text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed text-[#181700] placeholder:text-stone-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-400)] focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-[var(--hafta-ylw-400)]/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 transition-all scrollbar-thin",
            className
          )}
          {...field}
        />
      ) : (
        <Input
          id={name}
          disabled={disabled}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          className={cn(
            "h-12 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-[#FEFEF6] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm sm:text-base text-[#181700] focus-visible:border-[var(--hafta-ylw-400)] focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-[var(--hafta-ylw-400)]/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60",
            className
          )}
          {...field}
        />
      )}
      {error ? <p className="text-xs text-[var(--hafta-red-600)] font-semibold mt-1">{error}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function PatientIntakeForm({
  initialValues,
  status,
  onSaved,
  showStartNewAction = true,
  onFooterChange,
  formId: formIdProp,
}: IntakeFormProps) {
  const generatedId = useId();
  const formId = formIdProp ?? `intake-form-${generatedId.replace(/:/g, '')}`;
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const router = useRouter();
  const locked = status === 'ACCEPTED' || status === 'ARCHIVED';
  const canStartNewVersion = showStartNewAction && (status === 'ACCEPTED' || status === 'ARCHIVED');
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    trigger,
    getValues,
    formState: { errors },
    setError,
  } = useForm<IntakeDraftInput>({
    defaultValues: {
      chiefComplaint: '',
      affectedArea: '',
      onsetDescription: '',
      triggeringEvent: '',
      aggravatingFactors: '',
      relievingFactors: '',
      dailyLimitations: '',
      previousInjuryHistory: '',
      surgeryHistory: '',
      relevantMedicalHistory: '',
      currentMedication: '',
      allergies: '',
      patientGoal: '',
      dataAccuracyAcknowledged: false,
      ...initialValues,
    },
  });

  const stepFields: FieldName[][] = [
    ['chiefComplaint', 'affectedArea', 'onsetDescription', 'triggeringEvent'],
    ['dailyLimitations', 'patientGoal', 'aggravatingFactors', 'relievingFactors'],
    ['previousInjuryHistory', 'surgeryHistory', 'relevantMedicalHistory', 'currentMedication', 'allergies'],
    ['dataAccuracyAcknowledged'],
  ];

  const [rootErrorDetail, setRootErrorDetail] = useState<{
    title: string;
    description: string;
    actionText?: string;
    actionHref?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  async function next() {
    const valid = await trigger(stepFields[step]);
    if (valid) setStep((current) => Math.min(current + 1, steps.length - 1));
  }

  function handleConfirmNewVersion() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await startNewPatientIntake();
        if (res.success) {
          setRootErrorDetail(null);
          router.refresh();
        } else {
          setShowConfirm(false);
          if (res.reason === 'ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED') {
            setRootErrorDetail({
              title: 'Akun Anda Saat Ini Bukan Sebagai Pasien',
              description:
                'Anda saat ini sedang login dengan akun Terapis/Staf. Pembuatan form awal baru hanya dapat dilakukan oleh akun dengan hak akses Pasien.',
              actionText: 'Keluar dan masuk dengan akun pasien',
              actionHref: '/login',
            });
          } else if (res.reason === 'STILL_IN_REVIEW') {
            setRootErrorDetail({
              title: 'Form Awal Sebelumnya Masih Ditinjau',
              description:
                'Form awal Anda saat ini masih dalam proses peninjauan oleh tim fisioterapis Hafta. Anda dapat mengisi form baru setelah form saat ini selesai ditinjau dan diterima.',
              actionText: 'Lihat status di riwayat form',
              actionHref: '/dashboard/history',
            });
          } else if (res.reason === 'HAS_ACTIVE_DRAFT') {
            setRootErrorDetail({
              title: 'Anda Masih Memiliki Form yang Belum Selesai',
              description:
                'Terdapat draf form awal yang belum dikirim. Silakan lengkapi dan kirimkan draf tersebut terlebih dahulu sebelum membuat versi baru.',
            });
          } else {
            setRootErrorDetail({
              title: 'Form Awal Baru Belum Dapat Dibuat',
              description:
                'Sistem sedang memproses data klinis Anda. Silakan muat ulang halaman atau hubungi admin klinik kami jika kendala berlanjut.',
              actionText: 'Hubungi WhatsApp Hafta Fisioterapi',
              actionHref: 'https://wa.me/6281232932872',
            });
          }
        }
      } catch {
        setShowConfirm(false);
        setRootErrorDetail({
          title: 'Kendala Koneksi atau Izin Akses',
          description:
            'Permintaan pembuatan form awal baru tidak dapat diproses saat ini. Pastikan Anda masuk sebagai akun pasien dan memiliki koneksi internet yang stabil.',
        });
      }
    });
  }

  function startNewVersion() {
    setShowConfirm(true);
  }

  function save(mode: 'draft' | 'submit') {
    return handleSubmit((data) =>
      startTransition(async () => {
        try {
          await savePatientIntake(data, mode);
          setRootErrorDetail(null);
          router.refresh();
          onSaved?.(mode);
        } catch {
          setRootErrorDetail({
            title: 'Form Tidak Dapat Disimpan',
            description:
              'Terdapat isian yang belum lengkap atau sesi login Anda telah berakhir. Silakan periksa seluruh bagian bertanda bintang dan coba kembali.',
          });
        }
      }),
    );
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!onFooterChange) return;

    if (locked) {
      onFooterChange(null);
      return;
    }

    onFooterChange(
      <div className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full">
        <div>
          {step > 0 ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() => setStep((current) => current - 1)}
              className="w-full sm:w-auto h-10 sm:h-11 px-4 sm:px-5 rounded-full bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] border border-stone-200/90 font-semibold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Kembali
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-2.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={save('draft')}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto h-10 sm:h-11 px-4 sm:px-5 rounded-full bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] border border-stone-200/90 font-semibold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            Simpan Draft
          </button>
          {step < steps.length - 1 ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={next}
              className="w-full sm:w-auto h-10 sm:h-11 px-5 sm:px-6 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] font-bold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Lanjut
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button
              type="submit"
              form={formId}
              disabled={pending}
              className="w-full sm:w-auto h-10 sm:h-11 px-5 sm:px-6 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] font-bold text-xs sm:text-[13px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {pending ? 'Mengirim...' : 'Kirim untuk Ditinjau'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );

    return () => {
      onFooterChange(null);
    };
  }, [onFooterChange, step, pending, locked, formId]);

  return (
    <form id={formId} className="flex min-h-full flex-col gap-6" onSubmit={save('submit')}>
      {status ? (
        <Alert className="border-stone-200/80 bg-[#FEFEF6] text-stone-700">
          <AlertDescription className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <span className="text-stone-500">Status:</span>
            <strong className="font-semibold text-[#181700]">{statusLabel[status]}</strong>
            {locked ? <span className="text-stone-500">· Form tidak dapat diubah sampai tim Hafta meminta perbaikan.</span> : null}
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}

      {/* Humanized Error Handle Box dengan Penjelasan & Tindakan Jelas */}
      {rootErrorDetail ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--hafta-red-200)] bg-[var(--hafta-red-50)]/70 p-4.5 sm:p-5 text-[var(--hafta-red-950)] transition-all duration-200">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-[var(--hafta-red-600)] mt-0.5" aria-hidden="true" />
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5 text-sm">
              <h4 className="font-bold text-[var(--hafta-red-900)] leading-snug">
                {rootErrorDetail.title}
              </h4>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--hafta-red-800)]/90">
                {rootErrorDetail.description}
              </p>
              {rootErrorDetail.actionHref && (
                <div className="pt-2">
                  <a
                    href={rootErrorDetail.actionHref}
                    target={rootErrorDetail.actionHref.startsWith('http') ? '_blank' : undefined}
                    rel={rootErrorDetail.actionHref.startsWith('http') ? 'noopener noreferrer' : undefined}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--hafta-red-900)] border border-[var(--hafta-red-200)] shadow-2xs transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hafta-red-100)]/50"
                  >
                    <span>{rootErrorDetail.actionText}</span>
                    <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
                  </a>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {canStartNewVersion ? (
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <Button
            type="button"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={startNewVersion}
            className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] font-semibold"
          >
            {pending ? 'Membuat...' : 'Isi Form Awal Baru'}
          </Button>
          <ConfirmDialog
            isOpen={showConfirm}
            title="Isi Form Awal Baru?"
            description="Versi sebelumnya akan disimpan sebagai riwayat dan Anda akan mengisi form kosong yang baru."
            confirmLabel="Ya, Buat Baru"
            pending={pending}
            onConfirm={handleConfirmNewVersion}
            onCancel={() => setShowConfirm(false)}
          />
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* Stepper Wizard Bar */}
      {!locked ? (
        <nav aria-label="Tahap Form Awal" className="w-full py-2">
          <ol className="flex w-full items-center justify-between">
            {steps.map((item, index) => {
              const isCompleted = index < step;
              const isCurrent = index === step;
              const isPassed = index <= step;

              return (
                <li
                  key={item.title}
                  className={cn(
                    'relative flex items-center',
                    index < steps.length - 1 ? 'flex-1' : 'shrink-0'
                  )}
                >
                  {/* Step Circle & Label Button */}
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center relative z-10">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={locked || index > step}
                      onClick={() => index <= step && setStep(index)}
                      className={cn(
                        'flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-2xs',
                        isPassed
                          ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] text-[#181700] ring-3 ring-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]/30'
                          : 'border border-stone-200 bg-white text-stone-400 hover:border-stone-300',
                        index <= step && !locked ? 'cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90' : 'cursor-default'
                      )}
                      aria-current={isCurrent ? 'step' : undefined}
                    >
                      {index + 1}
                    </button>
                    <span
                      className={cn(
                        'mt-1.5 text-center text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap',
                        isCurrent ? 'text-[#181700]' : isCompleted ? 'text-stone-700' : 'text-stone-400'
                      )}
                    >
                      {item.title}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Connector segment between steps */}
                  {index < steps.length - 1 && (
                    <div className="flex-1 h-0.5 mx-2 sm:mx-3 -mt-5 bg-stone-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className={cn(
                          'h-full transition-all duration-300 ease-out',
                          isCompleted ? 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-300)]' : 'bg-transparent'
                        )}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        </nav>
      ) : null}

      {/* Document View (locked) — compact read-only summary */}
      {locked ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white divide-y divide-stone-200 overflow-hidden">
          {/* Section: Keluhan Utama */}
          <div className="px-5 py-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500 mb-3">Keluhan Utama</p>
            <div className="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Keluhan utama</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('chiefComplaint') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Area yang dikeluhkan</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('affectedArea') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Awal keluhan</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('onsetDescription') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Pemicu</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('triggeringEvent') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section: Aktivitas & Target */}
          <div className="px-5 py-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500 mb-3">Aktivitas & Target</p>
            <div className="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Keterbatasan aktivitas</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('dailyLimitations') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Target pasien</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('patientGoal') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Hal yang memperberat</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('aggravatingFactors') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Hal yang membantu meredakan</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('relievingFactors') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section: Riwayat */}
          <div className="px-5 py-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500 mb-3">Riwayat Relevan</p>
            <div className="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Riwayat cedera</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('previousInjuryHistory') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Riwayat operasi</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('surgeryHistory') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Riwayat medis relevan</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('relevantMedicalHistory') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Obat saat ini</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('currentMedication') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-0.5">Alergi</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-[#181700] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{getValues('allergies') || <span className="italic text-stone-400">Tidak diisi</span>}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* Step 0: Keluhan Utama (edit mode only) */}
      {step === 0 && !locked ? (
        <section className="space-y-6">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-[#181700]">Keluhan Utama</h2>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-stone-500">
              Tuliskan dengan kata-kata Anda sendiri sesuai yang dirasakan. Form ini bukan diagnosis medis.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
            <TextField
              name="chiefComplaint"
              label="Keluhan Utama"
              hint="Ceritakan rasa nyeri, pegal, atau rasa tidak nyaman yang paling mengganggu Anda saat ini."
              placeholder="Contoh: Pinggang bawah terasa nyeri dan kaku, terutama saat bangun tidur atau setelah duduk lama..."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.chiefComplaint?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
            <TextField
              name="affectedArea"
              label="Area Tubuh yang Dikeluhkan"
              hint="Sebutkan bagian tubuh mana saja yang mengalami keluhan."
              placeholder="Contoh: Punggung bawah, leher sebelah kanan, pundak..."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.affectedArea?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
            <TextField
              name="onsetDescription"
              label="Kapan atau Bagaimana Keluhan Mulai Terasa"
              hint="Kira-kira sudah berapa lama keluhan ini dirasakan, dan apakah muncul tiba-tiba atau perlahan?"
              placeholder="Contoh: Sudah terasa sejak 3 bulan lalu, awalnya pegal biasa lalu semakin sering kambuh dalam sebulan terakhir..."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.onsetDescription?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
            <TextField
              name="triggeringEvent"
              label="Kejadian atau Aktivitas Pemicu"
              hint="Apakah ada kejadian atau aktivitas tertentu saat keluhan pertama kali muncul?"
              placeholder="Contoh: Setelah mengangkat beban berat / duduk bekerja di depan laptop berjam-jam..."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.triggeringEvent?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : null}

      {/* Step 1: Aktivitas & Target (edit mode only) */}
      {step === 1 && !locked ? (
        <section className="space-y-6 border-t border-stone-200 pt-6">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-[#181700]">Aktivitas & Target Pemulihan</h2>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-stone-500">Bantu tim fisioterapis memahami dampak keluhan pada kehidupan sehari-hari Anda.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
            <TextField
              name="dailyLimitations"
              label="Keterbatasan Aktivitas Sehari-hari"
              hint="Aktivitas apa saja yang terganggu atau sulit dilakukan akibat keluhan ini?"
              placeholder="Contoh: Sulit membungkuk saat memakai sepatu, tidak nyaman saat menyetir mobil, terganggu saat bekerja..."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.dailyLimitations?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
            <TextField
              name="patientGoal"
              label="Target yang Ingin Dicapai"
              hint="Apa harapan atau tujuan utama Anda setelah mengikuti fisioterapi di Hafta?"
              placeholder="Contoh: Nyeri hilang tuntas, bisa duduk bekerja dengan nyaman, dan dapat berolahraga kembali tanpa sakit..."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.patientGoal?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
            <TextField
              name="aggravatingFactors"
              label="Hal yang Memperberat Keluhan"
              hint="Posisi atau gerakan apa yang membuat rasa nyeri semakin bertambah?"
              placeholder="Contoh: Duduk lebih dari 30 menit, berdiri lama, posisi membungkuk, menaiki tangga..."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.aggravatingFactors?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
            <TextField
              name="relievingFactors"
              label="Hal yang Membantu Meredakan"
              hint="Apa yang biasanya Anda lakukan untuk membuat rasa sakit berkurang atau lebih nyaman?"
              placeholder="Contoh: Berbaring telentang, kompres air hangat, istirahat jalan santai..."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.relievingFactors?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : null}

      {/* Step 2: Riwayat Relevan (edit mode only) */}
      {step === 2 && !locked ? (
        <section className="space-y-6 border-t border-stone-200 pt-6">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-[#181700]">Riwayat Kesehatan</h2>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-stone-500">Isi informasi yang Anda ketahui. Jika tidak ada, Anda cukup menulis &quot;Tidak ada&quot;.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
            <TextField
              name="previousInjuryHistory"
              label="Riwayat Cedera Sebelumnya"
              hint="Pernahkah Anda mengalami patah tulang, keseleo, atau cedera serupa di masa lalu?"
              placeholder="Tuliskan jika pernah ada cedera, atau tulis &quot;Tidak ada&quot;."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.previousInjuryHistory?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
            <TextField
              name="surgeryHistory"
              label="Riwayat Operasi"
              hint="Pernahkah Anda menjalani tindakan operasi atau pembedahan?"
              placeholder="Tuliskan jenis operasi dan tahunnya jika ada, atau tulis &quot;Tidak ada&quot;."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.surgeryHistory?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
            <TextField
              name="relevantMedicalHistory"
              label="Riwayat Medis yang Relevan"
              hint="Apakah Anda memiliki riwayat diabetes, hipertensi, saraf, atau penyakit kronis lainnya?"
              placeholder="Tuliskan riwayat penyakit jika ada, atau tulis &quot;Tidak ada&quot;."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.relevantMedicalHistory?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
            <TextField
              name="currentMedication"
              label="Obat yang Sedang Digunakan"
              hint="Apakah Anda sedang rutin mengonsumsi obat atau suplemen tertentu?"
              placeholder="Tuliskan nama obat yang rutin diminum jika ada, atau tulis &quot;Tidak ada&quot;."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.currentMedication?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
            <TextField
              name="allergies"
              label="Riwayat Alergi"
              hint="Apakah Anda memiliki alergi terhadap obat, plester medis, atau makanan tertentu?"
              placeholder="Tuliskan jika ada alergi, atau tulis &quot;Tidak ada&quot;."
              required
              multiline
              disabled={pending}
              register={register}
              error={errors.allergies?.message}
              className="text-[11px]"
            />
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : null}

      {/* Step 3: Review & Kirim */}
      {step === 3 && !locked ? (
        <section className="space-y-5 border-t border-stone-200 pt-6">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[#181700]">Review & Kirim</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-stone-500">
              Setelah dikirim, Form Awal akan ditinjau tim Hafta. Anda masih dapat memperbarui jawaban selama proses peninjauan.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-[#FEFEF6] p-4 text-sm text-stone-600 space-y-2">
            <p>
              <strong className="text-[#181700]">Keluhan:</strong> {getValues('chiefComplaint') || 'Belum diisi'}
            </p>
            <p>
              <strong className="text-[#181700]">Area yang dikeluhkan:</strong> {getValues('affectedArea') || 'Belum diisi'}
            </p>
            <p>
              <strong className="text-[#181700]">Target Terapi:</strong> {getValues('patientGoal') || 'Belum diisi'}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-start align-middle gap-3 p-4 text-sm">
            <input
              id="dataAccuracyAcknowledged"
              type="checkbox"
              className="mt-1 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 accent-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] cursor-pointer"
              disabled={pending}
              {...register('dataAccuracyAcknowledged', { required: 'Konfirmasi ketepatan data diperlukan.' })}
            />
            <label htmlFor="dataAccuracyAcknowledged" className="select-none text-[#181700] cursor-pointer">
              Saya mengonfirmasi bahwa informasi yang saya kirimkan akurat sesuai pengetahuan saya.
            </label>
          </div>
          {errors.dataAccuracyAcknowledged ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--hafta-red-600)] font-medium">{errors.dataAccuracyAcknowledged.message}</p>
          ) : null}
        </section>
      ) : null}

      {/* Action Buttons (Render inline only when drawer footer is not used) */}
      {!locked && !onFooterChange ? (
        <div className="sticky bottom-0 z-10 mt-auto -mx-5 -mb-5 flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 border-t border-stone-200 bg-[#FEFEF6] px-5 py-3.5 sm:-mx-6 sm:-mb-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-6">
          <div>
            {step > 0 ? (
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={() => setStep((current) => current - 1)}
                className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white text-[#181700] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] hover:text-[#181700]"
              >
                Kembali
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={save('draft')}
              className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white text-[#181700] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] hover:text-[#181700]"
            >
              Simpan Draft
            </Button>
            {step < steps.length - 1 ? (
              <Button
                type="button"
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={next}
                className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] font-semibold shadow-xs"
              >
                Lanjut
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button
                type="submit"
                disabled={pending}
                className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] font-semibold shadow-xs"
              >
                {pending ? 'Mengirim...' : 'Kirim untuk Ditinjau'}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </form>
  );
}
</file>

import { Users } from 'lucide-react';
import { CreatePatientFormModal } from '@/components/dashboard/create-patient-form-modal';
import { DashboardPageHeader } from '@/components/dashboard/dashboard-page-header';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
  Pagination,
  PaginationContent,
  PaginationItem,
  PaginationLink,
  PaginationNext,
  PaginationPrevious,
} from '@/components/ui/pagination';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { PatientTableClient } from '@/components/dashboard/patients/patient-table-client';

import { getPatientsList, getUnlinkedUserPatients } from '@/server/queries/patients';

function hrefFor(page: number, search: string, status: string) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page) });
  if (search) params.set('q', search);
  if (status) params.set('status', status);
  return `/dashboard/patients?${params.toString()}`;
}

export default async function PatientsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ page?: string; q?: string; status?: string }>;
}) {
  const { role } = await requireSession({ redirectToLogin: true });
  await requirePermission(PERMISSIONS.PATIENT_LIST);
  const params = await searchParams;
  const search = params.q?.trim() ?? '';
  const status = params.status ?? '';
  const result = await getPatientsList(Number(params.page) || 1, 10, search, status);
  const canCreate = hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.PATIENT_CREATE);
  const canArchive = hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.PATIENT_ARCHIVE);
  const unlinkedUsers = canCreate ? await getUnlinkedUserPatients() : [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <DashboardPageHeader
        title="Daftar Pasien"
        description="Pasien yang sudah terhubung dengan akun portal."
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard' },
          { label: 'Pasien' },
        ]}
        icon={<Users className="h-6 w-6 text-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)]" />}
        action={
          canCreate ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center w-full sm:w-auto">
              <CreatePatientFormModal
              userOptions={unlinkedUsers.map((u) => ({ id: u.id, name: u.name, email: u.email }))}
              buttonClassName={cn(
                'h-11 px-3 sm:px-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] border border-transparent text-[#181700] text-xs sm:text-[13px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0'
              )}
              />
            </div>
          ) : null
        }
      />

      {/* Content */}
      <div>
        <Card className="rounded-2xl border-stone-200/90 shadow-sm overflow-visible">
          <CardHeader className="gap-4">
            <PatientListTabs active="active" />
            <PatientListFilters initialSearch={search} initialStatus={status} />
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {result.items.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex min-h-48 flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
                <Users className="h-10 w-10 text-[#92400e]/70" />
                <p className="mt-4 font-semibold text-foreground">Tidak ada pasien ditemukan</p>
                <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Ubah pencarian atau filter, atau tambahkan akun USER sebagai pasien.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Menampilkan {(result.currentPage - 1) * 10 + 1}–{Math.min(result.currentPage * 10, result.total)} dari{' '}
                  {result.total} pasien
                </p>
                <PatientTableClient
                  items={result.items}
                  currentPage={result.currentPage}
                  canArchive={canArchive}
                />
                {result.totalPages > 1 ? (
                  <Pagination className="mt-6">
                    <PaginationContent>
                      <PaginationItem>
                        {result.currentPage > 1 ? (
                          <PaginationPrevious href={hrefFor(result.currentPage - 1, search, status)}>
                            Sebelumnya
                          </PaginationPrevious>
                        ) : null}
                      </PaginationItem>
                      {Array.from({ length: result.totalPages }, (_, index) => index + 1).map((item) => (
                        <PaginationItem key={item}>
                          <PaginationLink href={hrefFor(item, search, status)} isActive={item === result.currentPage}>
                            {item}
                          </PaginationLink>
                        </PaginationItem>
                      ))}
                      <PaginationItem>
                        {result.currentPage < result.totalPages ? (
                          <PaginationNext href={hrefFor(result.currentPage + 1, search, status)}>
                            Berikutnya
                          </PaginationNext>
                        ) : null}
                      </PaginationItem>
                    </PaginationContent>
                  </Pagination>
                ) : null}
              </>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

  Calendar,

  User,
  MapPin,

  Printer,
} from 'lucide-react';

import { hasPermission } from '@/lib/permissions/policy';

const statusConfig: Record<
  string,
  { label: string; dotColor: string; textColor: string; bgColor: string; border: string }
> = {
  SCHEDULED: {
    label: 'Terjadwal',
    dotColor: 'bg-[#e3db00]',
    textColor: 'text-[#181700]',
    bgColor: 'bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)]/70',

    bgColor: 'bg-stone-100',

    border: 'border-amber-200',
  },
};

function useAppointmentDropdownPdf(appointment: AppointmentView) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [printing, setPrinting] = useState(false);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null);

  const openPrintPage = async () => {
    setPrinting(true);
    try {
      const blob = await pdf(
        <MedicalRecordDocument
          record={{
            id: appointment.id,
            recordedAt: new Date(appointment.scheduledDate),
            patientName: appointment.patientName,
            therapistName: appointment.therapistName || 'Fisioterapis Hafta',
            painScore: 0,
            rangeOfMotionScore: 0,
            strengthScore: 0,
            functionScore: 0,
            anamnesis: '',
            physicalExamination: '',
            diagnosis: '',
            treatment: '',
            followUpPlan: '',
            summary: '',
          }}
        />
      ).toBlob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

      if (iframeRef.current) {
        iframeRef.current.src = url;
        iframeRef.current.onload = () => {
          iframeRef.current?.contentWindow?.print();
          setPrinting(false);
        };
      } else {
        window.location.href = url;
        setPrinting(false);
      }
    } catch {
      showToast('error', 'Gagal memproses file PDF untuk dicetak.');
      setPrinting(false);
    }
  };

   return { openPrintPage, loading, printing, iframeRef };
}

const typeLabel: Record<string, string> = {
  INITIAL_ASSESSMENT: 'Assessment Awal',
  THERAPY_SESSION: 'Sesi Terapi',
  FOLLOW_UP: 'Sesi Lanjutan',
  EVALUATION: 'Evaluasi Klinis',
  DISCHARGE: 'Pemeriksaan Akhir',
  CONSULTATION: 'Konsultasi',
};

function calculateEndTime(startTime: string, durationMinutes: number): string {
  const [hours, minutes] = startTime.split(':').map(Number);
  const totalMinutes = hours * 60 + minutes + durationMinutes;
  const endHours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60) % 24;
  const endMinutes = totalMinutes % 60;
  return `${String(endHours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(endMinutes).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function AppointmentCard({
  appointment,
  role,
}: {
  appointment: AppointmentView;
  role: Role;
}) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [showDeleteDialog, setShowDeleteDialog] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const editor = useAppointmentEditDrawer();

  const canEdit = hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.APPOINTMENT_UPDATE);
  const canComplete =
    hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.APPOINTMENT_COMPLETE) &&
    (appointment.status === 'SCHEDULED' || appointment.status === 'CONFIRMED');

  const date = new Date(appointment.scheduledDate);
  const formattedDay = date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
  const status = statusConfig[appointment.status] ?? statusConfig.SCHEDULED;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!appointment.isNew) return;
    const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
      markCalendarAppointmentsRead([appointment.id]).catch(() => {});
    }, 2000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  }, [appointment.id, appointment.isNew]);

  const router = useRouter();

  async function handleDelete() {
    setDeleting(true);
    try {
      await deleteAppointment(appointment.id);
      showToast('success', 'Jadwal terapi berhasil dihapus.');
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      showToast('error', 'Gagal menghapus jadwal. Silakan coba lagi.');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
      setShowDeleteDialog(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="group relative flex flex-col justify-between overflow-visible rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-2xs transition-all duration-200 hover:border-stone-300">
        <div>
          {/* Header Baris Atas: Pasien & Status */}
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
              <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-50)] text-[#181700]">
                <User className="h-5 w-5" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <h3 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-[#181700] sm:text-base">
                    {appointment.patientName}
                  </h3>
                  {appointment.isNew && (
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9px] font-black text-[#181700]">
                      BARU
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">
                  {typeLabel[appointment.type] ?? appointment.type}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Status Badge */}
            <span
              className={cn(
                'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold',
                status.bgColor,
                status.textColor,
                status.border
              )}
            >
              <span className={cn('h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full', status.dotColor)} />
              {status.label}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Blok Info Jadwal */}
          <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-stone-100 bg-[#FEFEF6] p-3.5 text-xs text-stone-600">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Calendar className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
              <span className="font-semibold text-stone-800">{formattedDay}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>
                {appointment.startTime} – {calculateEndTime(appointment.startTime, appointment.durationMinutes)} ({appointment.durationMinutes} mnt)
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <MapPin className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
              <span className="truncate">Terapis: {appointment.therapistName || 'Belum ditentukan'}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Baris Tombol Aksi — 1 Baris Kompak di Semua Layar */}
        <div className="pt-3 mt-3 border-t border-stone-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          {canComplete ? (
            <CompleteSessionButton
              appointmentId={appointment.id}
              className="h-10 px-4 rounded-full bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] text-[#181700] text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap"
            />
          ) : null}

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            {canEdit && (
              <AppointmentEditButton
                appointmentId={appointment.id}
                className="h-9 px-3.5 rounded-full border border-stone-200/90 bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#181700] text-xs font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap"
                label="Edit"
              />
            )}
            <AppointmentDropdown
              appointment={appointment}
              onDelete={() => setShowDeleteDialog(true)}
              {...useAppointmentDropdownPdf(appointment)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <ConfirmDialog
        isOpen={showDeleteDialog}
        title="Hapus Jadwal Terapi?"
        description={`Anda yakin ingin menghapus jadwal untuk ${appointment.patientName}? Tindakan ini akan membatalkan sesi.`}
        confirmLabel="Ya, Hapus"
        variant="destructive"
        pending={deleting}
        onConfirm={handleDelete}
        onCancel={() => setShowDeleteDialog(false)}
      />
      <AppointmentEditDrawer
        isOpen={editor.isOpen}
        isLoading={editor.isLoading}
        data={editor.data}
        onClose={editor.closeEdit}
      />
    </>
  );
}

function AppointmentDropdown({
  appointment,
  openPrintPage,
  loading,
  printing,
  iframeRef,
  onDelete,
}: {
  appointment: AppointmentView;
  openPrintPage: () => void;
  loading: boolean;
  printing: boolean;
  iframeRef: React.RefObject<HTMLIFrameElement | null>;
  onDelete: () => void;
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Tutup dropdown saat klik di luar panel (rule #4)
  const handleClickOutside = useCallback(
    (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    },
    [],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [handleClickOutside]);

  return (
    <div ref={menuRef} className="relative inline-flex shrink-0">
      {/* Rule #2: tombol pemicu (tidak ada Portal/fixed/getBoundingClientRect) */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((v) => !v)}
        disabled={loading || printing}
        className="w-10 h-10 aspect-square rounded-full border border-stone-200/90 bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer shrink-0"
      >
        <MoreVertical className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
      </button>

      {/* Rule #2: panel absolute menempel di bawah tombol, dalam DOM yang sama */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 bottom-full mb-2 z-10 w-48 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-stone-200/90 shadow-[0_12px_32px_rgba(24,23,0,0.14)] p-1.5 flex flex-col gap-0.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsOpen(false);
              window.open(`/dashboard/appointments/${appointment.id}/print`, '_blank');
            }}
            className="hover:bg-stone-100 font-medium flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm"
          >
            <Printer className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-medium">Cetak Jadwal</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsOpen(false);
              onDelete();
            }}
            className="hover:bg-stone-100 font-medium flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm"
          >
            <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-medium text-[var(--hafta-red-600)]">Hapus Jadwal</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { requireSession } from '@/lib/auth/require-session';

function getGreeting(): string {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour < 5) return 'Selamat Malam';
  if (hour < 11) return 'Selamat Pagi';
  if (hour < 15) return 'Selamat Siang';
  if (hour < 18) return 'Selamat Sore';
  return 'Selamat Malam';
}

function getFormattedToday(): string {
  return new Date().toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
    weekday: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

async function PatientDashboard({
  userId,
  userName,
}: {
  userId: string;
  userName?: string;
}) {
  const [intake, medicalSummary, appointments, requests, progress, availability, holidays] =
    await Promise.all([
      getCurrentPatientIntake(userId),
      getOwnMedicalRecordSummary(),
      getPatientPortalAppointments(),
      getPatientAppointmentRequests(),
      getScopedTherapyProgress({ page: 1, pageSize: 3 }),
      getPatientBookingAvailability(),
      getIndonesianHolidays(new Date().getFullYear()).catch(() => []),
    ]);

  return (
    <PatientDashboardOverview
      userName={userName}
      treatmentGoal={medicalSummary?.therapyGoal ?? null}
      intake={intake ? { status: intake.status, reviewMessage: intake.reviewMessage ?? null } : null}
      appointments={appointments}
      requests={requests}
      availability={availability}
      records={progress.items}
      totalRecords={progress.total}
      holidays={holidays}
    />
  );
}

export default async function DashboardPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string }> }) {
  const { session, role } = await requireSession({ redirectToLogin: true });

  if (role === 'USER') {
    return (
      <PatientDashboard
        userId={session.user.id}
        userName={session.user.name ?? ''}
      />
    );
  }

  const { month } = await searchParams;
  const currentMonth = new Date();
  const monthStr = /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(month ?? '')
    ? month!
    : `${currentMonth.getFullYear()}-${String(currentMonth.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
  const [holidays, nextYearHolidays, internalEvents] = await Promise.all([
    getIndonesianHolidays(currentYear),
    getIndonesianHolidays(currentYear + 1),
    getInternalCalendarEvents(monthStr),
  ]);

  const [calendarAppointments, upcomingAppointments] = await Promise.all([
    getCalendarAppointments(monthStr),
    getUpcomingScheduleAppointments(),
  ]);

  const isTherapist = role === 'THERAPIST';
  const showCharts = role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' || role === 'ADMIN' || isTherapist;
  const stats = showCharts ? await getDashboardStats() : null;
  const activities = await getRecentActivities({ limit: 8, userId: session.user.id });
  const canCreateAppt = hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.APPOINTMENT_CREATE);
  const canCompleteAppt = hasPermission(role, PERMISSIONS.APPOINTMENT_COMPLETE);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col xl:flex-row min-h-full gap-6">
      {/* ═══ MAIN CONTENT COLUMN (LEFT) ═══ */}
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-6">
        {/* Header Halaman Terapis / Admin */}
        <header className="border-b border-stone-200 pb-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-end lg:justify-between">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <LiveGreeting
                name={session.user.name || (isTherapist ? 'Terapis' : 'Admin')}
                initialNow={new Date().toISOString()}
              />
              <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-stone-600">
                Pantau jadwal pendampingan pasien, tinjau keluhan baru, dan kelola catatan perkembangan terapi.
              </p>
            </div>

            <dl className="grid shrink-0 grid-cols-2 gap-x-10 gap-y-3 border-t border-stone-100 pt-4 lg:border-l lg:border-t-0 lg:pl-8 lg:pt-0">
              <div>
                <dt className="text-[11px] font-medium text-stone-500">Jadwal bulan ini</dt>
                <dd className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-xl font-extrabold text-[#181700]">
                  {calendarAppointments.length}
                </dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-[11px] font-medium text-stone-500">Agenda internal</dt>
                <dd className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-xl font-extrabold text-[#181700]">
                  {internalEvents.length}
                </dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* ── 4 KARTU METRIK UTAMA (INTEGRASI NOTCHEDCARD) ── */}
        {stats && <TherapistKpiGrid stats={stats} isTherapist={isTherapist} />}

        {/* ── ANALYTICS BENTO PANEL (TREN & KOMPOSISI REAL DATA) ── */}
        {stats && <TherapistAnalyticsBento stats={stats} isTherapist={isTherapist} />}

        {/* ── JADWAL TERAPI MENDATANG ── */}
        <TherapistScheduleCalendar
          appointments={upcomingAppointments}
          canCreate={canCreateAppt}
          canComplete={canCompleteAppt}
          holidays={[...holidays, ...nextYearHolidays]}
        />
      </div>

      {/* ═══ RIGHT PANEL (STICKY ON DESKTOP) ═══ */}
      <aside className="w-full xl:w-[330px] shrink-0 flex flex-col gap-5 self-start xl:sticky xl:top-[88px]">
        {/* Tombol Aksi Utama: + Buat Appointment */}
        {canCreateAppt && (
          <NewAppointmentButton className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-100)] px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-[#181700] shadow-xs transition-all hover:bg-[var(--hafta-ylw-200)] hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-[0.99]">
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>Buat Appointment Baru</span>
          </NewAppointmentButton>
        )}

        {/* ── KOMPONEN GLOBAL FOLDER-TAB ACTIVITY HUB (REFERENSI GAMBAR 2) ── */}
        <RoleActivityHub
          activities={activities}
          role={role}
          userName={session.user.name ?? ''}
          dateLabel={getFormattedToday()}
        />
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';

import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

  Menu,
  ChevronDown,

  X,

  PanelLeftOpen,
} from 'lucide-react';

import { getRoleLabel } from '@/lib/role-utils';
import { getDashboardNavigation } from '@/lib/permissions/dashboard-navigation';
import { signOut } from '@/lib/auth/client';
import { NotificationBell, type NotificationView } from '@/components/dashboard/notification-bell';

  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
